bal/ gzugs bzang ba/ mdzes pa/ blta na sdug pa/ kha dog bzang po rgyas pa mchog dang ldan pa/ sngon gyi rgyal ba la lhag par bya ba byas pa/ dge ba'i rtsa ba bskyed pa/ sangs rgyas 'bum phrag bye ba khrag khrig brgya te/stong mang po la bsnyen bkurashon byas pa/ sangs rgyas 'bum phrag bye ba khrag khrig dpag tu med pa la dge ba'i rtsa ba bskyed pa zhig 'dug pa de 'khor dang bcas pa ( —)bya rgod kyi phung po'i ri ga la ba dang ri / bcom ldan 'das ga la ba der song ste phyin nas bcom ldan 'das kyi zhabs la mgo bos phyag 'tshal te/ bcom ldan 'das la lan gsum bskor ba byas nas bcom ldan 'das kyi spyan sngar 'dug ste phyinabacom ldan 'das la tshigs su bcad de gsol pa/ gal te skabs phye 46bdag gis ni/ /rdzogs pa'i sangs rgyas rkang gnyis mchog /'jig rten snang bar mdzad pa la/ /byang chub sems dpa'i spyod gang zhu/ /bcom ldan 'das kyis bka' stsal pa/ /yid la ci 'dod thams cad ni/ /bu mo khyod kyis dri bar gyis/ /byang chub sems dpa'i ri7)spyod pa kun/ /ci58)'dra khyod la bstan par bya/ /de nas bcom ldan 'das la bu mo blo gros bzang mos tshigs su bcad de gsol pa/ gang gis su ni mdzes par 'gyur/ /gang gis nor ni che ba dang / /mi phyed 'khor dang ldan par 'gyur/ /thub pas 'di ni bdag la gsungs/ /chos kyi rgyal po'i spyan sngar ni/ /gang gis rdzus she)te skye 'gyur zhing / /'dab ma stong ldan pad+ma nya snal / /mchis par yang ni gda' ba dang / /zhing rnams bye ba dpag yas par/ /sangs rgyas phyag bgyir mchi ba yi/ho/ /rdzu 'phrul pha rol phyin 'gyur ba'i(2/ /spyod pa rgyal bas lung bstan gsol/ /dgra zla ma mchis gang gis 'gyur/ /tshig kyang btsun par 'gyur ba dang / /las kyi sgrib pa ma mchis dang / /bdud 43wa 620

kyi las kun ma mchis dang / /'chi ba'i dus ni bgyid pa na①/ /mngon sumasasangs rgyas mthong ba dang / /de las chos kyang nyan pa dang / /sdug bsngal tshor ba myong mi 'gyur/ /de skad ces gsol pa dngasri/ bcom ldan 'das kyis bu mo blo gros bzang mo la 'di skad ces bka' stsal to/ /bu mo khyod kyis de bzhin gshegs pa la don 'di dri bar sems pa legs so legs so/ /bu mosnyide'i phyir legs par rab tu nyon la yid la zung shig7dang ngasashebashad do/ /bu mo blo gros bzang mos bcom ldan 'dasashelegs so zhes gsol te/ bcom ldan 'das kyi ltar nyan pa dang / bcom ldan 'das kyis de la 'di skad ces bka' stsal to/ /bu mo byang chub sems dpa' chos bzhi dang ldan na mdzes par 'gyur te / bzhi gang zhe na/ 'di lta ste/ tha na dgra la yang khro bar mi byed pa dang /byams pa la gnas pa dang / chos 'dod pa dang / de bzhin gshegs pa'i sku gzugs byed du 'jug pa ste/ bu mo byang chub sems dpa' chos bzhi po de dag dang ldan na mdzes par 'gyur ro/ /de la 'di skad ces bya ste/ gnod pa'i rtsa ba khro ba 'phel mi byed/ /byams la gnas par7byed dang chos 'dod dang / /de bzhin gshegs pa'i sku gzugs byas na ni/ /mdzes par 'gyur te blta hu7bar 'os pa yin/ /bu mo byang chub sems dpa' hurtechos bzhi dang ldan na nor che bar 'gyur te/ bzhi gang zhe na/ 'di lta ste/ dus su sbyin pa dang / 'gyod pa med5nyepar sbyin pa dang / yid du 'ong ba sbyin pa dang / rnam par smin pa 7mi re bar sbyin pa ste/ bu mo byang chub sems dpa' chos bzhi po de dag dang ldan na nor che bar 'gyur ro/ /de la 'di skad ces bya ste/ dus su byin skudang 'gyod pa med pa dang / /yid 'ong sbyin dang rnam smin mi re ba/ /dpa' bo rnams ni 843—621

las 'di byas pas na/ /rtag tu longs spyod chen po thob pa yin/ /bu mo byang chub sems dpa' chos bzhi dang ldan na 'khor mi phyed par 'gyur te/ bzhitugang zhe na/ 'di lta ste/ phra ma'i tshig spangs pa dang / sems can log par lta ba rnams yang dag pa'i lta ba yang dag par 'dzin du 'jug cing 'jog par byed pa dang / dam pa'i chos 'jig pa'i tshe dam pa'i chos srung ②ba dang /sems can rnams sangs rgyas kyi byang chub yang dag par 'dzin du 'jug cing 'jog par byed pa ste/ bu mo byang chub sems dpa' chos bzhi po de dag dang ldan na 'khor mi phyed par 'gyur ro/ /de la 'di skad ces bya ste/ phra ma de bzhin log par lta ba spong / /dam chos 'jig pa'i tshe na srung bshebyed/ /sems can byang chub yang dag 'dzin 'jug na/ /'khor rnams mi phyed phun sum tshogs par 'gyur/ /bu mo byang chub sems dpa' chos bzhi dang ldan na/sangs rgyas bcom ldan 'das rnams kyi thad du ④rin po che chen po'i pad+ma las rdzusar+sāte skye bar 'gyur te/ bzhi gang zhe na/ 'di lta ste/ phye ma 'am/ me tog ud pa la yi'am/ pad+ma 'am/ ku mu da 'ayon/ pad+ma dkar pos lag pa bkang ste/ de bzhin gshegs pa'i sku gzugs sam/ de bzhin gshegs pa'i mchod rten la 'bul ba dang / gzhan dag la yang gnod sems mi skyedasnyepa dang ske/ de bzhin gshegs pa'i sku gzugs pad+ma'i gdanashel bzhugs pa byed du 'jug pa dang / sangs rgyas kyi byang chub la nges pa rgya cher mos pa stekho/ bu mo byang chub sems dpa' chos bzhi po de dag dang ldan na sangs rgyas bcom ldan 'das rnams51kyi thad du rin po che chen po'i pad+ma las rdzus te⑩skye bar 'gyur ro//de la 'di skad ces bya gho/ phye ma me tog bkang ste 'bul ba dang / /gnod 43—622

sems spong zhing sku gzugs byed pa dang / /mos pa rgya chen la ni gnas byed na/ /rgyal ba dag gi thad du rdzus7te skye/ /bu mo byang chub sems dpa' chos bzhi dang ldan na rdzu 'phrul gyis sangs rgyas kyi zhing nas sangs rgyas kyi zhing du 'gro bar 'gyur te/ bzhi gang zhe na/ 'di lta ste/ gzhan dag gi dge ba'i rtsa ba'i bar chad mi byed pa dang / gzhan dag chos nyan pa lakhubar chad mi byed pa dang /de bzhin gshegs pa'i mchod rten dag la mar me 'bul ba dang / ting nge 'dzin sgomashepa ste/ bu mo byang chub sems dpa' chos bzhi po de dag dang ldan na rdzu 'phrul gyis sangs rgyas kyi zhing nas sangs rgyas kyi zhing du 'gro bar 'gyur ro/ /de la 'di skad ces bya ste/ dge ba dag gi⑧bar chad mi byed dang / /gzhan gyi chos gtam dag⑧la mi smod dang / /rgyal ba'i mchod rten dag la mar me 'bul/ /ting 'dzin bsgomasalgepas de ni zhing du 'gro/ /bu mo byang chub sems dpa' chos bzhi dang ldan na dgra zla med par 'gyur te/ bzhisnyigang zhe na/ 'di lta ste/ g.yo med par dge ba'i bshes gnyen dag la stenashepa dang / dge ba'i rtsa ba la ser sna mi byed pa dang / gzhan gyi rnyed pa la dga' ba dang / byang chub sems dpa' rnams kyi bya ba dang gnas pa thams cad la khong khro bar mi byed cing mi snyan pa mi sgrogs57pa ste/ bu mo〈nyebyang chub sems dpa' chos bzhi po de dag dang ldan na dgra zla med par 'gyur ro/ /de la 'di skad ces bya ste/ dge ba'i bshes gnyen rnams la de g.yo med/ /gzhan gyi rnyed la dga' zhing ser sna med/ /byang chub sems dpa'i spyod la7mi smod na/ /rtag tu dgra zla med par spyod par 'gyur/ /bu mo byang chub sems dpa' chos bzhi dang ldan na tshig btsun7par 'gyur te/ bzhi gang zhe na/ 'di lta ste/43—623

ji skad smras pa de bzhin7byed pa dang mdza' bo dag la yod pa'i rang bzhin mi 'chab pa dang / klan ka mi tsholaphubar chos nyan pa dang / gzhan chos smra ba dag la dpya skur ⑧mi byed pa ste/ bu mo byang chub sems dpa' chos bzhi po de dag dang ldan na tshig btsun par 'gyur ro/ /de la 'di skad ces bya ste/ jikhuskad smras pa de bzhin byed pa dang / /mdza' la yod pa'i rang bzhin mi 'chab cing ske/ /klan5nyeka mi tshol chos ni nyan byed na/ /'jigs pa med cing tshig kyang btsun par 'gyur/ /bu mo byang chub sems dpa' chos bzhi dang ldan na las kyi sgrib pa med par 'gyur zhing / /yongs su dag pa yang myur du rtogs par 'gyur te / bzhi gang zhe na/ 'di lta ste/ lhag pa'i bsam pa bsgrubasalgepas sdom pa gsum yang dag par len pa dang / mdo sde zab mo rnams mi spong ba dang /sems dang po bskyed pa'i byang chub sems dpa' la thams cad mkhyen pa nyid du 'du shes skyedas pa dang / sems can thams cad la byams pa sgomasapa ste/ bu mo byang chub sems dpa' chos bzhi po de dag dang ldan na las kyi sgrib pa med par 'gyur zhing yongs su dag pa yang myur du rtogs par 'gyur ro/ /de la 'di skad ces bya ste/ lhag pa'i bsam pas sdom pa gsum la gnas/ /mdo sde zab mo shenarnams la rtag tu mos/ /sangs rgyas sras la thams cad mkhyen ltar ltakhya/ /sems can rnams la byams pas las dag 'gyur/ /bu mo byang chub sems dpa' chos bzhi dang ldan na bdud kyi las med par 'gyur te/ bzhi7glegang zhe na 'di lta ste/rnye/ chos thams cad mnyam pa nyid du sgomatshwa pa dang / brtson 'grus brtsams pa dang / sangs rgyas rjes su dran pa sgom 8pa dang / dge ba'i rtsa ba yongs su sngo ba stemi/ bu mo byang chub sems dpa' chos bzhi po de dag dang ldan 43—624

na bdud kyi las med par 'gyur ro/ /de la 'di skad ces bya ste/ chos rnams la ni chos kyi tshul rtogs la/ /brtson 'grus brtsams7shing sangs rgyas rjes su dran / /yongs su sngoshezhing bshagasasnyedang phyag 'tshal ba/ /de la bdud kyis glags ni rnyed mi 'gyur/ /bu mo byang chub sems dpa' chos bzhi dang ldan na 'chi ba'i dus kyi tshe mdun du sangs rgyas bzhugs shing de las 47chos kyang nyan la sdug bsngal yang myong bar mi 'gyur te/ bzhi gang zhe na/ 'di lta ste/ gzhan dag gi bsam pa yongs su rdzogs par byed pa dang / mos pa mang ba dang /byang chub sems dpa'i sbyin pa bkod 0pa sna tshogs nye bar sgrub ⑥pa dang /dkon mchog gsum mchod pa la brtson pa ste/ bu mo byang chub sems dpa' chos bzhi po de dag dang ldan na 'chi ba'i dus kyi tshe mdun du sangs rgyas bzhugs shing de las chos kyang nyan la sdug bsngal yang myong bar mi 'gyur ro/ /de la 'di skad ces bya ste/ de ni gzhan gyi bsam pa rdzogs byed cing / /mos pa dang ni sbyin pa rgya che ba/ /mkhas pa de ni rtag tu sbyin par byed/ /de ri7)phyir de mdun de bzhin gshegasalgepa bzhugs/ /de skad ces bka' stsal nas bcom ldan 'das la bu mo blo gros bzang mos 'di skad ces gsol to/ /btsun pa bcom ldan 'das byang chub sems dpa'i bslab pa ji skad bcas pa 'di dag la bdag gis bslabam7parngo 'tshal te/ bcom ldan 'das gal te bdag gis 7bzhi pa hu7bcu po ji skad du bka' stsal pa 'di dag las chos gcig cig nyurtem spyad na yang bdag gis de bzhin gshegs pa'i sku bslus par gyur cig /de nas gnas brtan mod gal hunyegyi bu chen pos bu mo blo gros bzang mo la 'di skad ces smras so/ /bu mo byang chub sems dpa' rnams kyi spyod pa ni nyams 'og tu chud par dka' snyin 43—625

khyod 'di lta bu yang dag par len par byed na/ cinyekhyod kyisarnyusems la dbang thob bam/ de skad ces smras nas bu mo blo gros bzang mos tshe dang ldan pa mod gal7gyi bu chen po la/ 'di skad ces smras so/ /btsun pa med galasnyigyi bu bden pa dang bden pa'i tshigashegang gis bdag gis chos thams cad yongs su rdzogs par byed par 'gyur ba'i bden pa dang bden pa'i tshig des stong gsum gyi stong chen po'i 'jig rten gyi khams 'di rnam pa drug tu g.yos te0lha'i me togashegi char 'bab par gyur cig /ma dkrol bar yang sil snyan gyi sgra 'byung bar gyur cig ces byas so/ /de nas bu mo blo gros bzang mos de ltar bden pa'i byin brlabs ⑧byas ma thag tu de'i mod la stong gsum gyi stong chen po'i 'jig rten gyi khams 'di rnam pa drug tu g.yos te/ lha'i me togashegi char bab par gyur cing / ma dkrol bar lha'i sil snyan gyi sgra yang byung bar gyur to/ /btsun pa mod gal〈nyegyi bu bden pa dang bden pa'i tshig gang gis/ da ltar de bzhin gshegs pa dgra bcom pa yang dag par rdzogs pa'i sangs rgyas shākya (nyethub pa ji lta ba de bzhin du ma 'ongs pa'i dus na bdag de bzhin gshegs par 'gyur zhing / sangs rgyas kyi zhing der bdag la bdud kyang 'byung bar mi 'gyur ba dang / ngan song rnams kyi ming yang med pa dang / bud med kyi skyon rnams med par 'gyur ba'i bden pa dang bden pa'i tshig des/ 'khor 'di gser gyi kha dog can du gyur cig /bu mo blo gros bzang mos tshig de skad ces smras ma thag tu de'i med la thams cad dang ldan pa'i 'khor de gser gyi kha dog can du gyur to/ /de nas tshe dang ldan pa mod galasnyigyi bu chen po stan las langs te chos gos phrag〈nyepa gcig tu bgos nas pus mo g.yas pa'i lha nga sa la btsugs te/43—626

bcom ldan 'das ga la ba de logs su thal mo sbyar ba btud nas bcom ldan 'das la 'di skad ces gsol to/ /bcom ldan 'das bdag ni sems dang po bskyed pa nas bzung ste byang chub sems dpa' thams cad la phyag 'tshal lo/ /de nas 'jam dpal gzhon nur gyur pas bu mo blo gros bzang mo la 'di skad ces smras so/ /blo gros bzang mo khyod chos gang la gnas te bden pa'i byin gyi rlabasatu'adi byas/ blo gros bzang mos smras pa/ 'jam dpal chos kyi dbyings ni gnas pa ma mchis pas de la gnas par mi nus te 'di la dri ba ma mchis so/ /'jam dpal gyis smras pa/ blo gros bzang mo byang chub ces bya ba 'disnyegang gi tshig bla dgas yin/ blo gros bzang mos smras pa/ 'jam dpal byang chub ces bgyi ba ni rnam par mi rtog pa'i chos kyi tshig bla dgas so/ /'jam dpal gyis smras pa/ blo gros bzang mo 'di ltar byang chub sems dpa' zhes bya ba 'di gang gi tshig bla dgas yin/ blo gros bzang mos smras pa/ 'jam dpal byang chub sems dpa' zhes bgyi ba ni phyinam mkha' dang mnyam ⑥pa nyid gyi chos kyi tshig bla dgas so/ /'jam dpal gyis smras pa/ blo gros bzang mo ci de bzhin gshegs pa yang byang chub kyi phyir spyodasapa mdzad dam/ blo gros bzang mos smras pa/ 'jam dpal dper na smig rgyu7dang brag cas byang chub kyi phyir spyod pa7de bzhin du de bzhin gshegasalgepas kyang byang chub kyi phyir spyod dzo/ /'jam dpal gyis smras pa/ blo gros bzang mosakhyod kyis ci las bsams te de skad ces smras/ blo gros bzang mos smras pa/ 'jam dpal 'di la chos 'ga' la yang bsam pa'am/ bsam pa ma lagasalgepa ma mchis so/ /'jam dpal gyis smras pa/ blo gros bzang mo bsam pa de lta bu yin du zin na byis pa thams 43—627

cadamatsho)kyang byang chub tu 'gyur ro/ /blo gros bzang mos smras pa/ 'jam dpal 'di ji snyam du dgongs/ byis pa rnams kyang gzhan la mkhas pa rnams kyang gzhan te byang chub kyang gzhan par〈de ltar gzigs sam/ de ci'i slad du zhe na / 'di lta ste/ chos kyi dbyings kyi tshul du 'di ni dbyings gcig pa lags te no / blang ba ma mchis shing dor ba ma mchis la sgro btags pa ma mchis so /'jam dpal gyis smras pa/ blo gros bzang mo bshad pa 'di'i don shes pa ji snyed cig yod/ /blo gros bzang mos smras pa/ 'jam dpal bshad pa 'di'i don 'tshal sgrub ni sgyu ma sprul pa'i sems dang sems las byung ba ji snyed mchis pa des༄gesnyed do/ /'jam dpal gyis smras pa/ blo gros bzang mo sprul pa nyid kyang med na de'i sems dang sems las byung ba lta ga la yod/ blo gros bzang mos smras pa/ 'jam dpal chos kyi dbyings ni mchis pa yang ma lags5yi/ ma mchis pa yang ma lags te57/ de bzhin gshegs pa yangs)de dang 'dra'o/ /de nas bcom ldan 'das la 'jam dpal gzhon nur (7gyur pas 'di skad ces gsol to/ /bcom ldan 'das 'di ltar bu mo blo gros bzang mo 'di zab mo'i bzod pa dang ldan pa ni ngo mtshar lags so/ /bcom ldan 'das kyis bka' stsal pa/ 'jam dpal de de bzhin no/ /ji skad smras pa de the )bzhin te/ bu mo blo gros bzang mo yang dag par rdzogs pa'i byang chub la yang dag par zhugs nas bskal nya1pa sum cu 1)lon pa'i 'og tu gdod ngas bla na med pa yang dag par rdzogs pa'i byang chub tu sems bskyed do/ /khyod kyang bu mo blo gros bzang mo 'di nyid kyis mi skye ba'i chos la zhugs par byas so/ /de nas 'jam dpal gzhon nur gyur pa stan hunyelas langs te /zhebu mo blo gros bzang mo la phyag byas nas tshig 43—628

'di skad du bdag gis slob dpon yun ring mo zhig na ①mthong5kyezhes kyang smras so / /blo gros bzang mos smras pani/ 'jam dpal ma rtog shig④ /de ci'i phyir zhe na/ mi skye ba'i chos la bzod pa ni rnam par mi rtog pa'i phyir ro/ /'jam dpal gyis smras pa/ ci'i phyir slob dpon gyis bud med kyi lus las da dung ma bsgyur⑤ / blo gros bzang mos smras pa/ 'jam dpal 'di ni bud med do/ /'di ni skyes pa'o zhes bya ba de ni dmigs pa ste/ 'on kyang khyod kyi the tshomapo)med par bya'o/ /bden pa gang gis bdag ma 'ongs pa'i dus na de bzhin gshegs pa dgra bcom pa yang dag par rdzogs pa'i sangs rgyas su 'gyur ba'i bden pa des bdag skyes par gyur cig /bu mo blokhugos bzang mos tshig de skad cesalgesmras ma thag tu de'i mod la de'i7bud med kyi dngos po mi snang bar gyur nas skyes par red de tunye chos gos ngur smrig gyon tunyenas des 3)'di skad du bden pa gang gis bdag gis byang chub thob pa tunyen dge slong tshur shog ces byas pas rab tu 'byung bar 'gyur ba dang / bdag gicasangs rgyas kyi zhing der bdud kyang 'byung bar mi 'gyur ba dang / ngan song gi ming yang med pa dang / bud med kyi skyon rnams kyang med par 'gyur ba'i bden pa dang bden pa'i tshig des bdag dge slong bsnyen par7glerdzogs nas lo sum cu lon pa'i spyod lam ci 'dra ba de lta bur gyur cig ces byas so/ /byang chub sems dpa' blo gros bzang posatshwa snatshig 'di skad tunyesmras ma thag tu de'i mod la dge slong tu)bsnyen paramu )rdzogs nas lo sum cu rdunyelon pa'i spyod lamadza 2ci 'dra ba de lta bur gyur to/ /'jam dpal bden pa dang bden pa'i tshig gang gis (nyebadag gi sangs rgyas kyi zhing du sems can rnams kyi lus gser gyi kha dog lta bur 'gyur ba dang / bsam 39pas 43wa 629

bza' ba dang btung0)ba 'grub par 'gyur te(1/ gzhan 'phrul dbang byed kyi lha rnams kyi longs spyodashedang / yongs su spyod pa ji lta ba bzhin du 'gyur ba dang ske/ sangs rgyas kyi zhing de na ngan song gsum yongs su spangs parasnyi'agyur ba dang / rin po che sna bdun gyi shing ljon pa dang / rin po che'i dra bas yongs su bskor cing rin po che sna bdun gyi pad+ma dag gis rgyasasnyil steng rin po che'i bla re bres teyi/ 'jam dpal gyi sangs rgyas kyi zhing ci 'dra ba kho na dang mnyam zhing mi lhag pa de lta bur 'gyur ba'i bden pa dang bden pa'i tshig des 'khor 'di gser gyi kha dog can du gyur cig ces byas so/ /de nas byang chub sems dpa' blo gros bzang pos tshig de skad ⑦smras ma thag tu de'i mod la thams cad dang ldan pa'i 'khor de gser gyi kha dog can du gyuratsoto/ /de nas sa bla'i lha rnams kyi lha'i lus kyis gcig nas gcig tu sgra bsgrags shing skad kyis 0go bar byas te(3 / kye ma byang chub sems dpa' sems dpa' chen po blo gros bzang po byang chub thob pa'i sangs rgyas kyi zhing gi yon tan bkod (1pa ni de lta bur 'gyur ro zhes ched du brjod pa 'di〈nyeched du brjod do/ /de nas bcom ldan 'das kyis 'jam dpal gzhon nur gyur pa la bka' stsal pa/ 'jam dpal byang chub sems dpa' blo gros7bzang po 'di ni de bzhin gshegs pa dgra bcom pa yang dag par rdzogs pa'i sangs rgyas rig pa dang zhabs su ldan pa/ bde bar gshegasalgepa/ 'jig rten mkhyen pa/ skyes bu 'dul ba'i kha lo sgyur ba bla na med pa/ lha dang mi rnams kyi ston pa/ sangs rgyas bcom ldan 'das yon tan rin chen dpal gyi snying po zhes bya btso'ajig rten du 'byung bar 'gyur rol/ /bcom ldan 'das kyis chos kyi rnam grangs 'di bka' stsal pa na/ srog 43—630

chags bye ba phrag sum cu7bla na med pa yang dag par rdzogs pa'i byang chub las phyir mi ldog⑧pa nyid la yang dag par gnas par gyur to/ /lha bye ba phrag brgyad cukhuni chos rnams la chos kyi mig rdul med cing dri ma dang bral ba rnam par dag go/ /srog chags brgya stong gis ni ye shes mngon par rtogs par gyur to/ /byang chub sems dpa'i theg pa pa'i dge slong byang chub kyi sems las phyir mi ldog9)par 'dod ga⑧lnga stong tsam yang byang chub sems dpa' blo gros bzang po'i lhag pa'i bsam pa rtogs shing dge ba'i rtsa ba'i 0che ba nyid mthong nas de dag rang rang gi bla gos bcom ldan 'das kyi sku la gsol te⑩/ lhag pa'i bsam pas bla na med pa yang dag par rdzogs pa'i byang chub tu yongs su bsngos nas tshig 'di skad du bcom ldan 'das bdag cag yigi dge ba'i rtsa ba 'di 8bla na 8med pa yang dag par rdzogs pa'i byang chub tu nges par gyur cig ces smras so/ /dge slong de dag gis dge ba'i rtsa ba bla na med pa yang dag par rdzogs ⑩pa'i byang chub tu yongs su bsngos ma thag tu bskal pasnyidagu bcu'i 'khor ba bsnyil te bor nas bla na med pa yang dag par rdzogs pa'i byang chub las phyir mi ldog par gnas par gyur to/ /de dag thams cad kyang bcom ldan 'das kyis lung bstan te/'jam dpal dge slong 'di dag ni bskal pa bcu gnyis na bskal pa dri ma med pa'i 'od ces bya ba la de bzhin gshegs pa bzod par dka' ba'i sangs rgyas kyi zhing 'jig rten gyi khams 'od zer can du bskal pa gcig la bla na med pa yang dag par rdzogs pa'i byang chub mngon par rdzogs par 'tshang rgya bar 'gyur te/de bzhin gshegs pa spobs pa'i rgyan ces bya bar thams cad ming 'thun〈nyepar 'jig rten du 'byung bar 'gyur ro/ /'jam dpal de ltar na chos kyi rnam 43—631

grangs 'di ni byang chub sems dpa' sems dpa' chen po rnams dang / nyan thos rnams la rdzu 'phrul chen po byed pa yin no/ /'jam dpal rigs kyi bu 'am/rigs kyi bu mo byang chub 'dod pa gang gis bskal pa stong gi bar du thabs mkhas pa dang ma ①bral bas pha rol tu phyin pa drugasaspyad la gang gis chos kyi rnam grangs 'di bris nas〈zla ba phyed kyi bar du lan re blags5bya)na bsod nams kyi phung po snga mas nisnyibasod nams7kyi phung po 'di'i brgya'i char yangams)mi phod/ stong gi cha dang / brgya tho)stong gi77cha dang / bye ba brgya stong01gi cha dang / grangs dang ske/ bgrang ba dang / dpe〈rnyedang rgyur yang mi bzod do/ /'jam dpal de〈nyebs na chos kyi rnam grangs 'di khyod la gtad kyis 8 khyod 'dun 8par gyis la sngon gyi byang chub sems dpa'i 7smon lam las byung ba'i mdo 'di lta bu 'di ma 'ongs pa'i dus na zung shig⑩ /kun chub par gyis shig /chongs shig /shod cig /lhogs shigatunye /ston cig /gzhan dag la yang rgya cher rab tu ston cig /'jam dpal dper na 'khor los sgyur hu)ba'i rgyal po ji srid du gnas pa de srid du rin po che sna bdun med par mi 'gyur la/ 'khor los sgyur5༷ ba'i rgyal po shi na07rin po che sna bdun med par 'gyur ro/ /'jam dpal de bzhin du chos kyi rnam grangs 'di lta bu 'di 'jig rten na ji srid du spyod pa de srid du de bzhin gshegs pa'i byang chub kyi yan lag rin po che sna bdun dang / byang chub kyi phyogs kyi chos kyi tshul thams cad med par mi 'gyur la/ chos kyi rnam grangs 'di lta bu 'di med par gyur na dam pa'i chos nub par 'gyur ro/ /'jam dpal de0glebs na mdo sde rin po che 'di lta bu 'di yi ger bri ba dang / lung 'bogs sgo pa dang / bcang ba dang / bklag shustepa dang / gzhan dag la 43—632

yang rgya cher rab tu bstan pa'i phyir byang chub sems dpa' sems dpa' chen po rnams kyis brtson 'grus brtsam par bya'o/ /'di ni nga'i 3)/rjes su bstan pa yin no / /phyis 'gyod pa can du gyurakhuta re/ 'di ni rigs kyi bu 'am/ rigs kyi bu mo byang chub 'dod pa la ngas bstan pa yin no/ /bcom ldan 'das kyis de skad ces bka' stsal nas byang chub sems dpa' blo gros bzang po dang / 'jam dpal gzhon nur gyur pa dang / thams cad dang ldan pa'i 'khor des dang / lha dang ske/ mi dang / lha ma yin dang / dri zar bcas pa'i 'jig rten yis rangs te / bcom ldan 'das kyis gsungs pa la mngon par bstod ge)do// //'phags pa dkon mchog brtsegs pa chen po'i chos kyi rnam grangs le'u yestong phrag brgya pa lasar④bu mo blo gros bzang mos zhus pa'i le'u zhes bya ste na)sum cu79pa rdzogs casatshe // //rgya gar gyi hunyamakhan po dzi 32na mi tra dang / su ren dra bo dhi hu dang / zhu chen gyi lots+tsha 8ba ban de ye shes sde la sogs pas bsgyur cing 7zhus te gtan la phab nga/ski // //43wa 633

༄ga /'phags pa gang gā'i mchog gis zhus pa zhes bya ba theg pa chen po'i mdo/①༄7gi / zo'aphags pa dkon mchog brtsegs pa chen po'i chos kyi rnam grangs le'u stong phrag brgya pa las le'u sum cu ②rtsa gcig pa ste/ gang gā'i mchog gis zhus pa lung bstan pa/ bam po phyed pa /za④ rgya gar skad du/ār+ya gasgo t+ta ra pa ri kra nā ma ma hā yā na srur+sātra/ bod skad du/ 'phags pa gang gā'i mchog gis zhus pa zhes bya ba theg pa chen po'i mdog/ sangs rgyas dang byang chub sems dpa' thams cad la phyag 'tshal lo/ /'di skad bdag gis thos pa7dus gcig na/ bcom ldan 'das mnyan yod na rgyal bu rgyal byed kyi tshal mgon med zas sbyin gyi kun dga' ra ba na bzhugs te/ de'i tshe grong khyer chen po mnyanamu'iyod na dge bsnyen ma gang gā'i mchog ces bya ba zhigakheganas so/ /de nas dge bsnyen ma gang gā'i mchog mnyan yod nas byung nas rgyal bu rgyal byed kyi tshal mgon 11med zas sbyin gyi kun dga' hurter ba ga la ba der song ste phyin nas 43—638

bcom ldan 'das kyi zhabs la mgonyebos phyag 'tshal te phyogs gcig tu 'dug go/ /phyogs gcig tu 'dug pa dang / bcom ldan 'das kyis mkhyen bzhin du dge bsnyen ma gang gā'i mchog la gang gā'i mchog khyod da gzod gang ②nas 'ongs zhes7smras so/ /gang gā'i mchog gis gsol pa/ bcom ldan 'das gang zhig gis sprul pa la smras te/ khyod da gzodakyigang nas 'ongs zhes de skad bgyis na ji skad lan 'debs par 'gyur lags/ bcom ldan 'das kyis bka' stsal pa/ gang gā'i mchog sprul pa la ni 'greng ba med/ 'dug pa med/nyal ba med/ 'ong ba med/ 'gro ba med/ 'chi 'pho med/ skye ba med na 'di nas 'ongs so zhes de ci stizhig ston par 'gyur/ gang gā'i mchog gis gsol pa/ bcom ldan 'das ci chos thams cad sprul pa lta bu lags sam/bka' stsal pal/ gang gā'i mchog de bzhin no/ /gsol pa/ bcom ldan 'das gal te chos thams cad sprul pa lta bu lags na/ gang gā'i mchog khyod da gzodashegang nas 'ongs zhes7 ci'i slad du smradzi/ bcom ldan 'das kyis bka' stsal pa/ gang gā'i mchog sprul pa ni ngan song du mi 'gro/ mtho ris su mi 'gro/yongs su mya ngan las 'das par mi 'gro na ci gang gā'i mchog kyang ngan song du mi 'gro/ mtho ris su mi 'gro/ yongs su mya ngan las7'das par mi 'gro 'am/gang gā'i mchog gis gsol pa/ bcom ldan 'das gal te bdag gis dge bsnyen ma gang gā'i mchog sprul pa'i rang bzhin las gzhan lagasarwa par mthong na ni dge bsnyen ma gang gā'i mchog ngan song du mchi (nyeba'am mtho ris su mchi tunyeba'am yongs su mya ngan las 'das par mchi ba ma lags so zhes bdag sprul pa dang bstun du yang mi rung lags〈nyen/ bcom ldan 'das bdag gis7dge 43—639

bsnyen ma gang gā'i mchog sprul pa'i rang bzhin lasashigazhan lags par ma mthong ste / bcom ldan 'das de ltar bdag gis ma mthong na dge bsnyen ma gang gā'i mchog ngan song du mchi'ub 'am/ mtho ris su mchisab 'am/ yongs su mya ngan las 'das par mchiseb zhes ji skad bstan par bgyi/ bcom ldan 'das de lta lags kyis kyang g.yo ba dang / rlomasnyisems dang / bskyod pa dang /spros pa mchis na ji ltar7'di snyam du bdag ngan song du 'gro ba 'am/ mtho ris gsu 'gro ba 'am/ yongs su mya ngan las 'das par 'gro ba'o snyam du sems lags (3)te/ spubacom ldan 'das mya ngan las 'das pa'i dbyings ni nams kyangashingan song du mchirwa1ba 'am/ mtho ris su mchi hunyeb 'am yongs su mya ngan las 'das par mchi ba ma lags te(nye/ bcom ldan 'das dge bsnyen ma gang gā'i mchog kyang de lta bu'i dbyings can lags7so/ /bcom ldan 'das kyis bka' stsal pa/ gang gā'i mchog khyod ci yongs su mya ngan las 'das pa la yang dag par ma zhugs sam/ gsol pa/ bcom ldan 'das su zhig gis mi skye ba la smras 8te/ khyod yongs su mya ngan las 8'das pa la yang dag par ma zhugs sam zhes de skad bgyis na ji skad lan 'debs par 'gyur lagasatunye/bcom ldan 'das kyis bka' stsal pa/ gang gā'i mchog mi skye ba zhes bya ba ni mya ngan las 'das pa'i tshig bla dgas5)yin na de ci zhig lan 'debs par 'gyur/gang gā'i mchog gis gsol pa/ bcom ldan 'das ci chos thams cad ni tsom ngan las 'das pa dang mtshungs pa lags〈 —nyesam/ bka' stsal pa/ gang gā'i mchog de de bzhin te/ chos thams cad ni mya ngan las 'das pa dang mtshungs so / /gsol pa/ bcom ldan 'das gal te chos thams cad mya ngan las 'das 43wa 640

pa dang mtshungs pa lags na gang gā'i mchog khyod yongs su mya ngan las 'das pa la7yang dag par ma zhugs sam zhes nga ci zhig smra stetsho/ bcom ldan 'das su zhig gis sprul pa la smras te①/ khyod yongs su mya ngan las 'das pa la yang dag par ma zhugs sam zhes de skad byabagyis na ji skad lan 'debs par 'gyur lags/bcom ldan 'das kyis bka' stsal pa/ gang gā'i mchog dri ba55)'di ni dmigs pa med pa'o/ /gsol pa/ ci bcom ldan 'das kyis dmigs pa dang bcas pa'i smra bas smrasakyilags sam/ bka' stsal pa/ gang gā'i mchog dri ba 'di ni dmigs pa med mod kyi/ 'on kyang 'khor 'di na rigs kyi bu 'am/ rigs kyi bu mo 'dusnyib dag yod de/ de dag gi tso)don chen por 'gyur bas dris so/ /de ci'i phyir zhe na/ gang gā'i mchog de bzhin gshegs pas ni chos nyid ces bya ba yang mngon par rdzogs par sangs ma rgyas na gang de las byung ba'i chos yongs su mya ngan las 'das pa la gnas pa lta ga la yod/ gsol pa/ gal te bcom ldan 'das kyis chos nyid ces bgyi ba yang mngon par rdzogs par〈nyasangs ma rgyas te/ de las byung ba'i chos lta gang zhigatshwa)mchis par gyur〈rten bcom ldan 'das kyis byang chub kyi slad du ji ltar dge ba'i rtsa ba yang dag par bsgrubs lags / bcom ldan 'das kyis bka' stsal pa/ gang gā'i mchog gang dmigs pa de ni dge ba'i rtsa ba ma yin te/ byang chub sems dpa' dge ba'i rtsa ba de ni gang gi tshe yang dag par sgrub pa de'i tshe yang bsam gyis mi khyab pa nyid mi 'dor ro④ / /gang gi tshe yang dag par mi sgrub pa de'i tshe yang bsam gyis mi khyab pa nyid mi 'dor ro/ /gsol pa/ bcom ldan 'das bsam gyis mi khyab pa la bsam gyis mi khyab pa zhes bgyi ba ci'i slad du bsam gyis mi khyab pa la bsam 43—641

gyis mi khyab pa zhes bgyi/ bcom ldan 'das kyis bka' stsal pa/ gang gā'i mchog chos 'dinyeni sems pas7thob par bya ba ma yin te/ sems pas thob par byarasami nus li/ /de ci'i phyir zhe na/ 'di ltar 'di la ni sems nyid kyang mi dmigs na gang sems las rab tu byung ba'i chos lta ga la yod/ gang gā'i mchog sems mi dmigs pa ni bsam gyis mi khyab pa'i rgyud ces bya'o/ /bsam gyis mi khyab pa'i rgyud gang yin pa de ni thob pa ma yin/ mngon par rtogasar+sā)pa ma yin/ shes pa ma7yin/ mngon sum dusabyas pa ma yin te/de ni thob par bya ba ma yin/ kun nas nyon mongs pa ma yin rnam par byang ba ma yin no/ /de ci'i phyir zhe na/ gang gā'i mchog 'di ltar de bzhin gshegs pas ni chos thams cad nam mkha' ltar nges par thugs su chud de/ gang gā'i mchog chos thams cad ni7nam mkha' dang mtshungs pa gnyen po med pa'o/ /gsol pa/ bcom ldan 'das gal te chos thams cad nam mkha' dang mtshungs pa gnyen po ma mchis pa lags na bcom ldan 'das kyis gzugs zhes btags pa dang / tshor ba dang / 'du shes dang / 'du byed rnams dang rnam par shes pa zhes btags pa dang / phung po rnams dang / khams rnams dang / skye mched rnams dang / rten cing 'brel bar 'byung ba dang / zag pa dang bcas pa dang / zag pa ma mchis pa dang / kun nas nyon mongs pa dang / rnam par byang ba dang / 'khor ba dang / mya ngan las 'das pa zhes btags pa ji lta bu lagasatso/ bcom ldan 'das kyis bka' stsal pa/ gang gā'i mchog 'di lta ste dper na bdag bdag ces 'dogs kyang bdag gang yang mi dmigs pa de bzhin du gang gā'i mchog ngas gzugs zhes ⑩btags te gzugs gang yang mi 43—642

dmigs so/ /de bzhin du ngas tshor ba dang / 'du shes dang / 'du byed rnams dngatu/ rnam par shes pa zhes btags te〈rnam par shes pa gang yang mi dmigs so/ /phung po rnams dang / khams rnams dang / skye mchedashernams dang / rten cing 'brel bar 'byung ba dang / zag pa dang bcas pa dang / zag pa med pa dang zha kun nas nyon mongs pa dang / rnam par byang ba dang /'khor ba dang / mya ngan las 'das pa zhes bya bsnyiyang ngas btags te mya ngan las 'das pa gang yang ⑦mi dmigs so/ /gang gā'i mchog 'di lta ste dper na smig rgyu rnams la ni chu yong med de mi dmigs so/ /gang gā'i mchog de bzhin du ngas gzugs zhes nibya bar ⑨btags kyang gzugs gang yang mi dmigs so/ /ngas tshor ba dang / 'du shes dang / 'du byed rnams dang /rnam par shes pa zhes btags kyang rnam par shes parwategang yang7mi dmigs so//phung po rnams dang / khams rnams dang / skye mched rnams dang / rten cing 'brel bar 'byung ba dang / zag pa dang bcas pa dang / zag pa med pa dang (nyekun nas nyon mongs pa dang / rnam par byang ba dang / 'khor ba dang /mya ngan las 'das pa zhes bya bar byangs btags kyang don dam par na de dag thams cad med cing mi dmigs so/ /gang gā'i mchog gang chos la mchog tu 'dzin pa med par tshangs par spyad pa spyod pa de lta bu ni legs par gsungs pa'i chos 'dul ba la tshangs par spyod pa la gnas pa yin no/ /gang gā'i mchog mngon pa'i nga rgyal can gnas dmigs nas tshangs par spyad par spyod panyede dag gi tshangs par spyod pa de ni yongs su ma dag pa'o zhes nga smra'o⑩/ /gang dag tshangs par spyod pa yongs su ma dag pa de dag ni zab molorgyud chad pa'i chos 43—643

'di lta bu 'di thos na dngangs7skrag par 'gyur te/ de dag skye ba dang / rga ba dang / na ba dang / 'chi ba dang / mya ngan dang / smre sngags 'don pa dang ske/ sdug bsngal ba dang / yid mi bde ba dang / 'khrug pa rnams las yongs su mi 'grol te/ de dag ni sdug⑧bsngal gyi skal7ba can du 'gyur ro zhes nga smra'o/ /gang gā'i mchog da ltar ram nga 'dasalgepa'i phyi na yang rung ste/gang dag zab mo rgyud chad pa 'di lta bu'i chos ston pa de55)dag la mi gti mug pa dag gsod pa po'i 'du shes skyed par 'gyur te/ de ltar mi gti5shimug pa de dag log par zin pas bsad pa'i⑧zhe snang bskyedadzaskyenas ngan song du 'gro bar 'gyur ro/ /gang gā'i mchog gis gsol pa/ bcom ldan 'das rgyud chad pa rgyud chad pa zhes bgyi ba ci'i slad du (3 rgyud chad pa zhes bgyi/ bcom ldan 'das kyis bka' stsal pa/ gang gā'i mchog chos 'di ni rgyud gcad5)pa'am/dbye ba'am/ rnam par gzhig pa ma yin te/ de'i phyir rgyud chad pa zhes bya ste/'di ni yang dag pa'i mtha' zhesarwartebya/ bsam gyis mi khyab pa'i rgyud ces bya'o/ /de nas bcom ldan 'das kyis de'i tshe 'dzum 1 pa mdzad do/ /de nas bcom ldan 'das kyitshwastezhal gyi sgo nas 'od zeralakha dog sna tshogs kha dog du ma 'di lta ste / sngon po dang / ser po dang / dmar po dang / dkar po dang /btsod skoka dang / shel dang / dngul gyi kha dog lta bu dag byung nas de dag gis 'jig rten gyi khams mtha' yas mu med pa dag snang bar byas te 'od kyis khyab par〈shebyas nas tshangs pa'i 'jig rten gyirwanyebar du mngon par byung ste slar log nas bcom ldan 'das kyi zhal gyi sgor nub bo/ /de nas tshe dang ldan pa kun dga' bos bla gos phrags(tshepa gcig tu gzar te ni )pus mo g.yas pa'i lha nga sa la 43wa 644

btsugasatunas bcom ldan 'das ga la ba de logs su thal mo sbyar ba btud de ②bcom ldan 'das la 'di skad ces gsol to/ /bcom ldan 'das de bzhin gshegs pa rnams ni rgyu ma mchis par 'dzum pa〈(mi mdzad na 'dzum pasnyimadzad pa'i rgyu gang lags rkyen gang lags/ bcom ldan 'das kyis bka' stsal pa/kun dga' bo ngas mngon par shes te⑤/ sa phyogs 'di nyid du de bzhin gshegs pa stong gis gang gā'i mchog ces bya ba kho na'ilo7dge bsnyen ma sha stag las ⑤brtsams te/ chos kyi rnam grangs 'di bshad do/ /dge bsnyen ma de dag thams cad ni rab tu byung nas phung po ⑨med pa'i mya ngan las 'das pa'i dbyings su yongs su mya ngan las 'das so/ /de nas bcom ldan 'das la tshe dang ldan pa kun dga' bos 'di skad ces gsol to/ /bcom ldan 'das chos kyi rnam grangs 'di'i ming ci lags/ ji ltar gzung bobar bgyi/ bcom ldan 'das kyis bka' stsal〈nyepa/ kun dga' bo chos kyi rnam grangs 'di hunyeni dri ma med pa zhes bya ste/ 'di0nyedri ma med pa zhes bya bar zung shigatso /chos kyi rnam grangs 'di bstan pa na dge slong bdun brgya dang / dge slong ma bzhi brgya len pa med parashizag pa rnams las sems rnam par grol lo/ /de nas 'dod pa na7spyod pa dang / gzugs na spyod pa'i lha'i bu rnams kyis lha'i me togam rnams dang ske/ tsan dan gyi phye ma rnams mngon par sprul te/ bcom ldan 'das larwartegator nas tshig 'di skad ces 'di ltar grong khyer mnyan yod na dge bsnyen ma 'di lta bu gnas la de de bzhin gshegs pa dang lhan cig tu hunyesmra yang de'i lus ngal bar yang5) mi 'gyur ba dang / ji ltar yang 2glegang gā'i mchog 'di sngon gyi rgyal ba la lhag par bya ba du rtebyas shing dge ba'i rtsa ba bskyed pa dang / yun ring 43—645
