snying brtse 17ba can yin te/ 'jig rten la snying brtsepha ba'i phyir bsod snyoms kyi phyir rgyu ba /khyod kyis mi shes sam/ ci na khyod kyis de dag mthong la mthong bzhin du khri las kyang mi ldang / bsna ‘ zhibar yang mi byed phyag kyang mi 'tshal/gtam yang mi zer/ stan dang bsod snyoms la yang spyan55 mi 'dren/ dad pa dang gus pa yang mi skyed 6)par ci'i phyir ma gus pas7)ston cing kha rog ste 'dug /khyod kyis don gyi dbang ci zhig mthong / de skad ces smras pa dang / bu mo mya ngan med kyis byin pas rang gi phatshan/rgyal po ma skyes dgra la 'di skad ces 1)smras sol/ /yab 'di ji 7snyam du dgongs/ ci 'khor los sgyur 17ba'i rgyal po rgyal phranatsha1 la ldang ba'am/ bsnar mchi02ba nam yang gsan tam/ gzigs sam/rgyal pos smras pa/ bu mo de ni ma yin no/ /bu mos smras pa/ yab ci57lha'i dbang po brgya byin lha gzhan dag la ldang ba'am/ bsnar mchila'am/ rgyal pos smras pa/ bu mo de ni ma yin no/ /bu mos smras pa/ yab ci mi mjed kyi bdag po tshangs pa lha gzhan dag la ldang ngam/ bsnar mchis34'am/ rgyal pos smras pa/ bu mo de ni ma yin no/ /bu mos smras pa/ yab ci rgya mtsho 3 7chen po mtsho dang / mtshe'u dang / chu mig dang / mtsho bran dang / lteng 3nyeka dang /khron pa la phyag 'tshal ba gsan nyi tam/ gzigs sam/ rgyal pos smras pa tsho/bu mo de ni ma yin no/ /bu mos smras pa/ yab ci ri'i rgyal po ri rab tsho 1ri nag po gzhan dag la 'dud pa'am/ phyag 'tshal ba gsan tam/ gzigs sam/rgyal pos smras pa/ bu mo de ni ma yin no/ /bu mos smras pa/ yab ci nyi ma dang ske/ zla ba dang / skar ma'i tshogs srin bu me khyer gyi 'od 'dod pa gsan tam / gzigs sam/ rgyal pos smras pa/ bu mo de ni ma yin no/ /bu mos 43—654

smras pa/ yab ci ri dgas7kyi rgyal po seng gesawa la ldang ba 'am/ bsnar mchi bshegasan tam/ gzigs sam/ rgyal pos smras pa/ bu mo de ni ma yin no / /bu mos smras pa/ yab de bzhin du su zhig bla na medam0pa yang dag par rdzogs pa'i byang chub tu sems bskyed nas byams pa chen po dang / snying rje chen po'i seng ge'i sgra bsgragasakyil dman pa la mos pa'i7nyan thos wa lta bur gyur pa byams pa chen po dang / snying rje7chen po dang bral ba dag la dga' zhing ldang ba'am / bsnar mchi7ba'am/ phyag 'tshal ba'am/ bkur sti bgyid⑨/yab chos kyi rgyal po chen po su zhig chos kyi 'khor lo bla na med pa bskor tam6)/skorarwanyebar bgyid7pa na nyan thos dman5)pa/ zhan pa zhum pa/ nyi tshe ba'i shes pa (nyedang ldan pa rnams la dga' bas phyag 'tshal ba'am/ 'dud pa (9bgyid / yab lha'i bdag po lha'i dbang po lta bu su zhig rnam par dag pa'isnyilha'i bdag po don du gnyer ba na dge ba chung ba'i lha lta bu'i nyan thos dag la 'dod pa 'am7/ phyag 'tshal ba'am/ ldang ba'am/ bsnar mchisko ste bar bgyid/ yab mi mjed kyi bdag po tshangs pa lta bu su zhig 'jig rten na tshangs pa'i snga khang bla na med pa don du gnyer ba na dge ba'i rtsa ba chung ba'i tshangs pa lta bu'i nyan thos dag la 'dod pa 'am/ ldang ba'am/ bsnar mchi〈 nyeba'am/phyag 'tshal bar bgyid/ yab su zhig ye shes rgya mtsho dpag tu med pa mi mnyamadza nyepa dang mnyam pa'i chos rtogs pa tshol ba na ba lang gi mig 3nyerjes kyi chu lta bu'i tshul khrims kyi rjes su song ba'i nyan thos dag la 'dod pa'am/ ldang ba'amakhusnye bsnar mchi ba'am/ phyag 'tshal bar bgyid/ yab su zhig ri rab lta bu'i bsam gtan dang / rnam par thar pa dang ldan pa'i de bzhin gshegs pa'i 43wa 655

gzugs kyi sku don du gnyer ba na yungs 'bru lta bu'i7ting nge 'dzin gyi stobs dang ldan pa'i nyan thos dag la ldang ba'am/ bsnar mchikhuba'am/ phyag 'tshal ba'am/ 'dud pa'am/ 'dod pa skyed par bgyid / yab su zhig sangs rgyas bcom ldan 'das rnams kyi che ba ④nyid shes rab dang / bsod nams dang / ye shes dang / yon tan nyi ma dang zla ba'i snang ba dpag tu med pa lta bu thosalgenas srin bu me khyer gyi 'od lta bularang gi rgyud la snang ba gnas pa gzhan gyi sgra'i rjes su song ba'i nyan thos dag gi rnam par grol ba lasa'adod pa skyedalo)par bgyid/ bdag ni de bzhin gshegs pa rnams yongs su mya ngan las 'das kyang nyan thos rnams la phyag mi 'tshal na bzhugs bzhin du lta ci smos(spre/de ci'i slad du zhe na/ su zhig zla ba dang nyi ma'i dkyil 'khor btang ste7)srin bu me khyer la phyag 'tshal bar bgyid/ yab gang nyan thos la stenatshwanyepa ni nyan thos kyi sems dang gnas rtepar 'gyur ro/ /yang dag par rdzogs pa'i sangs rgyas la ston k+ṣan thams cad mkhyen pa'i nyugerin po che'i sems bskyed pa dang gnas par 'gyur ro/ /de nas rgyal po ma skyes dgras bu mo mya ngan med kyis byin pa la 'di skad ces smras so/ /'di ltar khyod nyan thos 'di dag mthong bzhin du mi ldang zhing bsnar 8mi 'gro la phyag mi the tsho'atshal zhing bsnyen bkur〈nyemi byed de/ 'di dag stan dang / bsod snyoms la spyan mi 'dren pa ni bu mo khyod lhag pa'i nga rgyal can zhig go/ /de skad ces smras hu pa dang / bu mo mya ngan med kyis byin pas rang gi pha rgyal po ma skyes dgra la 'di skad ces smras so/ /yab bdag ni lhag pa'i nga rgyal can ma lags so/ /de ci'i slad du zhe na/ yab khyod nyid grong khyer gyi dbul po rnams la mi bzhengs/ bsnar (tshemi bzhud/ stan sami 43wa 656

'dings pa lasanyen khyod nyid lhag pa'i nga rgyal can lags pa snyam bgyid do/ /rgyal pos smras pa/ bu mo de dag ni nga dngasamatshungs pa ma yin no/ /bu mos smras pa/ yab de bzhin du byang chub sems dpa' sems dang po7bskyed pa ni nyan thos dang rang sangs rgyas thams cad dang mtshungs pa ma lags sokha/ /rgyal pos smras pa/ bu mo byang chub sems dpa' rnams ni nga rgyal dang dregasalgepa spangs te sems can thams cad la 'dud cing phyag 'tshal bar mi byed dam/ bu mos smras pa/ yab byang chub sems dpa' ni 'khon57du 'dzin pa dang / tha ba dang ske/ khro ba dang / gnod sems dang / nyes pa spang ba5spyidang / dge ba'i rtsa ba yongs su smin par bgyid pa'i bslad du sems can thams cad la 'dud cing phyag 'tshal lo/ /yab nyan thos chen po 'di dag la ni 'khon du 'dzin pa dang rka/ tha ba dang /7 khro ba dang / gnod sems dang / 31nyes pa bsalarwartebar bgyi btsom mchis/ spang bar mibagyi ba dang / dge ba 'phel bar bgyi ba yang ma mchis te/ yab nyan thos thams cad la ni sangs rgyas 'bum gyisasgomanyan thos kyi tshul khrims ji snyed pa dang / ting nge 'dzin ji snyed pa dang / shes rab ji snyed pa'i chos bstanarwartedu lags kyang / yab de dag la ni tshul khrims kyang ga las marmanye/ ting nge 'dzin kyang ga las mchi/zhe/ shes rab kyang ga〈 3las mchi/ rnam par grol ba yang ga las nastomachi/ rnam par grol ba'i ye shes mthong ba nunyeyang ga las mchi/ yab 'di lta ste dper na bum pa chab kyis gtams pa'i5nyenang du char bab rdusten de gyichab kyi thigs pa gcig kyang mi len la/der gnas par yang mi 'gyur ro/ /yab de bzhin du nyan thos rnams lam 9gal te sangs rgyas 'bum0)gyis chos bshad du lags kyang de dag ni 'dzin par yangasngo ṭ+wāṃ43—657

mi 'gyur la tshul khrims dang / ting nge 'dzin dang / shes rab dang / rnam par grol ba dang / rnam par grol ba'i ye shes mthong ba yanganyede dag la gnas par mi 'gyur zhing rnam par 'phel bar yang mi 'gyur ro/ /yab 'di lta ste dper na rgya mtsho chen po ni chu klung thams cad dang / char gyi rgyun thams cad 'dzin cing der gnas par 'gyur ro/ /de ci'i slad du zhe na/ rgya mtsho chen po ni tshad masamachis pa'i slad du'o/ /yab byang chub sems dpa' sems dpa' chen po rgya mtsho lta bu deshedag kyang de bzhin te/ chos bstan pa'i chu thams cad yang dag par 'dzin cing chos bstan pa thams cad dekyil yang dag par gnas sol/ /de ci'i slad du zhe na/ 'di ltar byang chub sems dpa' sems dpa' chen po rnams kyi4)thams cad mkhyen pa nyid kyi sems kyi snodakyide ni mi mnyamakhupa dang mnyam pa'i slad du'o/ /de la 'di skad ces bya ste/ /ma skyes dgra'i7bu mor gyur pa ni/ /mya ngan med byin yon tan gzi brjid brgyan/ /nyan thos lnga brgya dag ni lhags gyur kyang / /de la phyag bya'i phyir ni de ma langs(nya ma skyes dgra yis de la smras pa ni/ /bu mo don 'di nga〈nyelas mnyanasapar gyis/ /khyod kyis nyan thos lnga brgya mthong bzhin du/ /phyag bya'i phyir na7ci phyir ldang mi byed/ /bu mo mya ngan med kyis byin na re/ /nyan thos 'di dag bdag gis mthong ba na/ /ci phyir phyag 'tshalasnyibasam pa mi skye ba/ /bdag mchis yab cig tshig ni〈pegasan par gsol/ /dper na mi zhig rgya mtshor mchis nas kyang〈nye/ /rin chen 'byung khungarwarkyenas ni mching〈nyebu blangs/ /de bzhin bdag ni nyan thos thams cad kyang / /ye shes dbyings nas nyan thos blangs snyam bgyid / /dper na rgyal po nor gyi dbang phyug po/ /sa bdag 'khor los sgyuratswa43—658

ba mnyes bgyis nas/ / kār ṣa pā khotugacig tsam gsol na ni/ /de yis rgyal po bsten⑧pa don ma mchis/ /gang gis 'khor los sgyur7ba mnyes bgyis nas//bye ba phrag stong gsol ba bgyis na ni/ /des ni dbul mang nor dang ldan par bgyid/ /des ni rgyal po legs par bsten pa lags④/ / kār ṣa pā 'o⑧slong ba'i mi bzhin du/ /gang gisakyisangs rgyas yon tan mtha' yas rnams/ /thos nas theg pa dman la 'dod skyedashepa/ /nyan thos kun la bdag ni de snyam bgyid/ /nor rnams sgrub bgyid mi ni ji lta brgya/ /byang chub sems dpa' mkhas pa de 'dra ste/ rgyal ba yonyechos kyi rgyal po mnyes bgyis shing / /byang chub reg nas sems can 'dul bar bgyid/ /dper na nad parwanyend brgyas gzir rnams sman pa yis/ /grol bgyid de bzhin gzhan gyi sgrasaphyir 'brang ba yi/ /nyan thos nyon mongs rnams kyis gzir ba thams cad kyang / /byang chub sems dpa' sman pa lta bus grol bar bgyid/ /sems can mang po grol bgyid sman pa btang nas ni/ /sos gyur sems can la ni su zhig 'dud par bgyid/ /de bzhin rdzogs pa'i sangs rgyas sman par gnyer ba na/ /sos gyur nyan thos la ni su zhig 'dud par bgyid/ /'di ltar nad pa sos par gyur pa thams cad la/ /sman pa dag gis gso bar nus par mi 'gyur ba/ /de bzhin nyan thos thams cad sos par gyur pa la/ /sangs rgyas sman pa dag gis gso bar mi spyod do/ /'di na sman pa gang zhig bdag gis bdag nyid la/ /gsonyebar sems kyi sems can gzhan la ma lags tenye/ /de 'dra'i bdag nyid 'gongs〈 spepar bgyid pa'i nga rgyal mi rte/ /sman pa de dag la ni 'dod pa'i sems mi skyedabu/ /sman pa gang zhig snying rje bskyed nas bdag nyid ji lta bar/ /de 43—659

bzhin pha rol rnams kyang nad las grol bgyid pa/ /de ni mchod par 'os shing bsngags gyo)par bgyi ba dang / /'jig rten kun gyis 'dud ④par bgyi ba'i gnas kyang lags / /gang zhigasheye shes rig pa gtso bo rtogs gyur nas/ /bdag nyid grol bar bgyid kyi sems can gzhan ma lags/ /de ni sman pa bdag nyid grol bar bgyi ba ltar⑤/ /mkhas pa dag gis mchod par0bgyi ba'i gnas ma lagasal/ /gang zhig 0ye shes rig pa gtso bo rtogs gyur kyinas/ /sems can grangs med sdug bsngal dag las grol bgyid pa/ /de dag byang chub mchog la 'dun pa skyed77pa ste/ /de ni 'jig rten kun gyis bsngags par bgyi ba lags/ /e ran da yi77shing sdong mdzes pa ma lags la/ /de dag rnams kyi grib ma 'ang hu yangs pa ma lags tehunye/ /e ran da yi 8shing 'dra nyan thos thams cad kyis/ /rnam par grol ba'i grib ma nye bar bstenatshwanyem lags/ /tsan dan mchog gi sdong chen dag ni tsha ba yis/ /gdungs pa'i skye bo rnams kyi nye bar bsten pa lags/ /de bzhin bdag ni byang chub sems dpa' rnams la yang hunye/ /lha dang bcas pa'i 'jig rten dag gi 1)don bgyid snyam/ /ba lang mig zhu )rjes chu ni yangs ma lags/ /tsha bas gdungs pa zhi bar5)mi bgyid 'khorte/ /gang gā'i ni klung ni sems can bye ba stong / /tshim par bgyis nas rgya mtsho chen por mchi/ /ba lang migasngo sterjes chu 'dra'i ni nyan thos kun/ /sems can kun gyi tsha ba zhi mi bgyid/ /gang gā'i klung 'dra 39byang chub sems dpa' rnams/ /sems can mtha' yas chos kyis tshim par bgyid/ /ji ltar rin chen char ni 'bab pa nas / /dbul po dag ni 'gron 33bu len par bgyid/ /gang zhig nor mang sa/de dag blangs nasam skuni/ /sems can dbul po nor dang ldan par bgyid//43wa 660

de ltar sangs rgyas rin chen chos char 'bebs/ /nyan thos rnams ni dam chos rin chen las/ /chung ngu 'dzin te byang chub sems dpa' rnams/ /sems can don slad mang du len paratubagyid/ /ji ltar sems can dag ni ri rab kyi/ /drung du mchis na ②gser gyi mdog tu 'gyur/ /ri bo gzhan la sems can rnams mchis na/ /gser gyi kha dog can du yong57mi 'gyur/ /byang chub sems dpa' rnams ni ri rab bzhin/ /gang dag mthus ni ④lhar bcas skye dgu rnams / /rnam grol mdog tu kha dog gcig tu 'gyur/ /nyan thos rnams kyi7yi shes 'dod mi bgyid⑥/ /yab cig ji ltar 〈〈bran rtse mo yi/ /zil pa'i thigs pasashelo tog rgyas7mi bgyid/ /rab tu khebs pa'i sprin gyis sa steng 'dikyi/ /tshim par bgyid cing lo togamo/me'aphel bar bgyid/ /nyan thos thams cad zil pa'i thigs pa bzhin/ /byang chub sems dpa' rab khebs7khrin dang 'dra/ /snying rje mngon byas gang dag bsten hurten ni/ /stong gsum dam chos chu yis tshim par bgyid/ /ka ra bi ra'i me tog 8dri mchog min/ /des ni skyes pa bud med dga' mi 'gyur/ / tsam pa ka yi mime tog dri la dga'/ /ud pal bal shi ka yang de bzhin no/ /nyan thos ka ra bi ra'i dri hu)bzhin te/ /de dag shes pas skye dgu dga' mi 'gyur/ /kun mkhyen dri canatshwa/byang chub sems dpa' la/ /lha dang mi rnams rab zhunye tu dga' bar 'gyur/ /gcig pu mchi ba༄tede la mtshar ci marmanye/ /gang zhig sems can mtha' yas khrid pa med(rte/ /nyan thos mi reng stegacig pu mchi〈 geb bzhin/ /byang chub sems dpa' rnams ni ded dpon 'dra/ /'gron zhig gzhan gyis stsal ba 'tshal ba dang / /skye bo kun la stsal bgyid kun 'gronamanyebazhin/ /sgra 'brang nyan thos kun ni 'gron snyedang 'dra/ /byang chub 43—661

sems dpa' kun la 'gronatubagyid bzhin/ /gzings la brten⑧pas chu bo chen po las ni/ /gzhan dag bsgral bar nus par mi 'gyur gyi/ /brtan bgyisakyi gru yir+sā)nang du zhugs nas7ni/ /sems can bye ba mang po sgrol bar bgyid/ /nyan thos gzings la7brten pa lta bu ste/ /sems can gzhan dag sgrol bar ji ltar nus/ /rdzogs pa'i byang chub grur zhugs byang chub sems/ /sdug bsngal mtsho las sems can sgrol bar bgyid/ /ji ltar g.yul ngor bong bu zhon na ni/ /dgra las rgyal bar nus par mi 'gyur gyi/ /glang chen rta dang shing rta zhon naphuni / /g.yul du lhags pa'i dgra rnams choms par nus/ /nyan thos rnams ni bong bu zhon pa bzhin/ /byang chub sems dpa' glang chen zhon 'dra ste/ /sems can kun la phan dang bde slad du/ /de dag shing dbang drung du bdud kyang nyunye'ajoms/ /ji ltar bar snang skar7mas rgyas gyur kyang / /de dag gis ni mtshan mo mdzes mi 'gyur/ /zla ba rab tu rgyas pa5)shar bas ni/ /mtshan mo mkha' la thig le bzhin du mdzes/ /yab cig nyan thos 'di dag skar 8ma 'dra/ /rgyal po byang chub sems dpa' zla ba bzhin/ /gang dag sems can kun la sman slad du/ /ye shes shar bas7skye bo snang bar bgyid/ /yab cig srin bu me khyer tshogs 'od kyis/ /las rnams la ni 'jug par mi nus kyis/ /'dzam gling 'di na nyi ma'i 'od rnams kyis/ /bya ba sna tshogs brgyasnyidag bgyid par 'gyur/ /nyan thos 'di dag srin bu me khyer 'dra/ /de dag shes 'od yang dag mthong mi 'gyur / /sangs rgyas rnam grol nyi ma lta bu askye/ /shes rab ye shes kyis ni sems can 'grelahurte/ /yab cig wa brgya dag gisamanyeskad phyung yang / / ri dgas 37tshogs rnams 'drog7 par mi 'gyur gyi/ / seng ge'i5)skad kyis glang 43—662

chen ri dgas7dang / /byar bcas rnams kyang phyogs su〈'byer bar 'gyur/ /yab cig de ltar nyan thos wa 'drar gzigs/ /de dag skad kyisaphubadud rnams skrag mi 'gyur/ /rgyal po7byang chub sems dpa'i spyodasaspyad pas/ /bdud dang de bzhin bdud rig skrag 0par 'gyur/ /yab cig rgyu 'di bdag gis mthong bas na/ /theg pa dman pa dag la 'dod mi skyedag/ /su zhig bla med byang chub spangs nas ni/ /theg pa dman la 'dod pa skyedarnyupar bgyid/ /gang zhig7byang chub dam pa yongs spangs nas/ /theg pa dman la 'dod pa skyed par bgyid/ /de dag 'tsho7tengan rnyed pa thob ma gyur8/ /de dag mir skyes pa ni nyes par mchis/ /gang dag lhar bcas 'jig rten sman slad du/ /byang chub mchog la 'dun 8pa skyed 8par bgyid/ /de dag legs 'tsho 8rnyed pa legs par rnyed/ /de dag mi lus thob pa legs par mchis/ /gang dag lus dang ngag dang yid kyis kyang / /'jig rten sman slad las bgyid yid kyang rton//gang dag rtag tu sems can sman slad brtson/ /de dag u dum ba ra'i〈nyeme togagle/rtebazhin / /de nas rgyal po ma skyes dgra hu)bu mo mya ngan med kyis byin pas tshigs su bcad pa bstan pa 'di dag thos nas cang mi smra bar gyur to4)/ /de nas tshe dang ldan pa shāshā ri'i bu 'di snyam du sems tezhunye/ kye ma bu mo 'di spobs pa thogs pa med pa zhig na/ ci bzod pa thob pa 'am sgo ma thob pa bdag gis 'di brtag par byar nges so snyam mo/ /de nas tshe dang ldan pa shā ri'i bus bu mo mya ngan med kyis byin pa la 'di skad ces smras so/ /ci rdunyebu mo khyod nyan thos kyi theg pa la yang dag par zhugs sam/ smras pa ma yin no/ /rang sangs rgyas kyi theg pa la yang dag par zhugs sam/ smras pa ma yin no/ /bu mo khyod ci zhig don du 43—663

gnyer na 'di ltar seng ge'i sgra sgrogs par byed/ bu mos smras pa/ btsunanyepa shā ri'i bu gal te bdag ②chos 'ga' zhig don du gnyerasnyen ni bdag seng ge'i sgra ci yang mi sgrog⑧pa zhig na/ btsunapo)pa shā ri'i bu 'di ltar bdag ni chos gang yang don du mi gnyer te/ de'i phyir bdag seng ge'i sgra sgrogs so/ /btsun pa shā ri'i bu yang gang khu'adi skad du ci bu mo khyod nyan thos kyi gatheg pa la yang dag par zhugs sam zhes zer ba ni btsun ⑧pa shā ri'i bus 0chos gang mngon du byas pa'i chos de la〈nyeci nyan thos zhes5nyebya ba 'am/ rang sangs rgyas zhes7bya ba 'am/ yang dag par rdzogs pa'i sangs rgyas zhesalge bya ba'isnyatheg pa rnam par gzhag7pa yod dam/ gnas brtan shā ri'i bus smras pa/ bu mo chos de dag la ni theg pa rnam par gzhag5nyepa med de/ chos de ni 'di ltar mtshan nyid med par mtshan nyid gcig pa'o/ /bu mos smras pa/ btsun pa shā ri'i bu mtshan nyid med pa'i chos la don du gnyer ba ci zhig yod/ shā ri'i bus smras pa/bu mo chos de la ni don du gnyer ba ci yang med do/ /gnas brtan shā ri'i bus bu mo mya ngan med kyis byin pa la gzhan yang 'di skad ces smras so/ /bu mo sangs rgyas kyi chos rnams dang / so so'i skye bo'i chos rnams la bye brag ni ci yod/tha dad du dbye ba ni ci yod/ /bu mos smras pa/ btsun pa shā ri'i bu stong pa nyid dang / dben pa nyid la bye brag ni 1rtaci yod/ tha dad du dbye ba nidza )ci yod / shā ri'i bus smras pa/ bye brag med cing tha dad du dbye ba ci yang med do / /bu mos smras pa( lha/ btsun du )pa shā ri'i (nyebu stong pa nyid dang / dben pa nyid lamanyeji ltar bye brag med cing tha dad du dbye ba ci yang med pa de bzhin du btsun pa shā ri'i bu sangs rgyas kyi chos rnams dang / so so'i skye bo'i chos rnams 43wa 664

la yang bye brag med cing tha dad du dbye ba ci yang0)med do/ /btsun pa shā ri'i bu 'di lta ste dper na nam mkha' dang bla gab med pa la yang bye brag med cing tha dad du dbye ba ci yang med do/ /btsun pa shā ri'i〈 bu de bzhin du sangs rgyas kyi chos rnams dang / so so〈skye bo'i chos rnams la yang bye brag med cing tha dad du dbye ba ci yang med do/ /gnas brtan shā ri'i bu cang mi smra bar gyur to/ /de nas tshe dang ldan pa mod gal gyi bu chen pos bu mo mya ngan med kyis byin pa la 'di skad ces smras so/ /bu mo cidzagekhyod de skad ces zer ba las na sangs rgyas kyi chos rnams ni shin tu ches lhag pa zhig ⑤tu mthong la/ nyan thos kyi chos rnams ni 0shin tu dman par ⑦mthong ngam ci na khyod nyan thos chen po rnams mthong na ldang bar yang mi byed/ phyag kyang mi 'tshal/ snaraX yang mi 'gro/gtam yang mi zer/ stan dang bsod snyoms la yang spyan 'dren par mi byed de skad ces smras pa dang / bu mo mya ngan med kyis byin pas gnas brtanalo mod gal gyi bu chen po la 'di skad ces smras so/ /btsun pa mod gal gyi bu chen po stong gsum gyi stong chen po'i tshi'ajig rten gyi khams na skar ma'i gzugs su gtogs pa ji snyed cig yod pa shes sam/ mod gal gyi bu chen pos smras pa/bu mo snyoms par zhugs na ni kho bos grangs shes kyi snyoms par ma zhugs na ni mi shes so/ /bu mos smras pa/ btsun pa mod gal gyi bu chen po de bzhin gshegs pas51ni lan cig mnyam nyurtepar bzhag /nyepa nyid kyis stong gsum gyi stong chen po'i 'jig rten gyi khams gang gā'i klung gi bye ma snyed dag na sems can 'das pa dang ske/ ma 'ongs pa dang / da ltar byung ba thams cad kyi sems kyi spyod pa yang rab tu mkhyen na/ stong gsum gyi stong chen po'i 'jig rten gyi khams gcig tu 43—665

gtogs pa'i sems can rnams7kyi lta ci smos te②/ btsun pa mod gal gyi bu chen po 'di ni de bzhin gshegs pa dang / nyan thos rnams kyi khyad par yin te/'di ni tha dad du dbye ba yin no/ /btsun pa mod gal gyi bu chen po phyogs bcu'i 'jig rten na sangs rgyas kyi zhing 'jig⑧pa ni ji snyed cig yod/ 'chags pa ni ji snyed cig yod dushes sam/ mod gal gyi bus smras pa/ bu mo de ni mi shes so/ /bu mos smras pa/ btsun pa mod gal gyi bu chen po sangs rgyas bcom ldan 'das 'das pa ni ji snyed cig yod/ ma byon pa ni ji snyed cig yod/ da ltar bzhugs pa ni ji snyed cig yod shes sam/ mod gal gyi bus smras pa/ bu mo de ni mi shes so/ /bu mos smras pa/ btsun pa mod gal gyi bu chen po sems can 'dod chags la spyod pa ni ji snyed cig yod/ zhe snang la spyod pa ni ji snyed cig yod/ gti mug la spyod pa0ni ji snyed cig yod/ cha mnyam pa la spyod pa ni ji snyed cig yod shes sam/ mod gal gyi bus smras pa/bu mo de ni mi shes so/ /bu mos smras pa/ btsun pa mod gal gyi bu chen po nyan thos kyi theg pa pa'i sems can ni ji snyed cig yod rang sangs rgyas kyi theg pa pa ni ji snyed cig yod/ theg pa chen po la yang dag par zhugasalgepa ni ji snyed cig yod shes sam/ mod gal gyi bus smras pa/ bu mo de ni mi shes so/ /bu mos smras pa/ btsun pa mod gal gyi bu chen po nyan thos kyis 'dul ba'i sems can ni ji snyed cig yod/ rang sangs rgyas kyis 'dul ba'i sems can ni ji snyed cig yod/ sangs rgyas kyis 'dul ba'i sems can ni ji snyed cig yod shes sam / mod gal gyi bus smras pa/ bu mo de ni mi shes so/ /bu mos smras pa/btsun pa mod gal gyi bu chen po yang dag pa nyid du nges pa'i sems can ni ji 43—666

snyed cig yod/ log pa nyid du nges pa'i sems can ni ji snyed cig yod/ skem nges pa'i sems can ni ji snyed cig yod shes sam/ mod gal gyi bus smras pa/bu mo de ni mi shes so/ /bu mosanyesmras pa/ btsun pa mod gal gyi bu chen po de bzhin gshegs pas ni de dag dang gzhan yang de'i gong du gang nyan thos dang rang sangs rgyas thams cad kyis ma yin pa dag kyang rab tu mkhyen na/ sems can gzhan dag gi lta ci smos te④/ btsun pa mod gal gyi bu chen po 'di ni de bzhin gshegs pa'i bla ma'i khyad par yin no/ /btsun pa mod gal gyi bu chen po gzhan yang de bzhin gshegs pas khyod rdzu 'phrul chen po rnams kyi mchog tu bstan gyis / btsun pa med gal gyi bu chen po 'jig rten gyi khams spos kyi 'od ces bya balgegang na de bzhin gshegs pa dgra bcom pa yang dag par rdzogs pa'i sangs rgyas spos rab tu 'gyed pa'i 'od zer zhes bya bsnyed ltar bzhugs te 'tsho ༷zhing gzhes rgyal byang chub sems dpa' rnams la chos kyang ston ⑧pa'i sangs rgyas kyi zhing deshen shing ljon pa thams cad las tsan dan sbrul gyi snying po'i spos gang gis sangs rgyas kyitshwa)zhing de khyab par 'gyur ba'i spos kyi ngad ldang ba yod pa der song shigs /gnas brtan7mod gal gyi bu chen pos smras pa/ bu mo sangs rgyas kyi zhing de'i ming yang yikho bos da gdod 8thos na sangs rgyas la bltasnyib dang / chos mnyan7pa'i phyir ji ltar 'gro bar bya/ de nas bu mo mya ngan med kyis byin pas khri de las ma langs bzhin du tshig 'di skad ces smras te⑩/bden pa dang / bden pa'i tshig gang77gis byang chub sems dpa' sems dpa' chen pos sems dang po5nyebaskyed ma thag tu nyan thos dang rang sangs rgyas thams cad zil gyis gnon pa lta na/ bden pa dang / bden pa'i tshig des 43—667

de bzhin gshegs pa spos rab tu 'gyed pa'i 'od zer hu)des bdag nyid dang /rang gi sangs rgyas kyi zhing nyan thos chen pophu'adi dag la ston par gyur cig /tsan dan gyi dri de dag kyang nyan thos chen po 'di sedag gis tshor bar gyur cig ces byas so/ /de nas bu mo mya ngan med kyis byin pas tshig dekhuskad ces7smras ma thag tu bden pa'i byin gyi rlabasamanyades bcom ldan 'das de bzhin gshegs pa spos perab tu 'gyed pa'i 'od zera'ugyis de nyid kyi tshe 'od gang gis nyan thos chen po de dag gis spu'ajig rten gyi khams spos kyi 'od de dang / de bzhin gshegs pa dgra bcom pa yang dag par rdzogs pa'i sangs rgyas spos rab tu 'gyed pa'i 'od zer hu )de chos ston cing bzhugs par51mthong bar 'gyur ba de lta bu'i 'od sku las bkye'ohurte/ /chos bstan pa de yang sangs rgyas kyi mthus 'jig rten gyi khams 'dir thos so/ /tsan danatshwa sbrul gyi snying po'i dri des kyang 'jig rten gyi khams mi mjed 'dir khyabalgepar gyur to/ /de bzhin gshegs pa spos rab tu 'gyed pa'i 'od zer 8des kyang gsung gi yan lag drug cu ⑩dang ldan pa'i tshig gis 'di skad ces bka' stsal to/ /bu mo mya ngan med kyis byin pas ji skad smras pa hu tshobazhin te/ byang chub sems dpa' sems dpa' chen pos sems dang po nyushebaskyed ma thag tu nyan thos dang rang sangs 37rgyas thams cad zil gyis gnon to/ /de nas byang chub sems dpa' sems dpa' chen po byams pa du —3 bya rgod kyi phung po du 1la gnas pas tsan dan sbrul gyi snying po'i dri tshor nas bcom ldan 'das la 'di skad ces gsol to/ /bcom ldan 'das tsan danasko rnyasbrul gyi snying po'i dri 'di ga las byung lags/ de skad ces gsol pa dang / bcom ldan 'das kyis byang chub sems dpa' byams pa la 'di skad ces bka' stsal to/ /43wa 668

byams pa bu mo mya ngan med kyis byin pa 'dis nyan thos chen po rnams kyi7mdun du seng sgo'i sgra bsgrags te/ des nyan thos chen po de dag la bden pa'i byin gyi rlabs7kyis 'jig rten gyi khams spos kyi 'od ces bya ba na de bzhin gshegs pa spos rab tu 'gyed pa'i 'od zer7byang chub sems dpa' sems dpa' chen po rnams la chos ston cing bzhugs pa yang bstan/ 'jig rten gyi khams spos kyi 'od de'i tsan dan sbrul gyi snying po'i dri des kyang 'jig rten gyi khams 'di khyab par byas so/ /de nas bu mo mya ngan med kyis byin pas tshe dang ldan pa mod gal gyi bu chen po la 'di skad ces smras so/ /btsun pa mod gal gyi bu chen po mkhas pa su zhig byang chub sems dpa' sems dpa' chen po dag gi cho 'phrul dang rnam par 'phrul pa bsam gyis mi khyab pa rmad du byung ba 'di lta bu dag mthong ngam thos nasanyan thos dman pa/ zhan pa/ zhum pa/ nyi tshepo)ba'i shes pa dang ldan pa rnams la ldang ba'am/ snar ci'agro ba 'am/ phyag 'tshal bar byed/btsun pa mod gal gyilobu chen po 'jig rten gyi khams spos kyi 'od de ji tsam du thag ring ba shes sam/ med gal gyi bus smras pa/ bu mo de ni mi shes so/ /bu mos smras pa/ btsun pa mod gal gyi bu chen po 'o rigal te khyod 'dra 3 tshoba'i rdzu 'phrul can sha stag gis stong gsum gyi 37stong chen po'iphama'ajig rten gyi khams 'di dper na bu ram shing gi tshal lam/ 'od ma'i tshal lamanyan/ 'dam bu'i tshal lam / 'bras sā 8lu'i zhing bzhin du mtshams med par gang bar gyur nas de dag thams cad kyis 8bskal par rtsis 7kyang 'jig rten gyi khams spos kyi 'od ces bya ba de sangs rgyas kyi zhing ji snyed cig 'das pa'i pha rol na 'dug pa bgrang ba'i thabs kyis rtogs par mi nus so/ /de nas bcom ldan 'das de 43—669

bzhin gshegs pa spos rab tu 'gyed pa'i 'od zer ①gyis 'od de dag mi snang bar mdzad de/ sangs rgyas kyi zhing de yang mi snang bar mdzad do/ /de nas tshe dang ldan pa 'od srung7chen pos bu mo mya ngan med kyis byin pa la 'di skad ces smras so/ /bu mo khyod kyis bcom ldan 'das de bzhin gshegs pa dgra bcom pa yang dag par rdzogs pa'i sangs rgyas shākya gethub pa de sngonasnyimathong ngam bu mos smras pa/ btsun pa 'od srung chen po de bzhin gshegs pa mthong bar nus sam / de bzhin gshegs pas/ gang dag nga la gzugs su mthong / /gang dag nga la sgrar shes pa/ /log pas spong bar7zhugs pa stetsho/ /skye bo de dag nga mi mthong / /sangs rgyas rnams ni chos nyid bltas/ /'dren pa rnams ni chos kyi 0sku/ /chos nyid shes par bya min pas/ /de0)ni rnam par shes misngo )nus/ /zhes 1tshem gsungs sam/ btsun pa 'od srung chen po gzhan yang bu mo khyod kyis bcom ldan 'das de bzhin gshegs pa dgra bcom pa yang dag par rdzogs pa'i sangs rgyas shākya0)thub pa de sngon nyunyemathong ngam zhes de skad zer ba ni btsun pa 'od srung chen po bdag gis de bzhin gshegs pa mthong mod kyi/ sha'i mig gis ma yin te gzugs su ma yin no/ /lha'i mig gis ma yin te tshor bar ma yin no//shes rab kyi mig gis ma yin te 'du shes sumatsham yin no/ /chos kyi mig gis ma yin te 'du byed du ma yin no/ /sangs rgyas kyi mig gisalgem yin te rnam par shes par ma yin no/ /btsun pa 'od srung chen po gzhan yang bdag gis de bzhin gshegs pa mthong ste/ dper na gnas brtan gyis ma rig pa dang srid pa la sred pa mthong ba bzhin no/ /btsun pa 'od srung chen po gzhan yang bdag gis de bzhin gshegs pa mthong ste/ dper na gnas brtan gyis ngar 'dzin pa 43—670

dang ske/ nga yir 'dzin pa mthong ba bzhin no/ /gnas brtan 'od srung chen pos smras pa/ bu mo 'di ltar ma rig pa dang / srid pa la sred pa dang / ngar 'dzin pa dang / nga yir 'dzin pa'i chos 'di gnyis ni med pa yin no/ /chos gang med pa de ni blta bar7mi nus so/ /bu mo mya ngan med kyis byin pas smras pa / btsun pa 'od srung chen po de de bzhin no/ /chos thams cad ni med pa yin te/ de dag ni blta bar mi nus so/ /'od sung chen pos smras pa/ bu mo cisasangs rgyas kyi chos kyang med dam/ bu mos smras pa/ gnas brtanashesangs rgyas kyi chos rnams sam so so'i skye bo'i chos rnams kyang rung ste/ chos 'ga' zhig yongs su grub par 'dod dam/ 'od srung chen pos smras pa/ bu mo kho boshogeni so so'i ⑤skye bo'i chos rnams la ⑥yang yongs su grub par mi 'dod na sangs rgyas kyi chos rnams lta la7ci smos/ bu mos smras pa/ btsun pa 'od srung chen po chos gang dag yongs su grub pa med pa'i chos de dag ci yod pa yin nam/'on te med pa yin/ 'od srung chen pos smras pa/ bu mo med pa de dag ni med pa yin noni/ /bu mos smras pa/ btsun pa 'od srung chen po de bas na chos thams cad ni med pa nyid do/ /med pa gang yin pa de dag la ni lta ba rnam par sbyang bar bya ba med do/ /btsun pa 'od srung chen po rigs kyi bu'am rigs kyi bu mo sangs rgyas la lta ba rnam par sbyang bar 'dod pas ni bdag la lta bsngo) rnam par sbyang tebar bya'o/ /'od srung chen pos smras pa/ bu mo bdag la lta ba ji ltar rnam par dag par 'gyur/ bu mos smras pa/ btsun pa 'od srung chen po gang girwa tshe bdag rang bzhin med pa'i phyir chos thams cad rang bzhin med pa nyid du mos na de tsam gyis namanyebadag la ltadza8ba rnam par dag par /tshoge'agyur ro/ /43—671

'od srung chen pos smras pa/ bu mo bdag gi rtsirang bzhin ci yin/ bu mos smras pa / btsun pa 'od srung chen po bdag gis rang bzhin ni stong pa nyid do/ /bdag gi rang bzhin med pa'i phyir bdag dben pa yang yin no/ /rang bzhin med pa des bdag dben no/ /rang bzhin med pa des chos thams cad dben rnal/ /'od srung chen pos smras pa/ bu mo khyod kyis su las chos thos na 'di ltar khyod kyi ④yang dag pa'i lta ba skyes par gyur/ bu mo yang dag pa'i lta ba skye bsnyel ni rgyu gnyis dang rkyen gnyis yod de/ gzhan gyi sgra dang bdag nyid kyi tshul bzhin yid la byed pa las 'byung ngo zhes de skad gsungs so/ /bu mos smras pa/btsun pa 'od srung chen po gang dag gzhan gyi dring mi me'ajog pa'i shes rab canaphude dag ni gzhan gyi sgra dang / bdag nyid kyi 33tshul bzhin du so sor rtogatso)pa las lta ba rnam par dgas3 ripar 'gyur ro/ /btsun pa 'od srung chen po gang dag gzhan gyi (1dring mi 'jog pa'i shes rab can dag ni gzhan gyi sgra mi tshol lo3)/ /btsun pa 'od srung chen po ji ltar na dge slong tshul bzhin du zhugs pa yin/'od srung chen pos smras pa/ bu mo gang gi tshe dge slong ji skad thos pa'i chos rnams kyi don la nye bar rtog par byed pa de ltar na dge slong tshul bzhin du zhugs pa yin no/ /'od srung chen pos smras pa/ bu mo ji ltar na byang chub sems dpa' tshul bzhin du zhugs pa yin/ bu mos smras pa/ btsun pa 'od sung chen po gang gi tshe 12byang chub sems dpa' sems can thams cad dang lhan cig gnas kyang sems can du 'du shes skyed 7par mi byed pa de ltar na byang chub sems dpa' tshul bzhin du zhugs pa yin no/ /btsun pa 'od srung chen po zhugs pa zhes bya ba ni chos thams cad ni sngon gyi mtha'i de bzhin nyid dang ldan 43—672

no / /chos thams cad ni phyi ma'i mtha'i de bzhin nyid dang ldan no/ /chos thams cad ni da ltar byung ba'i de bzhin nyid dang ldan no zhes btsun pa 'od srung chen po byang chub sems dpa' sbyor ba de lta bus sbyor bar mi byed na de tsam gyis na byang chub sems dpa' tshul bzhin du zhugs pa yin no/ /'od srung chen pos smras pa/ bu mo chos de dag la ji ltar sbyar bar bya/ bu mos smras pa/ btsun pa 'od srung7chen po ji ltar de bzhin nyid la sbyor ba yang med/ mi sbyor ba yang med par mthong ba de bzhin du chos thams cad la sbyarasribar bya'o/ /'od srung chen pos smras pa/ bu mo ji ltar mthong na chos thams cad mthong ba yin/ bumasadamos smras pa/ btsun pa 'od srung chen po chos thams cad la gnyis su med par mthong la mi byed cing 'jig par yang mi byed na de ltar na chos thams cad mthong ba yin no/ /btsun pa 'od srung chen po mthong ④zhes bya ba de ni mthong ba med pa'i tshig bla dgas5lde)so/ /'od srung chen pos smras pa/ bu mo bdag ji ltar blta rtsibar bya/ bu mos smras pa/ btsun pa 'od srung chen pos ji ltar mthong 0 ba bzhin du bltarababar bya'o/ /'od srung chen pos smras pa/ bu mo kho bos ni bdag dang bdag gi ma mthong ngo / /bu mos smras pa/ btsun pa 'od srung chen pos 3)ji ltar bdag med cing bdag gi med pa de bzhin du chos thams cad blta bar bya'o/ /rgetam de skad brjod pa'i skabs su gnas brtan rab 'byor gyis bu mo mya ngan med kyis byin pa la 'di skad ces smras so/ /bu mo khyod kyis nyu tshospobs pa 'di 'dra ba rnyed pa ni khyed thotekyis rnyed pa legs par rnyed do/ /bu mo mya ngan med kyis byin pas smras pa/ btsun pa rab 'byor rnyed kyi pa las ni spobs par mi 'gyur gyi gang gis ci yang ma rnyed pa de spobs pa dang ldan zhing gang gis7rtenang 43—673

ngam phyi rol ci yang mi dmigs pa de spobs pa dang ldan pa yin no/ /rab 'byor gyis smras pa/ bu mo gang ma rnyed na spobs pa dang ldan pa yin/ bu mos smras pa/gang gis bdag ma rnyed cing gzhan ma yin/ dge ba ma yin/ mi dge ba ma yin / kha na ma tho ba dang bcas pa ma yin/ kha na ma tho ba med pa ma yin/zag pa dang bcas pa ma yin/ zag pa med pa ma yin/ 'dus byas ma yin①/'dus ma byas ma yin/ 'jig rten pakum yin/ 'jig rten las 'das pa ma yin / kun nas nyon mongs pa ma yin/ rnam par byang ba ma yin te/ 'khor ba dang mya ngan las 'das pa ma rnyed la ①so so'i skye bo'i chos mi dmigs shing 'phags pa'i chos kyang mi dmigs te sangs rgyas kyi chos mi dmigs na/ btsun pa rab 'byor de ltar nasregang gis ci yang ma rnyed pasaspobs pa dang ldan pa yin no / /rab 'byor gyis smras pa/ ji ltar spobs par 'gyur/ bu mos smras pa/btsun pa rab 'byor gyis ji ltar chos thams cad ma rnyed rjopa de bzhin du de spobs par 'gyur ro/ /chos kyi de bzhin nyid gang gis gnas brtan nyon mongs pa med pa rnams kyi stimachog tu bstan pa'i chos kyi de bzhin nyid de ༷ci brjod cing smrar rung ngam/ nyon mongs pa med pa de dang chos kyi de bzhin nyid de la ci7spobs pa ci yang yod dam/ rab 'byor gyis smras pa/ nyon mongs pa med pa dang ske/ de bzhin nyid ni bstan pa'am brjod par mi nus so/ /bu mos smras pa/btsun pa rab 'byor chos thams cad ni brjod du med pa yin na khyod kyis bu mo khyod spobs pa 'di lta bu dang ldan pa ni khyod kyis rnyed pa legs par rnyed do zhes bya ba de ji lta bu yin/ rab 'byor gyis smras pa/ bu mo khyod ni 'di ltar med pa'i spobs pas ston to/ /bu mos smras pa/ gnas brtan rab 'byor chos 43—674

thams cad la brag ca7lta bur mos sam/ rab 'byor gyis smras pa/ bu mo mos so/ /bu mos smras pa/ gnas brtan rab 'byor ci brag cashel spobs pa ci yang yod dam/ rab 'byor gyis smras pa/ bu mo de ni med de/ bu mo rgyu dang rkyen tshogs pa las sgra 'byung bar zad do/ /bu mos smras pa/ btsun pa rab 'byor brten nas sgra 'byung ba gang yin pa de la ni5)rang bzhin gyis grub pa ci yang med rga/ /de ci'i phyir zhe na/ 'di ltar gang brten0nas 'byung ba de la ni skye ba ci yang med pa'i phyir ro/ /rab 'byor gyis smras pa/ bu mo chos thams cad ni brten nas 'byungakhuba'o/ /bu mos smras pa/ btsun⑧pa rab 'byor de bas na chos thams cad ni rang bzhin gyis ma skyes pa'o/ /rab 'byor gyis smras pa/ bu mo gal te chos thams cad rang bzhin gyis ma skyes pa yin na ⑨bcom ldan 'das kyis de bzhin gshegs pa gang gā'i klung byagi bye ma snyed ni 'das te gshegs so/ /de bzhin gshegs pa gang gā'i klung7gi bye ma snyed ni ma 'ongs pa na7'byung bar 'gyur ro/ /de bzhin gshegs pa gang gā'i klungatsog bye ma snyed ni da7ltar bzhugs so zhes ci'i phyir bstan/ bu mos smras pa/ btsun pa rab 'byor mi skye ba ni skye bar mi 'gyur ro/ /de ci'i phyir zhe na/ btsun pa rab 'byor chos kyi dbyings la ni skye ba'amanyenub par 'gyur ba mi 'dod pa'i phyir ro/ /rab 'byor gyis smras pa/ bu mo khyod ni 'di ltar skye ba med pa don dam pa'i tshig ston to/ /bu mos smras pa/ btsun pa rab 'byor bstan pa thams cad ni bstan tu med pa'o/ /ci'i〈nyephyir bstan pa thams cad bstan du med ce na/ de ni bstan kyang rung / ma bstan kyang rung〈nyedangos posri ma yin te/dngos po med pa dang brjod du med pa'i mtha' mi spong ba'i phyir ro/ /rab 43—675

'byor gyis smras pa/ bu mo khyod khyim na gnas bzhin du 'di lta bu'i chos la gnas shing 'di lta bu'i rnam pa dgatuston pa 'di ni ngo mtshar to/ /bu mos smras pa / btsun pa rab 'byor byang chub sems dpa' sems dpa' chen po la ni khyim pa'am / rab tu byung ba zhes gzungakhubar mi bya'o/ /de ci'i phyir zhe na/ de dag ni bsam pas phye ba yin/ shes rab kyis phye ba yin/ ye shes kyisashephye ba yin pa'i phyir ro/ /btsun pa rab 'byor byang chubashesems dpa'i gnas pa khyod kyis shes sam/ rab 'byor gyis smras pa/ bu mo khyod kyis shod cig dang kho bos mnyan7to/ /bu mos smras pa/ btsun pa rab 'byor byang chub sems dpa' sems dpa' chen po chos brgyad dang ldan na khyim pa 'am rab tu byung ba zhes mi bya ste/ spyod lam gang dang gangatswagis gnas kyang kha na ma tho ba med par 'gyur ro/ /brgyad gang zhe na/ 'di lta ste/ btsun pa rab 'byor 'di la byang chub sems dpa' sems dpa' chen po lhag pa'i bsam pa phun sum tshogs pa yin te/ lhag pa'i bsam pa de yang ༅bla na med pa yang dag par rdzogs pa'i byang chub kyi phyir ro/ /sems can thams cad yongs su mi gtongasnyibar gnas pa'i phyir byams pa la gnas pa yang yin no/ /'jig rten pa'i dga' ba dang spyod pa dang bral ba'i phyir snying rje chen po la gnas pa yang yin no/ /lus dang srog la mi lta ba'i phyirashebatang snyoms 1 )la gnas pa yang yin no/ /yongs su bsngo ba la mkhas pa shin tu rdzogs pa'i phyir thabs hu1la mkhas pa yang yin no/ /lta ba thams cad dang bral ba'i phyir shes rab kyi pha rol tu phyin pa las hunyenges par byungatshwanyeb yang yin no/ /dge ba'i rtsa ba tshol ba la brtson pas chog mi shes pa'i phyir brtson 'grus brtsams 39pa yang yin no/ /bzod pa shin tu thob pa'i 43—676

phyir ma bstan par7shes pa yang7yin te/ btsun pa rab 'byor byang chub sems dpa' sems dpa' chen po chos brgyad po de dag dang ldan na khyim pa'am rab tu byung ba zhes mi bya ste/ spyod lam gang dang / gang gis gnas kyang thams cad du kha na ma tho ba med par 'gyur ro/ /de nas tshe dang ldan pa sgra gcanashezin gyis bu mo mya ngan med kyis byin pa la 'di skad ces smras so/ /bu mo khyod ma la khri gser gyi rkang pa can la 'dug cing stan ④shin tu mtho ba la 'dug nas nyan thos chen po dag dang gtam zer ba de ni rung ba ma yin par ⑤gnas pa yin no/ /bu mo mi na bar stan mthon po la 'dug pa la stan dma' ba la 'dug pas chos bshad par mi bya'o zhes bya ba ci khyod kyis ma thos sam de skad ces smras pa dngashe/ bu mo mya ngan med kyis byin pas tshe dang ldan pa sgra gcan rin la 'di skad ces smras so/ /btsun pa sgra gcanashezin 'jig rten na gang dag ni rung ba yin/ 'jig rten na gang dag nitshwa) rung ba mtshwanyeyin pa khyod kyis shes sam/ sgra gcan phonyezin gyis smras pa/ bu mo kho bos shes te/ gang dag ji ltar bcas pa'i bslab pa la slob cing bslab pa de las 'gal bar mi byed pa de dag5nyeni rung ba zhes bya'o/ /gang dag bslab pa de las 'gal bar byed pa de dag ni rung ba ma yin pa zhes bya'o/ /bu mo mya ngan med kyis byin pas smras pa/btsun pa sgra gcanatswazin thong 8de skad ma zer cig /btsun pa sgra gcan zin gang dag ji ltar bcas pa'i bslab pa la slobasngo)pa de dag ni rung ba ma yin pa'o/ /de ci'i phyir zhe na/ 'di ltar de dag ni rtog cing rnam par rtog pa'i phyir ro/ /btsun pa sgra gcanatshwanyezin gang dag mi rtog cing rnam par mi rtog pa de dag ni rung ba zhes bya'o/ /btsun pa sgra gcan hu)zin rung ba zhes bya ba 'di ni dge slong dgram ste 43—677

bcom pa zag pa zad pa rnams kyi tshig bla dgas7yin te/ de dag niphubaslab pa las 'gal bar7mi byed do/ /de ci'i phyir zhe na/ bcom ldan 'das kyi nyan thos rnams ni bslab ④pa las yang dag par 'das pa'i phyir te/ de dgatuni phyir yang bslab pa 'dod pa ma yin pas de57ni rung bsheyin no/ /de dag ni khams gsum du phyir mi 'ong ba yin⑨/ de dag ni bslab pa las yang dag par 'das pa yin te/ mi slob pa zhes bya'o/ /de ltar na de dag gi bslab pa nirwatemi dmigs te(nya/ khams gsum pa btags〈nyepa tsam du shes so/ /de'i phyir de dag ni7rung ba zhes bya'o/ /sgra gcan zin gyis smras pa/ bu mo rung ba dang / rung ba ma yin pa la tha dad du dbye ba ci zhig yod/ bu mos smras pa/btsun pa sgra gcanatsozin 'di lta ste dper na gser dngul tu)rgyan du byas pa dang /rgyan du ma byas pa larwanyetha dad du dbye ba ci7yod/ sgra gcan zin gyis smras pa/bu mo tha dad du dbye ba ci yang med do/ /bu mos smras pa/ btsun pa sgra gcan lhazin de bzhin du rung ba dang / rung ba5)ma yin pa la yang yi ge'i tha snyad mnyam pa nyid kyi phyir tha da da du dbye ba ci yang med do/ /de ci'i phyir zhe na/chos thams cad ni ci dang yang bral ba'i phyir te/ rang bzhin gyis kun nas nyon mongs pa can ma yin no/ /btsun pa sgra gcan nyezin yang 'di skad du stan shin tu mtho༄steb la 'dug ste rdunyechos nyan tam zhes (stozer ba la byang chub sems dpa' ni rtswa bting5)ba la 'dug kyang shin tu mtho ba la 'dug pa yin no/ /sgra gcan5)zin gyis smras pa/ rnam grangs gang gis khyod de skad smra/ bu mos smras pa / btsun pa sgra gcan5) zin 'di ji snyam du sems/ byang chub sems dpa'༄nyegang la 'dug ste5)byang chub thob par gyur(3/ sgra gcan sterin gyis smras pa/43—678

rtswa bting ba la bzhugs nas byang chub thob bo/ /bu mos smras pa/ btsun pa sgra gcanatuzin ci byang chub sems dpa' 〈khubating ba la 'dug pa la stong gsum gyi stong chen po'i 'jig rten gyi khams na tshangs pa'am/ brgya byin nam/'jig rten skyong ngam/ de las gzhan pa 'og min man chad kyi lha gang yin pa de dag thams cad kyis lus btud de ①thal mo sbyar nas byang chub sems dpa'i zhabs la gtug par byed dam/ sgra gcanasazin gyis smras pa/ bu mo de de bzhin te/ khyod kyis ji skad smras pa bzhin no/ /bu mos smras pa/ btsun7pa sgra gcan zin de'i phyir rnam grangs des kyang dper na byang chub sems dpa' sems dpa' chen po rtswasabating ba la 'dug kyang stan shin tu mtho bshel 'dug pa yin gyi/ nyan thos tshangs pa'i 'jig rten na ⑩'dug pa ni de lta ma yin par rig par bya'o/ /de nas rgyal po ma skyes dgras bu mo mya ngan med kyis byin pa la 'di skad ces smras so/ /bu mo btsun pa sgra gcanatshwa)zin7ni bcom ldan 'das shākya tunyethub pa de nyid kyi 8sras yin te/ bslab pa 'dod pa rnams kyi mchog yin na ci khyod kyis mi shes sam/ bu mo mya ngan med kyis byin pas smras pa/yab thong shig thong shigatso /'di ltar btsun pa sgra gcan tsozin bcom ldan 'das shākya thub pa de'i sras yin zhes ma gsung5)shig /ri dgas77kyi rgyal po seng ge ral pa can cod5 nyepan btags rdunyepa lta bus nye/ bu wa skyed par gyur patshwastenam yang gsan tam/ gzigs sam/ rgyal pos smras pa/ bu mo de ni ma yin no / /bu mos smras pa/ yab de bzhin du de bzhin gshegs pa seng ge'i rtsal lta bus gshegs pa dam pa'i chos kyi 'khor los sgyur ba'i zhabs 'bring ba ni nyan thos mdzes pa ma lags so/ /yab de bzhin gshegs pa'i sras gang yin zhes 43—679

yang dag pa'i smra bas gang smra na byang chub sems dpa' nyid yin no zhes de7dag yang dag pa'i smra bas smra'o/ /yab de lta bas na de bzhin gshegs pa'i sras su khas len par 'tshal bas ni bla na med pa yang dag par rdzogs pa'i byang chub tu sems bskyed par bgyi'o/ /gtam 'di brjod pa'i skabs su rgyal po ma skyes dgra'i⑧btsun mo'i 'khor nas btsun mo nyi shus bla na med pa yang dag par rdzogs pa'i byang chub tu sems bskyed do/ /lha'i bu brgyasatham pas kyang bu mo de'i seng ge'i sgra 'di thos nas bla na med pa yang dag par rdzogs pa'i byang chub tu sems bskyed de getshig 'di skad du bdag cag ⑥'di rnams 'das pa dang /ma byon pa dang / da ltar byung ba'i sangs rgyas bcom ldan 'das rnamasashekyi sras su khas len to zhes kyang smras so/ /lha'i bu de dag gis 'di ltar bu mo mya ngan med kyis byin pa la mchod pa bya ba'i〈phyir rgyal po'i khabashekyi grong khyer chen po thams cad lha'i me tog dgatshwakye gis mngon par gtor to/ /de nas bu mo mya ngan med kyis byin pasgo/nyekhri gser gyi rkang pa can las babs te5)nyan thos chen po de dag gi rkang pa la mgo bos phyag 'tshal nas bza' ba dang / bca' ba dang /bldag pa dang / gzhib 8pa dang / myang bar bya ba bsod 8pa mang po dag gis bkur ste7byas te/ dad pa dang gus pas rang gi lag nas nyan thos chen po de dag tshim par byas nas 'di skad du btsun pa dag rang hunyedagar slad dro༄nyebacom ldan 'das la chos nyan du bzhud cig /btsun pa dag bdag kyang mchimanyebar 'tshal lo zhes kyang smras so/ /de nas bu mo mya ngan med kyis byin pa pha ma (shel sogs pa zhu )'khor mang po dang / skye bo phal po ches yongs su bskor nas bcom ldan 'das ga la ba der song ste phyin nas bcom ldan 'das kyi zhabs la mgo bos 43—680

phyag 'tshal te phyogs gcig tu 'khod do①/ /rgyal po btsun mo'ikhu'akhor dang bcas pas kyang bcom ldan 'das kyi7zhabs la mgo bos phyag 'tshal nas gnangasaste phyogs gcig tu 'khod do / /nyan thos chen po de dag kyang bcom ldan 'das kyi thad du dong ste bcom ldan 'das kyi zhabs la mgo bos phyag 'tshal nas phyogs gcig tu 'khod do/ /de nas bcom ldan 'das la tshe dang ldan pa shā ri'i bus 'di skad ces gsol to/ /bcom ldan 'das bu mo mya ngan med kyis byin pa'i spobs pa ni ngo mtshar lagasasreso/ /bcom ldan 'das kyis bka' stsal pa/shā ri'i bu ⑦bu mo 'dis ni thog ma nyid du byang chub don du gnyer ba na sangs rgyas bye ba khrag khrig phragashedagu bcu rtsa gnyis la dge ba'i rtsa ba dag bskyed do/ /shā ri'i bus gsol pa/ bcom ldan 'das ci'i slad du bu mo 'dis budatshwa )med kyi〈nyelus ma bsgyurahunye/ bcom ldan 'das kyis bka' stsal pa/ shā ri'i bu hunye'adi ji snyam du sems/ bu mo mya ngan med kyis byin pa la bud med do snyam du sems na de ltar mi blta'o/ /byang chub sems dpa' dag ni sems can yongs su smin par bya ba'i phyir smon lam gyisashebadag nyid bud med kyi gzugs su ston to//de nas de'i tshe bu mo mya ngan med kyis byin pas bden pa'i byin gyis brlabs 39byas te/ bden pa'i byin gyi rlabasatshwa snagang gis chos thams cad skyes pa yang ma yin / bud med kyang ma yin pa lta na bden pa dang bden pa'i tshig des bdag skyes pa'i lus su gyur cig /thams cad dang ldan pa'i 'khor 'dis kyang mthong bar gyur cig /tshig de skad ces smras ma thag tu bud med kyi mtshan ma hunyemi snang bar gyur te/ skyes pa'i mtshan ma byung bar gyur 3)nas steng gi bar snang la ta la bdun srid tsam du 'phags so/ /de nas du — ༷bcom ldan 'das kyis tshe dang ldan 43—681

pa shā ri'i bu la bka' stsal pa/ shā ri'i bu byang chub sems dpa' sems dpa' chen po mya ngan med kyis byin pa steng gi bar snang la 'phags pa khyod kyis mthong ngam / shā ri'i bus gsol pa/ bcom ldan 'das mthong lags7so/ /bcom ldan 'das kyis bka' stsal pa/ /shā ri'i bu byang chub sems dpa' sems dpa' chen po mya ngan med kyis byin pa 'di ni bskal pa grangs med pa bdun gyiku'ajig rten gyi khams dri ma med pa'i 'od ces bya bar7de bzhin gshegs pa dgra bcom pa yang dag par rdzogs pa'i sangs rgyas mya ngan med pa zhes bya bar 'gyur te/tshe'i tshad ni bskal pa brgyaraba'agyur ro/ /dam pa'i chos ni bskal pa bcur gnas par 'gyur ro/ /de'i dge 'dun ni byang chub sems dpa' 'ba' zhigashetu 'gyur te/ phyir mi ldog pa'i byang chub sems dpa' sems dpa' chen po bye ba phrag sum cu7rtsa gnyis yod do/ /'jig rten gyi khams de yang be+e drur+ya7las grub pa rin po che sna bdun gyis bkra bar byas shing mig mangs ris5nyesu bris la rin po che'i pad+mas khebasalgepa dang / ngan song thams cad rnam par spangs par 'gyur ro/ /lha dang mi rnams kyi longs spyod dag hunyekyang khyad par med de8/ shā ri'i bu dga' ldanasnyigyi lha rnams kyi nye bar spyad pa dang / longs spyod ji lta ba bzhin du mi rnams kyi yang der de bzhin du 'gyur ro/ /de nas byang chub sems dpa' mya ngan med kyis byin7pa'i ma rgyal po ma skyes dgra'i btsun mo dam pa zla ba can zhes bya ba des thal mo sbyar ba btud nas bcom ldan 'das la 'di skad ces gsol to/ /bcom ldan 'das bdag gis skyes bu dam pa 'di dgung zla dgur rum na bzung ba ni bdag gis〈rnyed pa legs par rnyed lags so/ /bcom ldan 'das bdag gis kyang bla na med pa yang dag par rdzogs pa'i byang chub tu 43—682

sems bskyed par bgyi ste/ dge ba'i rtsa ba 'dis bdag 'jig rten gyi khams dri ma med pa'i 'od de nyid du 'di'i 'og tu bla na med pa yang dag par7rdzogs pa'i byang chubashemangon par rdzogs par 'tshang rgya bar gyur cig /de nas bcom ldan 'das kyis tshe dang ldan pa shā ri'i bu la bka' stsal pa/ shā ri'i bu btsun⑧me zla ba can 'disakhyod kyis mthong ngam/ shā ri'i bus gsol pa/ bcom ldan 'das mthong lags so/ /bcom ldan 'das kyis bka' stsal pa/ shā ri'i bu rgyal po'i⑧btsun mo zla ba can 'di ni 'di nas shi 'phos nas sum cu rtsa gsum pa'i lha rnams dang skal ba mnyam ⑧par skye bar 'gyur zhing lha'i bu rin chen mchog ces bya bar 'gyur te/ gang gi tshe byang chub sems dpa' byams pas byang chub thob par gyur pa7de'i tshe rgyal po dung zhes bya ba de'i bu rgyal po gzhon nu mthong na dga' ba zhes bya bar gyur nas de bzhin gshegs pa byams pa (7la mchod pa byas te rab tu 'byung bar 'gyur ro/ /des de bzhin gshegs pa byams pa'i dam pa'i chos thog ma dang / bar〈hedang / tha ma'i bar du 'dzin par 'gyur te/ bskal pa bzang po 'di la sangs rgyas bcom ldan 'das gang dag 'byung bar 'gyur bsnyide dag thams cad kyang mnyes par byed cing mchod par 'gyur ro/ /de mthar gyis de bzhin gshegs pa mya ngan med pas byang chub thob pa na 'khor los sgyur5nyeba'i rgyal po mu khyud 'dzin ces bya bar 'gyur te/des de bzhin gshegs pa de la mchod pa tshad med patsha/nyedag byas nas sangs rgyas kyi zhing de lta bu de (7nyid du bla na med pa yang dag par rdzogs pa'i byang chub mngon par rdzogs par 'tshang rgya bar 'gyur te/ de bzhin gshegs pa kun tu 'od zer zhes bya bar 'gyur ro/ /de nas rgyal po'i btsun mo zla ba can gyis5 ) 43—683

bdag nyid lung bstan pa thos nas tshim zhing mgunyeste yisherangs nas bcom ldan 'das la mu tig gi do shalashebargya stong ri ba phul tetswatshangs par spyod par rgyal pos gnang nas bslab pa'i gzhi dag bzung ngo / /de nas byang chub sems dpa' sems dpa' chen po mya ngan med kyis byin pas lhas phul ba'i me tog man 'o⑧ra ba dag gis bcom ldan 'das dang 'khor thams cad la gtor to/ /de nas bar snang las babs te 0phyogs gcig tu 'dug nas tshig ⑩'di skad du bden pa dang bden pa'i tshig gang gis7bdag gi〈nyebyang chub thob pa na5)byang chub sems dpa' sems dpa' chen po de dag thams cad rdzus7te skye zhing7chos gos ngur smrig gyon la rin po che'i pad+ma dag la skyil mo krunganyebacas te skye bar 'gyur ba lta na/ bden pa dang bden pa'i tshig des dper na dge slong bsnyen par rdzogs nas lo brgyad ()lon pa'i spyod lam ji lta ba bzhin du bdag gnas par gyur cig ces smras so/ /byang chub sems dpa' sems dpa' chen po mya ngan med kyis byin pas bden pa'i byin gyi brlabasamanye byas ma thag tu dge slong gi spyod lam dang ldan par snang bar gyur nyeto/ /de nas byang chub sems dpa' sems dpa' chen po mya ngan med kyis byin pas pha rgyal po ma skyes dgra la 'di skad ces smras so/ /yab 'di ltar chos thams cad ni bcos ma ste rnam par bsgrubs pas nye bar gnas5 nyepa'i mtshan nyid dang / yongs su brtags pa las langs pa med bzhin du phyin ci log dang mtshungs par ldan pa lags so/ /rgyal po chen po gzigs shig dang de ring kho na'i gdugs gcig la bu mo'i gzugs su yang gzigs khye'u'i5nyegazugs su yang khyod kyis gzigs/ da nyeni bdag la dge slong gi gzugs su yang khyod kyis gzigs na 'di la gang yang dag pa'i gzugs 43—684
