༄ga /'phags pa dri ma med kyis byin pas zhus pa zhes bya ba theg pa chen po'i mdo/sti༄zag / zo'aphags pa dkon mchog brtsegs pa chen po'i⑧cos kyi rnam grangs le'u stong phrag brgya pa las le'u7sum cubartsa gsum pa ste 'phags pa dri ma med kyis byin pas zhus pa lung bstan pa/ bam po dang po/maphyi rgya gar skad du/ ār+ya bi ma la data ta pa ri thra yinā ma ma hā yā na sru ③tra/ bod skad du/'phags pa dri ma med kyis byin pas zhus pa zhes bya ba theg pa chen po'i mdol/ ldasangs rgyas dang byang chub sems dpa' thams cad la phyag 'tshal lo/ /'di skad bdag gis thos pa dus gcig na/ bcom ldan 'das mnyan yod na rgyal bu rgyalamo/spebyed kyi tshal7mgon med zas sbyin gyi kun dga' ra ba na/ dge slong stong nyis tsobargya lnga bcu'i dge slong gi dge 'dun chen po tsodang thabs ciganyetu bzhugs te/ thams cad kyang dgra bcom pa/ zag pa zad pa/ nyon mongs pa med pa/ dbang dang ldan par gyur pa/ sems shin tu rnam par grol ba/43—697

shes rab shin tu rnam par grol ba/ cang shes pa/ glang po chen po/ bya ba byas pa/ byed pa byas pa/ khur bor ba/ bdag gi7don rjes su thob pa/srid par kun tu sbyor ba yongs su zad pa/ yang dag pa'i shes pas sems shin tu rnam par grol ba/ sems kyi dbang thams cad kyi dam pa'i pha rol tu son pa sha stag ste/ gang zag gcig⑧ma gtogs pa ni 'di lta ste/ tshe dang ldan pa kun dga' bo'o/ /byang chub sems dpa' stong phrag bcu phal cher thams cad kyang duphyir mi ldog pa/ skye ba gcig gis thogs pa sha stag la 'di lta ste/ byang chub sems dpa' rin chen 'od dang / byang chub sems dpa' shes rab brtsegs dang / byang chub sems dpa' dpal gyi snying po dang / byang chub sems dpa' grags pa'i blo gros dang / spobs gepa brtsegs dang / spyan ras gzigs dbang phyug dang / mthu chen thob dang / byams pa dang / mya ngan med kyis byin dang / 'jam dpal gzhon nur gyur pa dang / gom pa 'dorasheb don yod dang / mthong ba don yod dang / ngan song spong dang / mya ngan⑧gyi mun pa7thams cad 'joms pa dang / yon tan rin po che'i me tog gis rtag tu brgyan dang / gser gyi phreng hunyeba'i 'od kyishedapal can dang / sgrib pa thams cad rnam par sel ba dang / byang chub sems dpa' sems thogasake/pa med pa dngahū/ de dag la sogasalgepa byang chub sems dpa' khri dang yang thabs cig go/ /de nas tshe dang ldan pa shātswari'i bu dang / tshe dang ldan pa mod gal gyi bu chen po dang / tshe dang ldan pa byams ma'i〈nyebu gang po dang / tshe dang ldan pa 'od srungalochen po dang / tshe dang ldan pa rab 'byor dang / tshe dang ldan pa nam gru dang / tshe dang ldan pa ma 'gags5 ༷ pa dang / tshe dang ldan pa kun 43—698

dga' bo dang / nyan thos chen po brgyad po de dag dang / byang chub sems dpa' 'jam dpal dang / byang chub sems dpa' ngan song spong dang / rin po che'i togatudang / mthong ba don yod dang / sgrib pa thams cad rnam par sel ba dang / 'phags pa spyan rasakhugazigs dbang phyug dang / spobs pa brtsegs ③dang / byang chub sems dpa' gom pa 'dor ba don yod dang /byang chub sems dpa' sems dpa' chen po brgyad po de dag snga dro'i dus kyi tshe sham thabs dang chos gos bgos nas lhung bzedakyithogs te/ bsod snyoms kyi phyir grong khyer chen po mnyan yod du zhugs nasal/ de dag lam gyi bar skabs su gtam 'di skad ces/ gang gis grong khyer du skye ⑧bo'i tshogs thams cad kyis 'phags pa'i bden pa'i gtam thos par 'gyur ba rnam pa de lta bu'i ting nge 'dzin la snyoms par zhugs te grong khyer du 'jug par bya'o zhes brjod7par gyur tokyi / /tshe dang ldan pa shā ri'i bus smras pa/ gang gis grong khyer du 'phags pa'i bden pa rnams la()skye bo'i tshogs thams cad kyi shes rab thogs pa med de/de dag gi shes rab la mun pa mun nag med par 'gyur ba rnam pa de lta bu'i (gyeting nge 'dzin la/ kho bo snyoms par zhugs te grong khyer du 'jug par bya'o/ /tshe dang ldan pa med gal gyi bu chen pos smras pa/ gang gis grong khyer du skye bo'i〈nyetshogs thams cad la bdud kyi las rnams 'byung bar mi 'gyur ba rnam pa de lta bu'i ting ngesa'adzin la kho bo snyoms par zhugs te⑩grong khyer du 'jug par bya'o//tshe dang ldan pa byams ma'i bu gang pos smras pa/ ci nas kyang gzhan mu stegs can spyod pa pa dang / kun tu rgyu ba dang / gcer bu pa dang / 'tsho ba pa dang / bram ze dang / khyim bdag gang dag grong khyer na 'khod pa de dag sdig 43—699

pa can gyi lta ba dang ldan par mi 'gyur ba rnam pa de lta bu'i ting nge 'dzin la kho bo snyoms par zhugs te7grong khyer du 'jug par bya'o/ /tshe dang ldan pa 'od srung lachen pos smras pa/ ci nas kyang grong khyer na skyes pa dang / budashemed dang ske/ khye'u dang / bu mo gang dag bdag cag⑧la bsod snyoms sbyin par byed pa 'khod pa de dag thams cad yongs su mya ngan las 'das pa la thug gi bar du longs spyod zad mi shes pa rnyed5nyepar 'gyur ba rnam pa57de lta bu'i ting nge 'dzin la kho bo snyoms par zhugs te grong khyer du 'jug par bya'o/ /tshe dang ldan pa rab 'byor gyis smras pa/ gang gis grong khyer du skye bo'i tshogs thams cad nyon mongs pa med pa ⑦thob par 'gyur ba rnam pa⑥de lta bu'i ting nge 'dzin la kho bo snyoms par zhugs te grong khyer du 'jug par bya'o/ /tshe dang ldan pa ⑨nam grus smras pa / gang gis grong khyer du skye bo'i tshogs thams cad kyis ting nge 'dzin thob par 'gyur ba rnam pa de lta bu'i ting nge 'dzin la kho bo snyoms par zhugs te grong khyer du 'jug par bya'o/ /tshe dang ldan pa ma 'gags pas smras pa/ gang gis grong khyer du skye bo'i tshogs thams cad nad med pa'i bde ba thob par 'gyur ba rnam pa de lta bu'i ting nge 'dzin la kho bo snyoms par zhugs te grong khyer du 'jug par bya'o / /tshe dang ldan pa kun dga' bos smras pa/ gang gis grong khyer du skye bo'i tshogs thams cad la sngon ma thos pa'i chos rnams mngon du 'gyur ba rnam pa de lta bu'i ting nge 'dzin la kho bo snyoms par zhugs te grong khyer du 'jug par bya'o/ /'jam dpal gzhon nur gyur pas smras pa/ ci nas kyang gang gis grong khyer na sgo dang / skar khung dang / rtsig pa dang / snod 31dang / rgyan dang / shing dang —/ lo ma dang / me tog dang / 'bras bu dang / gosarwahernams las stong 43—700

pa nyid kyi sgra 'byung bar 'gyur ba dang / mtshan ma med pa'i sgra dang / smon pa med pa'i sgra dang / skye ba med pa'i sgra dang / dngos po med pa'i sgra dang /bdag med pa'i sgra 'byung bar 'gyur ba rnam pa de lta bu'i bsam pa kho bos bsam par bya'o/ /byang chub sems dpa' ngan song spong gis smras pa/ gang gis grong khyer na sems can rnams kyi las ngan song myong bar 'gyur ba gang yod pa de0)tshe 'di nyid la yang zhing chung ngu myong bar 'gyur ba rnam pa de lta bu'i bsam pa kho bos bsam par bya'o/ /byang chub sems dpa' mthong ba don yod kyis smras pa/ci nas kyang grong khyer na sems can gang dag kho bo'i mig lam na snang bar 'gyur ba de dag thams cad kyis de bzhin gshegs pa'i gzugs mthong bar 'gyur ba rnam pa de lta bu'i bsam pa kho bos bsam par bya'o/ /byang chub sems dpa'aphurin po che'i gtog gis smras pa/ gang gis ④grong khyer na khyim thams cad du rin po ches gang ba'i gter rnams 'byung bar 'gyur ba rnam pa (dede lta bu'i bsam pa kho bos bsam par bya'o/ /byang chub sems dpa' sgrib pa thams cad rnam par sel bas smras pa/ gang gis mnyan yod kyi grong khyer chen por skye bo'i tshogs thams cad kyi sgrib pa lnga po dag rnam par sel bar 'gyur ba rnam pa de lta bu'i bsam pa kho bos bsam par bya'o/ /byang chub sems dpa' spyan ras gzigs dbang phyug gis smras pa/ ci nas kyang grong khyer na sems can gang dgalabacings pa dang / gsad ⑦par bkri ⑧ba de dag thams cad she)thar pa dang 'jigs pas nyen pa rnams kyang 'jigarware pa med pa thob par 'gyur ba rnam pa de lta bu'i bsam pa kho bos bsam par bya'o/ /byang chub sems dpa' spobs pa brtsegs kyis smras pa/ gang gis grong khyer na skye bo'i tshogs thams cad phan tshun 43—701

du tshigs su bcad pa'i dbyangs dang / byams pa'i sems kyis smra bar 'gyur ba dang ske/ spobs pa yang thob par 'gyur ba rnam pa7de lta bu'i bsamashepa kho bos bsam par bya'o/ /byang chub sems dpa' gom pa 'dor ba don yod kyis smras pa/ ci nas kyang grong khyer nashesems can gang dag kho bo'i mig lam na snang bar 'gyur ba de dag thams cad bla na med pa yang dag par rdzogs pa'i byang chub las phyir mi ldog par 'gyur ba rnam pa de lta bu'i bsam pa kho bos bsam par bya'o / /de nas nyan thos chen po de dag dang / byang chub sems dpa' de dag rnam pa de lta bu'i gtam 'di brjod cing mnyan0yod kyi grong khyer chen por phyin to/ /yang de'i tshe yul ko sa la'i rgyal po gsal rgyal gyi bu mo dri ma med kyis byin pa zhes bya ba sngon gyi rgyal ba la lhag par bya ba byas pa/ dge ba'i rtsa ba bskyed pa/sangs rgyas mang po la bsnyen0bkur byas pa/ chos zab mo la bzod pa dang ldan pa/ mngon par shes pa lnga pokyithob pa zhig yod de bu mo des lha'i mig rnam par9)dag pa mi'i las 'das pas byang chub sems dpa' de dag dang / nyan thos chen ponyede dag mthong zhing de dag lam gyi bar7skabs su gtam ci brjod pa de dag thams cad kyang thos so/ /bu mo de yang gzugs bzang ba(spre/mdzes pa9nye blta na sdug pa/ kha dog bzang po rgyas pa mchog dang ldan pa/pha ma dang nang mi la byams pa/ btsas nas lo bcu gnyis lon pa ste/ de dpyid zla tha chungs 8tshes brgyad skar hunyem rgyal gyi nyin par pha mas dge mtshan dang ske/ bkra shis byedamo du gnang nas bram ze zho dang / rtswa ku sha dang / me tog dang / yam sreg7shing dang / mar dang / bum pa thogs pa lnga brgyas yongs su bskor 7te khrus bya bar spre 7khrid pa las 4)bram ze de dag gis byang chub 43—702

sems dpa' de dag dang nyan thos chen po de dgatumathong ngo / /mthong nas kyang bkra mi shis so snyam pa'i 'du shes kyis gnas par gyur to/ /de nas bram ze de dag gi nang nas bram ze ches bgres7tshangs pa'i lha zhes bya ba des bu mo7dri ma med kyis byin pa la 'di skad ces smras so/ /bu mo dge slong dag mdun na 'khod pa ni bkra mi shis te/ de dag mthong na dgos pa'am/ nor ram/brtul zhugs sam/ mchod sbyin nam/ bkra shis kyang rung ste mi 'grub kyisasnyigrong khyer du slar bzhud do/ /de nas bu mo dri ma med kyis byin pas bram ze tshangs pa'i lha de la tshigs su bcad de smras pa/ 'di dag chags med mchog tu dge shis pa/ /skye bo mang po'i sdig pa 'jig par byed/ /'di dag rnam par dag cing bden bzhi mthong / /dul la grol ⑦bar gyur cing mnyam par bzhagani /'di dag rkang gnyis dam pa bsod nams zhing / /'di la yon phul mtho ris 'gro bar 'gyur/ /'di la yon phul 'bras bu 'chi med 'thob/ /byin nas sems can ngan 'gror 'gro mi 'gyur/ /tshul khrims dang ni dul bar ldan pa yin / /'dod las rgal cing sdig med re ba med/ /'di dag sman pa mchog ste 'jig rten rgyu/ /sdug bsngal gzir〈nye ba'i srog chags thar bar byed/ /sangs rgyas 'jig rten dag na chos kyi rje/ / de sras 'dinyedag rdul7med nyon mongs med/ /'di dgatshwanyebyang chub sems dpa' gzhan yang mangs/ /shes rab ldan mis 'di dag ji ltar spang / /'di dag brtul zhugs spyad cing 'dod chags zhi/ /bkra shis gyur cing mkhas pa7sbyin char phabatso/ /'di dag rnams la bkur sti chung byas kyang / /mi rnams chos dang de bzhin nor yang 'grub/ /'di dag mtshan rnams yongs rdzogs dge shis〈nyeldan/ /'di dag zhing mchog 43—703

rnam dag sems dang ldan/ /bram ze 'di la su zhig dad byed pa/ /de ni bsod nams nyu)mang po skyedane par 'gyur/ /①de nas bram ze tshangs pa'i lhas bu mo dri ma med kyis byin pa la tshigs su bcad de slar smras pa/ byis pa'i sems kyisalgedabang du ma bzhud cigazhuge /mchod sbyin dus 'dir dge slong ma gzigs shig⑥ /ngur smrigasamagos can de bzhin mgo bregs shepa/ /de dag don 'dod pas ni blta sku'o)mi bgyi0/ /yab dang yum yang dgyes par mi 'gyur zhing / /bdag kyang mkhas pa rnams kyis smad par 'gyur/ /khyod kyang mchod sbyin 'grub par mi 'gyur gyis(te/ /de bas dge slong rnams ni shin tu spongs/ /de nas bu mo dri ma med kyis byin pas bram ze tshangs pa'i lha de la tshigs su bcad de slar〈nyesmras pa/yon tan ldan pa 'di dag ma gtogs hunyepar/ /pha dang ma yang kho mo'i skyabs ma yin / /gnyen gyi tshogs dang nor dang lang tsho min/ /'di dag 'khor bar bying mib rnams kyisngogeskyabs/ /bdag ni sangs rgyas dga' bas lus7btang zhing ske/ /de bzhin srog dang longs spyod rnams kyang btang / /dkon mchog gsum nyid skyabs yin ma gtogs5nyepar/ /kho mo'i skyabs rten sems can 'di na med/ /de nas bram ze tshangs pa'i lhas bu mo dri ma medatshwanyekyis byin pa la5ce'adi skad ces smras so/ /bu mo btsas nas khyod kyis sngon sangs rgyas kyang ma gzigs / sngon chos kyang ma gsan( )/ sngon dge 'dun la bsnyen bkur kyang tem mdzad na khyod ci'i slad du sangs rgyas la dad par gyur(nya/ /bu mo dri ma med kyis byin pas smras pa/ bram ze kho mo btsas nas zhag bdun lon pa na tsan dan gyi khang bzangs kyi rdunyenang na gser gyi khri la bzhag pa'i tshe lha'i bu lnga brgya stengarmā gi bar snang la 'dong ba kho mos mthong ste/ de dag rnam grangs du mas sangs rgyas 43—704

kyi bsngags pa rjod①/ chos dang dge 'dun gyi bsngags pa rjod7pa kho mos thos so / /de nas lha'i bu de dag gi nang nas gang gis sngonas de bzhin gshegs pa mthong ba gcig po de la lha'i bu rnams kyis dris ④pa/ grogs po de bzhin gshegs pa ni ci 'dra geb zhig de ni ji ltar shes par bya/ de nas lha'i bu des kho mo'i bsam pa shes nas lha'i bu de dag kyang dad pa bskyed pa'i phyir tshigs su bcad pa 'di dag smras so/ / de yir+sā)dbu skra dri med snum zhing mdzes/ /gtsang 'jam g.yas su 'khyil pa'i lcang lo can/ /zhal mdog pad ma 'dab ma rgyas pa 'dra/ /zla nya mtshan mo nam mkhar mdzes pa bzhin/ / de yi dumadzod spu kha ba shel mdog bzang / / smin mtshams bar nas 'khyil cing shin tu mdzes/ /de yis 'khor rnams zil gyis mnan te 'dug /rgyal ba'i zhal yang hunyashin tu mdzes par byed/ /mi dbang spyan mdzes 'gram pa tsha/geseng ge'i 3nye'adra/ /sems stobs mi zhum tshems mnyam ④thags kyang bzang / / bo de yi 8ljags che zhal gyi dkyil 'khor khebs/ /de yis7zhal ni dri med rnam par mdzes/ / de yisngo tshogasung ni phan zhing snyan la ran(she/ /tshig rtsub spangs7)shing mi 'byed sdig pa med / /skye bo nyedapag tu med pa dang mdzad cing / /'gro la phan phyir rgyal ba'i py-i megasung yang sgrogs/ / de yi mgur zhu ni dung dang mtshungs shing 'dra/ /de bzhin mi dbang phyag (nyegi sor mo ring / / de yi 2nyephyag ni glang chen sna dang 'dra/ /brang nigeyangs dri med lte ba gzhol 29zhing zab/ /rta mchog lta bur mdoms du 7kyi sba 3sheb nub/ /de bzhin spu yi khung 36bu gser dang 'dra/ / brla yi5 )dbyibs ni glang po'i lag dang mtshungs/ /zhabs ni legs gnas byin pa e na'i01'dra/ /thub pa'i dbang po bden gsung0 rgyags pa'i skyon dang bral/ /ngan ltas bcom 43—705

pa rnams kyinyesdig pa'i lta ba 'jig /'khor gyi nang du dri ba bye ba dris7byas kyang | /'khrul med skyon dang bral bas sems can kun tshim mdzad/ /gya gyushemed drangasatshig gis lus ni tshim mdzad cing / /mya ngan 'das pa bde mchog yid 'ong yang dag zhi/ /skye bo kun gyi yid 'ong mya ngan 'das ston cing / /mtha' gnyis dag dang bral ba'i dbu ma'i lam yang ston/ /de ni rang gis sangs rgyas gyur pa ste/ /bdag nyid rgal cing pha rol rnams kyang sgrol/ /'gro ba'i skyobasnyedang skyabs dang dge shis shing / /'jig rten kun la thugs brtse'uphan pa7mdzad/ /ston pa de yi yon tan 'di dag dang / /gzhan yang mtha' yas kho bos de〈nyam brjod/ /thos nas lha rnams yid dga' dad gyur nas / /rgyal ba la ni dang ba'i yid kyang sgomanya/ /de nas bu mo dri ma med kyis byin pas tshigs su bcad pa 'di dag smras nas bram ze tshangs pa'i lha la 'di skad ces smras so/ /bram ze kho mo btsas nas zhag bdun lonacanas sangs rgyas kyi yon tan rnam pa 'di lta bu dag thos so/ /mngon par dran te de tshun chad nam yang rmugs pa dang gnyid kyis non par ma gyur to/ /nam yang 'dod pa la rnam par rtog pa'i rnam par rtog pa dang / gnod sems kyi rnam par rtog pa'i rnam par rtog pa dang / 'tshe ba'i rnam par rtog pa'i rnam par rtog pa ma byas sonye / /mngon par dran te de tshun chad nam yang pha la dga' ba'am/ ma la dga' ba 'am(7 ming po la dga' ba 'am/ spun la dga' ba 'am/ nye du la dga' ba 'am/ nor la dga' ba 'am/ rgyan la dga' ba 'am/ gos la dga' ba 'am/ lus la dga' ba 'am/ srog la dga' ba 'am/ grong khyer la dga' ba 'am/ skye mched la dga' ba ma bskyed kyi/ bram ze gzhan du na 43—706

sangs rgyas nyid rnam pas7rjes su dran⑧rna/ /bram ze kho mos ni gsum sems lasayid la bya ba yid la byas te/ de bzhin gshegs pa phyogs gang na bzhugasalapa dang / de bzhin gshegs pas chos gang bshad pa de thams cad kho mos legs par yongs su bzung zhing ⑤'o mos don tam khyitshig 'bru las yi ge dang tshig gcig kyang chud ma zos par7byas so/ /de bzhin gshegs pa dge slong gi ⑨dge 'dun gyis yongs su bskor ba kho mosalgenam yang yid larwanyam byas par ma gyur to/ /kho mos nyin mtshan gang du yang sangs rgyas ma mthong〈nyeb dang /chos ma thos pa dang / dge 'dun la bsnyen bkur ma byas par ma gyur to/ /bram ze kho mo5)ni sangs rgyas la bltasab dang / chos mnyan pa dang / dge 'dun la bsnyen bkur bya bas chog pa med do/ /de nas bram ze tshangs pa'i lhas bram ze'i khye'u zhig la smras pa/ bram ze'i khye'u khyod song la lo rgyus 'di rgyal po dang btsun mo la gsol cig /de nas bram ze'i khye'u de rings pa'i tshul du song ste ji ltar mthong ba'i lo rgyus thams cad rgyal po dang btsun mo la gsol to/ /bu mo dri ma med kyis byin pas kyang ji ltar bram ze tshangs pa'i lha la sogs pa bram ze lnga brgyarwanyepo de dag gis bla na med pa yang dag par rdzogs pa'i byang chub tu5)sems bskyed pa de ltar sangs rgyas kyi bsngags pa brjod/ chos dang dge 'dun gyi bsngags spepa brjod do/ /de nas bu mo dri ma med kyis byin pa shing rta nyelas babs nas bram ze de dag dang lhan cig tu byang chub sems dpa' de dag dang ske/ nyan thos chen po de dgatshu nyeg la ba der song ste phyin nas de dag gi rkang pa la mgo bos phyag 'tshal te/ gus pa dang bcas/ rje sa dang bcas par tshe dang ldan pa shā ri'i bu'i mdun du 'dug nas tshe dang ldan pa shā ri'i bu ga la ba 43—707

de logs su thal mo sbyar ba btud de tshe dang ldan pa shā ri'i bu la 'di skad ces smras so/ / btsun pas3)shā ri'i bu budamu )med ni shes rab sor gnyis pa/ nyon mongs pa drag pa/ bag med pa mang ba/ dman pa la mos pa/ tshul bzhinashem lags rtsa)pa yid la bgyid pa'i dbang du mchis pasnyilags na/ bdag la thugs brtse btswanye bar bzung ste ci nas bdag gi yun ring po'i don dang sman pa dang bde bar 'gyur ba'i slad du btsun pas mede ltar bdag la chos legs par bstan du gsol/ ko sa la'i rgyal po gsal rgyal gyis gtam byung5nyeb 'di dang /bram ze'i tshig thos nas myur ba'i tshul gyis phyogs der phyin te/ des7nyan thos de dag dang byang chub sems dpa' de dag la phyag byas nas rang gi bu mo la 'di skad ces smras so/ /bu mo khyod na re kho mo nam yang rmugs pa dang gnyid kyis non par ma gyur to/ /nam yang dga' ba dang rtse ba dang ldan pa'i sems ma bskyed (7do zhes zer ba de ltar khyod bde ba dang yid bde ba la brtson tunyenam/'on te hunye'adi ltar yid byung ba'i tshul gyis smra/ de nas rgyal po gsal rgyal gyis rang gi bu mo la tshigs su bcad de smras pa/ khyod kyi gzugs byang lha yitswabu mo mtshungs shing 'dra/ /rgyan rnams kyis ni de nyidasngogechas pa'i cha byad 'dzin/ /ji ltar khyod ni nam yang gnyid kyis ma non pa/ /citsha phyir bu mo khyod ni 'di 'dra'i yid byung gyur/ /khyed dzo/)kyi rgyal srid rgyas shing shin tu legs par 'byor/ /ma ni rtag tu khyod kyis nyusnyedabang du gyur bsngo/yin/ /bu mo dga' ba de las ci 'dra gzhan yod na/ /de yis khyod kyi lus ni dga' ba rnyed ma gyur(3 / /sdug cing phangs 31la yid du 'ong ba steni / /skye bo kun la dga' ba skyedadza cigeyin na(ste/ /yon tan brgya phrag du mas brgyan pa khyod/ / ci yi ( ci phyir namanyekhyim 'dir dga' 43—708

ba med/ /bu mo khyod kyis ci zhig thos gyur cing / /ci zhig mthong na 'di ltar yid mi bde/ /yongs su nyams shing yid byung0)sems su gyur②/ /khyod kyi〈kye'adod pa ci 'dra ngasrel smos/ /de nas bu mo dri ma med kyis byin pas rang gi pha rgyal po gsal rgyal la tshigs su bcad de smrasamasepa/ yab cig phung po nyesal)dmigs snod7rnams dang / /khyim gyi skyon rnams thugs su ma chud dam/ /'khor ba'i gnas ni gar la lta〈kyedang mtshungs/ /'tsho ba'i 'jig rten mi gnas 'jig pa can/ /sbrul gdugalonyenang na gnas pa'i khyim 'di la/ /gnyid dang 'dod pa'i 'dun pa ga la mchis/ /khams 'di dag ni gdug pa'i sbrul bzhi ste / /srid pa sems pa hunyabade ba ga la mchis/ /mi mdza'atsotshogs kyis rab tu gtsesatshwanyegyur cing / /dgon par phyin la dga' ba ga la mchis/ /kun nas nyon mongs dgra yis yongs bskor ba/ /ji ltar bde 'thob rgyal posnyibaka' stsol cig /dug 'thungasalgepa la bde ba ga la mchis/ / gsad par bkri la dga' ba ga la mchis7/ /g.yang sa chen tu 'dir su zhig yid rton7)bgyid/ /rgyal po 'tsho ba'i5) 'jig rten de dang du nyamatshungs/ /blo ngan dag gis lus rnams bor ba ni / /ri rab tsam gyi ni phung por gyur to zhes/ /de bzhin gshegs pas dpe5 nyeni bka' stsal na/ /'dus byas slu ba'i chos la su yid rton/ /pha dang ma dang sdug dang ming po dang / /bu dang rtsa lag gnyen tshogs 'gro ba kun/ /'dus byas thams cad me long gzugs brnyan 'dra/ /'di 'dra'i mi sdug gang la su yid rton / /gang tshe bdag gis rang byung du stergyal ba mthong / /de tshe sangs rgyas 'gyur ma( nyesnyam sems kyang skyeme/ /byang chub sems dpa' bag med 'gyur ba ni / /yab cig bdag gis ma thos ma mthong ngos nye/ /bdag ni mtshan rdzogs 43—709

rgyal ba blta0)'tshal gyur②/ /bde bar gshegs pas gsungs pa'i chos kyang thos / /rgyal ba rgyal ba'i sras ③po 'di dag mthong / /yab cig ji ltar 'dod pa bsten par bgyi/ /de nas rgyal po gsal rgyal bu mo'i tshig 'di thos nas cang mi smra bar gyur to/ /de nas bu mo dri ma med kyis byin pas rang gi pha cang mi smra bar gyur par7rig nas tshe dang ldan pa shā ri'i bu la 'di skad ces smras so/ /btsun pa shā ri'i bu khyod la zhu ba zhus thugs brtse'ubar dgongs te lan gdab tu gsol/ 'di ltar btsun pa shā ri'i bu ni bcom ldan 'das kyis shes rab dang ldan pa rnams kyi5kyemachog tu bstan pa lags na/ ci shes rab de 'dus byas lags sam 'on te 'dus ma byas lags/ de gal teshe'adus byas lags na de bzhin gshegs pas 'dus byas thams cad ni brdzun7pa slu ba'i chos can yinarwateno zhes bka' stsal to/ / ci ste5)'dus ma byas lags na8/ 'dus ma byas la ni skye ba ma mchis so/ /gang la skye ba ma mchis pa de la ni phrad pa ma mchis natso/phrad 8pa ma mchis pa'i shes rab kyis ji ltar btsun pa shā ri'i bu shes rab chen po zhes bgyi/ de nas tshe dang ldan pa shā ri'i bu cang mi smra bar7gyur to/ /de nas tshe dang ldan pa mod gal gyi bu chen pos tshe dang ldan pa shā ri'i bu la 'di skad ces smras so/ /shā ri'i bu bu mos dris pa'i lan thob cigayon /shā ri'i bus smras pa / bu mo ni〈she'adus byas mi 'dri'i(rte/ bu mos ni skye ba med pa dris te/ desaX ni lan gdabamanyepar mi nus so/ /de nas bu mo dri ma med kyis byin pas tshe dang ldan pa mod gal gyi bu chen po la 'di skad ces smras so/ /'di ltar btsunamanyepa mod gal gyi bu chen po khyod ni bcom ldan 'das kyis rdzu 'phrul dang ldan pa rnams kyi mchog tu bstan pa lags na/ ci tshe dang ldan pa sems can du 'du shes pa la 43—710

gnas te rdzu 'phrul ston tam/ 'on te chos su 'du shes pa la ①gnas te rdzu 'phrul ston/ /gal te sems can du 'du shes pa la gnas te ston na sems can ni ma mchis pa ste/ de lta bas na rdzu 'phrul de yang ma mchis par 'gyur ro/ /ci ②ste chos su 'du shes pa la gnas te ston na chos nyid ni 'gyur ba ma mchis pa'o/ /'gyur ba ma mchis pa gang lagasalgepa de la ni rnam par rtog pa ma mchis na rnam par mi rtog ④pas ji ltar tshe dang ldan pa'i rdzu 'phrul 'byor par gyur⑤/tshe dang ldan pa mod gal gyi bu chen po yang cang mi smra bar gyur to/ /de nas byams ma'i bu gang pos tshe dang ldan pa mod gal gyi bu chen po la 'di skad ces smras so/ /mod gal gyi bu chen po bu mos dris pa'i lan thob cig⑥ /med gal gyi bus smras pa/ bu mo ni 'gyur ba mi 'dri'i⑧/ bu mos ni 'gyur ba med pa drisashete/ 'gyur ba med pa dang rnam par mi rtog pa ni de bzhin gshegs pa rnams kyi byang chub yin pas de ni lan gdab par mi nus so/ /de nas bu mo dri ma med kyis byin pas byams ma'i bu gang po la 'di skad ces smras so/ /'di ltar tshe dang ldan pa gang po ni bcom ldan 'das kyis chos smra bsngo1rnams kyi7mchog tu bstan pa lags na/ ci tshe dang ldan pa dmigs pa dang bcas pa'i chos ston tam / 'on te dmigs pa ma mchis pa'i chos ston/ gal te dmigs pa dang bcas pa'i chos ston na ni khyod byis pa so so'i skye bo rnams dang mtshungs so/ /de ci'i slad du zhe na/ byis pa so so'i〈nyeskye bo thams cad ni dmigs pa dang bcas pa'i slad du ste/ de lta bas na btsun pa yang byis pa so so'i skye bo thams cad kyi chos rnams dang ma bral ba lags so/ / ci ste7dmigs pa ma mchis pa'i chos ston na ni chos smra ba nyidasridangos po ma mchis par 'gyur te 0mi 'thad do/ /de 43—711

nas tshe dang ldan pa gang po yang cang mi smra bar gyur to/ /de nas tshe dang ldan pa 'od srung chen pos gang po la 'di skad ces smras so/ /gang po bu mos dris pa'i lan thob cig6) /tshe dang ldan pa gang pos smras pa/ bu mo ni kun rdzob mi 'dri'i②ske/ bu mo7ni don dam pa dris te/ de ④ni lan gdab53)par mi nus so/ /de nas bu mo dri ma med kyis byin pas tshe dang ldan pa 'od srung chen po la 'di skad ces smras so/ /'di ltar btsun pa 'od srung chen po ni rnam par thar pa brgyad la snyoms par zhugs nas langs te gzhan dag la chos ston cing gang dag las tha na gzar bu gang tsam gyi bsod snyoms yongs su blangs pa de dag thams cad mtho ris su 'gro bar 'gyur ro zhe〈pen/ de ci btsun pas7lus kyis sbyin pa sbyong ngama'i / 'on te sems kyis sbyin pa sbyongatshwa )/ gal te lus kyis sbyong〈nyan lus ni bems po g.yo ba mtshwa)mchis pa byed pa ma mchis pa ste/ rtswa hunyedang / shing dang /rtsig pa'i chos lta bu mig yor dang mtshungs pas des kyang sbyong b.rarwastemi nus so/ /ci miste sems kyis sbyongakhen sems ni sgyu ma lta bu gnas pa ma mchis pa ste/ des kyang sbyong bar5nyemi nus so/ /ci〈nyeste lus dang sems kyi phyi rol gyis sbyong7can de ni ma mchis pa ste/ ma mchis pas ji ltar sbyong bar〈 ) bgyid/ de nas tshe dang ldan pa 'od srung chen po yang cang mi smra bar gyur torurmi/ /rab 'byor gyis smras pa/tshe dang ldan pa 'od srung chen po bu mos dris pa'i lan thob shigadu /'od srung chen pos smras pa/ bu mo ni len pa mi 'dri'i/ bu mos ni len pa med pa dris shing yang dag pa'i mtha' 'dri bas de ni〈rnyelan gdab par mi nus so/ /de nas bu mo dri ma med kyis byin pas gnas brtan rab 'byor la 'di skad ces smras so/ /'di ltar btsun pa rab 'byor ni bcom ldan 'das kyis nyon mongs pa med par 43—712

gnas pa rnams kyi mchog tu bstan pa lags na/ ci nyon mongs pa med pa de dngos pos rab tu phye ba lags sam/ 'on te chos nyid kyis rab tu phye ba lags/gal te dngos pos rab tu phye ba lags na ni 'dus byas su 'gyur ro/ /cir1)ste chos nyid kyis rab tu phye ba lags na ni 2chos nyid ni skye ba ma mchis pa'i mtshan nyid dang / 'gag pa ma mchis pa'i mtshan nyid de/ skye ba ma mchis pa dang 'gag pa ma mchis pa'i mtshan nyid gang lags pa de ni semanyam pa nyid do/ /mnyam pa nyid gang lags pa de ni de bzhin nyid do/ /de bzhin nyid gang lagasalogapa de ni 'gyur ba ma mchis pa'o/ /'gyur ba ma mchis pa gang lags pa55)de ni tha snyad ma mchis pa'o/ /tha snyad ma mchis pa gang lags pa de ni bsam gyis mi khyab pa'o/ /bsam gyis mi khyab pa gang lags pa de ni bstan du ma mchis pa'o/ /bstan du ma mchis pa gang lags pa de ni dngos po ma mchis pa'o/ /dngos po ma mchis pa gang lags pa de ni ma byung ba'o/ /ma byung ba gang lags pa de ni 'phags pa rnams mi ston to/ /de nas tshe dang ldan pa rab 'byor kyang g.yecang mi smra bar gyur to/ /de nas tshe dang ldan pa nam grus tshe dang rtsonaldan pa rab 'byor la 'di skad ces smras so/ /tshe dang ldan pa rab 'byor bu mos dris pa'i lan thob shig(2) /rab 'byor gyis smras pa/ 'di la brjod du 1ci yang med/ /cang mi smra ba de 'thobarwarngo byed/ /spros pa med pa'i chos 'di dag /bu mo yongs su 'dri bar byed/ /ji srid dngos po skye yod pa/ /de srid skyon gyis gos 31par 'gyur/ /chos kyi dbyings ni tha snyad med/ /'di ni nyon mongs med pa'i tshul/ /de nas bu mo dri ma med kyis byin pas tshe dang ldan pa nam gru la 'di skad ces smras so/ /tshe dang ldan pa nam gru ni bcom ldan 'das kyis bsam gtan pa rnams kyi mchog 43—713

tu bstan pa lags na/ ci sems la gnas te bsam gtan mdzad ①dam/'on te sems ma mchis pasnyel gnas te bsam gtan mdzad/ gal te sems la gnas te bsam gtan mdzad na sems ni brjod du ma mchis shing sgyu ma lta bu ste/yang dag pa ma yin pa kun brtagasalgepa lags na/ ci yang dag pa ma yin pa kun brtagasalgepa ma mchis pa la gnas te bsam gtan mdzad dam/ ci7ste sems ma mchis pa la duganas te bsam gtan mdzad na ni rtswa dang / shing dngas/ rtsig pa dang / rdo la sogs pa byung ba dang zhig pa de dag thams cad kyang ting nge 'dzin du 'gyur ro/ /de ci'i slad du zhe na/ 'di ltar de dag ni sems ma mchis pa'i slad du'o/ /tshe dang ldan pa nam gru yang cang mi smra bar gyur to/ /de nas tshe dang ldan pa ma 'gags ⑩pas tshe dang ldan pa nam gru la 'di skad ces smras so/ /tshe dang ldan pa nam gru bu mos dris pa'i lan thob shig(1 /nam grus smras pa/ bu mo ni de bzhin gshegs pa'i yul yongs su 'dri ste/ de ni nyan thos rnams kyis bstan par mi nus so/ /bu mos smras pa/ tshe dang ldan pa nam gru chos kyi dbyings de bzhin gshegs pa rnams kyi yang gzhan la/nyan thos rnams7kyi yang gzhan lags sam/ gal te chos kyi dbyings gzhan lags na ni tha dad du 'gyur ro/ /de bzhin nyid ni gnyis su ma mchis te/ de bas na de bzhin nyid dang gnyis ni bye brag ma mchis na ci'i slad du tshe dang ldan pa nam gru de skadacagasung nam gru yang cang mi smra bar gyur to/ /de nas bu mo dri ma med kyis byin pas tshe dang ldan pa ma 'gags pa la 'di skad ces smras so/ /'di ltar tshe dang ldan pa ma 'gags pa ni bcom ldan 'das kyis lha'i mig can rnams kyi mchog tu bstan pa lags na (nyelha'i mig gis dngos po gzigs sam/43—714

'on te dngos po ma mchis pa gzigs/ gal te dngos po gzigs na ni rtag par lta bar 'gyur ro/ /ci0)ste dngos po ma mchis pa gzigs na ni chad par lta bar 'gyur te/ de yang mi rigs so/ /ma 'gagasalgepa yang cang mi smra bar gyurasheto/ /de nas tshe dang ldan pa kun dga' bos tshe dang ldan pa ma 'gags pa la 'di skad ces smras so/ /tshe dang ldan pa ma 'gags pa bu mos dris pa'i lan thob shig④ /tshe dang ldan pa ma 'gags pas smras pa/ bu'agemos ni shes rab kun tu 'jom paladris pas de ni lan gdab par mi nus so/ /de nas bu mo dri ma med kyis byin pas tshe dang ldan pa kun dga' bo la 'di skad ces smras so/ /'di ltar tshe dang ldan pa kun dga' bo khyod ni bcom ldan 'das kyis mang du thos pa rnams kyi mchog tu bstanashepa lags na/ ci mang du thos pa nyid de'udon du blta7'am/ 'on te tshig 'brur bsto9/ gal te don du bltarwanyan don ni brjod du ma mchis shing bsnyad du ma mchis pa ste/ de ni rna ba'i rnam par shes pas shes par bgyi ba ma lags pa nas yid kyi rnam par shes pa'i bar gyis shes par bgyi ba ma lags pa ste/ rnam pa de lta bu gang lags patshwanyede ni bstan du ma mchis pa'o3nye/ /ci7ste tshig 'brur bltacan ni bcom ldan 'das kyis don la rton pa yin gyi tshig 'bruratshwa 7rton pa ma yin no zhes gsungs pas de bsatshwanyen tshe dang ldan pa kun 3)dga' bo'i mang du thos pa nyid 3 ni rton pa ma lags so/ /de nas tshe dang ldan pa kun dga' bo yang cang mi smra bar gyur to/ /de nas 'jam dpal gzhon nur gyur pas tshe dang ldan pa kun dga' bo la 'di skad ces smras sol/ /tshe dang ldan pa kun dga' bo bu mos dris pa'i lan thob shigasum /kun dga' bos smras pa/ bu mo du rteni yi ge dang bral ba 'dri'ageste/ de ni sgras tshim 43—715

par byed par7mi nus so/ /bu mo ni sems dang bral ba'i mnyam pa nyid 'dri ste/slob pa rnams kyi sa ma yin na de ji ltar bstan par bya ste/ chos kyi mnga' bdag de bzhin gshegs pa la zhu dgos pa'o②/ /de nas bu mo dri ma med kyis byin pasalge'ajam dpal gzhon nur gyur pa la 'di skad ces smras so/ /'jam dpal khyod ni de bzhin gshegs pas zab mo la mos pa'i byang chub sems dpa' rnams kyi mchog tu bstan pa lags na/ ci rten cing 'brel bar 'byung ba zab pas khyo da zab btso/ 'on te ngo bo nyid zab pas zab/ gal te rten cing 'brel par 'byung ba zab pas khyod zab na ni rten cing 'brel bar 'byung ba dang ldan pa'i chos gang yang ma mchis so/ /de ci'i slad du zhe na/ 'di ltar rten cing 'brel bar 'byung ba ni song ba ma lags/ 'ong ba ma lags te/ rten cing 'brel bar 'byung ba ni mig gi rnam par shes pas shes par bgyi ba ma lags pa nas yid kyi rnam par shes pa'i bar gyis shes par bgyi ba ma lags shing gnyis su ma mchis la kun tu 'byung ba ma mchis pa'i slad du'o/ /ci ste ngo bo nyid zab pas zab na ni ngo bo nyid gang yang sus kyang brtag par mi nus so/ /'jam dpal gyis7smras pa/ bu mo yang dag pa'i mtha' zab pas kho bo zab po/ /bu mo dri ma med kyis byin pas smras pa/ 'jam dpal yang dag pa'i mtha' ni mtha' ma lags te/ de'i slad du rnam par shes pas 'tshal ba ma lags so/ /'jam dpal gyis smras pa/ bu mo yang dag pa'i mtha' zhes bya ba 'di'uni dmigs su med pa'i tshig⑧bla dgas57so/ /bu mo dri ma med kyis byin pas smras pa/ 'jam dpal dmigs su ma mchis pa ni gang gi tshig bla dgas kyang ma lags te/dmigs su ma mchis pa ni tshig bla dgas las yang dag par 'das pa lags so/ /43—716

'jam dpal gyis smras pa/ bu mo 'dinyeji ltar gzhan dag la bstan par bya/bu mos smras pa/ 'jam dpal de bzhin gshegs pa rnams kyi byang chub ni bstan pa las yang dag par 'das pa lags te/ de ni brjod pas bstan par mi nus so / /'jam dpal yang cang mi smra bar gyur to/ /de nas bu mo dri ma med kyis byin pas byang chub sems dpa' mthong ba don yodasal 'di skad ces smras so/ /rigs kyi bu khyod 'di skad du ci nas kyang grong khyer na skyes pa 'am/ bud med dam / khye'u 'am/ bu mo gang dag kho bo'i mig lam na snang bar 'gyur ba de dag thams cad kyis de bzhin gshegs pa'i gzugs mthong bar 'gyur ba rnam pa de lta bu'i bsam pa kho bos bsam par bya'o/ /zhes gsungs pa de ci de bzhin gshegs pa gzugs kyi skur mthong b.rarnyumadzad dam/ 'on tesnyichos kyi skur mthong bar ⑤mdzad/ gal te gzugs kyi skur mthong bar ⑥mdzad na de ni sangs rgyas kyi bka' ma lags te/ bcom ldan 'das kyis ni 'di skad du/gang dag nga la gzugs su mthong / /gang dag nga la sgrar shes pa/ /'dun pa 'dod chags ldan pa ste/ /skye bo de dag nga mi mthong zhes gsungs so/ /ci5nyeste de bzhin gshegs pa chos kyi skur mthong bar mdzad na chos kyi sku ni bstan du mi nus pa'o/ /de ci'i slad du zhe na/ de bzhin gshegs pa rnams kyi chos kyi sku ni mig gi rnam par shes pa las yang dag par 'das pa ste7blta bar mi nus pa'i slad du'o/ /mthong ba don yod kyang cang mi smra bar gyur tokyi/ /byang chub sems dpa' rin po cherwanyetog gis77smras pa/ mthong ba don yod bu mos dris pa'i lan thob shigatunye /mthong ba don yod kyis smras pa/ bu mo ni dngos po med pa 'dri ste de ni bstan par mi nus so/ /bu mo dri ma med kyis byin pas smras pa/43—717

bdag ni dngos po'am dngos po ma mchis pa mi 'dri'o/ /bstan pa slobs la de nas ston cig /mthong ba don yod kyang cang mi smra bar0)gyur to/ /de nas bu mo dri ma med kyis byin pas byang chub sems dpa' rin po che tog⑧la 'di skad ces smras so/ /rigs kyi bu khyod kyis 'di skad du gang gis grong khyer na khyim thams cad du〈(rin po ches5gegang ba'i gter rnams 'byung bar 'gyur bshernam pa de lta 4)bu'i bsam pa kho bos bsam par bya'o/ /zhes gsungs pa de ci57zang zing dang bcas pa'i0)phan 'dogs par59)mdzad dam/ 'on te zang zing ma mchis pas phan 'dogs paratshwaste mdzad/ gal te zang zing dang bcas pas phan 'dogs na ni byis pa so so'i skye bo'i phan 'dogs pa dang bye brag ma mchis par 'gyur ro/ /de ci'i slad du zhe na/ 'di ltar byis pa so so'i skye bo rnams kyi dga' ba ni zang zing dang bcas pa'i slad du'o/ /ci77ste zang zing ma mchis pas phan 'dogs paratshwanyemadzad na zang zing ma mchis pa ni〈nyebasgrub tu mchamachis pa lags so/ /rin po che tog kyang cang mi smra bar gyur to8/ /de nas bu mo dri ma med kyis byin pas byang chub sems dpa' ngan song spong la 'di skad ces smras sol/ /rigs kyi bu khyod kyis 'di skad du gang gis grong khyer 'di napha sems can rnams kyi las ngan song myong bar 'gyur ba gang yod pa de tshe 'di nyid la yang zhing chung ngu myong bar 'gyur ba rnam pa de lta bu'i bsam pa kho bos bsam par bya'o / /zhes gsungs pa de/ de bzhin gshegs pas las ni bsam gyis mi khyab pa nyid du bstan pa〈 tshode ni khyod kyis bsam par mi spyod do/ /gal te spyod na de bzhin gshegs pa'i bka' dang 'gal bar 'gyur ro/ /ci5)ste bsam par mi spyod na mi mkhyen bzhin du mang po myong bar 'gyur ba'i las tshe 'di nyid la yang 43—718

zhing chung junyemyong bar ji ltar mdzad de/ bdag po ma mchis pa'i chos rnams la bdag po rnyed par 'gyur ro/ /gal te de ltar mdzad na de bzhin gshegs pa'i bka' dang 'gal bar 'gyur ro/ /ngan song spong gis smras pa/ kho bosadza ni smon lam gyi dbang gis mang du myong bar 'gyur ba'i las nyung ngu myong bar 'gyur bar byed do/ /bu mos smras pa/ rigs kyi bu chos rnams kyi chos nyid ni smon lam gyi dbang gis bsgyur du mi nus lags so/ /gal te nus par gyur na sems can thams cad yongs su mya ngan las bzla'o zhes de bzhin gshegs pa re re'i dgongs pa de smon lam gyi dbang gis ji ltar mi 'grub ste/ rnam grangs 'dis nalcesmon lam gyishedabang gis bsgyur bar75)mi nus par rigapo)par bgyi'o⑦ / /ngan song spong yang cang mi smra bar gyur to/ /de nas bu mo dri ma med kyis byin pas byang chub sems dpa' sgrib pa thams cad rnam par sel ba la 'di skad ces smras so/ /rigs kyi bu khyod 'di skad du gang gis mnyan yod kyi grong khyer chen por skye bo'i tshogs thams cad kyi sgrib pa lnga po dag rnam par sel bar 'gyur ba rnam pa de lta bu'i bsam pa kho bos bsam par bya'o zhes gsungasapo)pa de ci ting nge 'dzin de bdag la rag las pa lags sam/ 'on te gzhan la rag las pa lags/ gal te bdag la rag las pa7lags na ni mi 'pho ba'i chos can lags te/ ji ltar khyod snyoms par zhugs pas gzhan dag gi tu )sgrib pa rnams rab tu zhi bar mdzad/ cirwanyeste gzhan la rag las pa lags na ni ting nge 'dzin de khyod kyi ma lags so/ /gang khyod kyi ma lags pa des ni gzhan la phan param/nyamadzad par mi spyod do/ /byang chub sems dpa' sgrib pa thams cad rnam par sel bas smrasalgepa/ bu mo kho bo'i sbyor ba 'di ni byams pa sngon du 'gro 43—719

ba'o / /bu mo dri ma med kyis byin pas smras pa/ rigs kyi bu sangs rgyas bcom ldan 'das thams cad kyang byams pa la gnas ①lags na sangs rgyas kyi zhing rnams na sems can dag〈kyel sgrib pa rnams kyis gnod pa yang masamachis so/ /byang chub sems dpa' sgrib pa thams cad rnam par sel ba yang cang mi smra bar gyur to/ /de nas bu mo dri ma med kyis byin pas byang chub sems dpa' spyan ras gzigs dbang phyug la 'di skad ces smras so/ /rigs kyi bu khyod kyis 'di skad du ci nas kyang grong khyer na sems can gang dag bcings pa dang / gsadakyipar bkri(lde)ba de dag thar ba dang / 'jigs pas nyen pa rnams kyang 'jigs pa med pa thob par 'gyur ba rnam pa de lta bu'i bsam pa kho bos bsam par bya'o//zhes gsungs pa de ci khyod kyi sbyor ba 'di len pa dang bcas pa lags sam/'on te len pa ma mchis pa lags/ gal te sbyor ba de len pa dang bcas pa lags na ni byis pa so so'i ⑦skye bo rnams kyang len pa dang bcas pa lags te/byis pa so so'i skye bosarnams dang mtshungs par 'gyur ro/ /de lta bas na de yang mi rigs so/ /ci7ste sbyor ba de len pa ma mchis pa lags na ni mngon par 'dus ma byas pa lags te/ mngon par 'dus ma byas pa la ni nye bar sgrubalgepa ma mchis so/ /byang chub sems dpa' spyan ras gzigs dbang phyug kyang cang mi smra bar gyur to/ /de nas byang chub sems dpa' spobs pa brtsegs kyis byang chub sems dpa' spyan ras gzigs dbang phyug la 'di skad ces smras so/ /spyan ras gzigs dbang phyug bu mos dris pa'i lan thob shigatso /byang chub sems dpa' spyan ras gzigs dbang phyug gis smras pa/ bu mo ni skye ba dang 'gag pa mi 'dri ste/ de ni lan gdab par mi nus so/ /bu mo dri ma med kyis byin pas 43—720

smras pa/ spyan ras gzigs dbang phyug gang na skye ba ma mchis pa dang 'gag pa ma mchis pa de ni dri ba ①ma mchis so/ /byang chub sems dpa' spyan ras gzigs dbang phyug gis smras pa/ bu mo gang na skye ba med cing 'gag pa med pa de ni7yi ge 'jug pa med do/ /bu mos smras pa/ 'jug pa ma mchis pa dang /yi ge ma mchis pa'i chos thams cad la ni mkhas pa dag yi ge dang 'jug pa mi ston te①/ yi ge rnams la mi chags so/ /chags pa ma mchis pa ni chos kyi dbyings te/ de la nisnyirtogs par bgyi ba'i slad du chags pa ma mchis so /byang chub sems dpa' spyan ras gzigs dbang phyug kyang cang mi smra bar gyur to/ /de nas bu mo dri ma med kyis byin pas byang chub sems dpa' spobs pa brtsegs la 'di skad ces smras so/ /rigs kyi bu khyod kyis 'di skad du gang gis grong khyer na skye bo'i tshogs thams cad phan tshun tshigs su bcad pa'i dbyangs dang / byams pa'i sems kyis smra bar 'gyur ba dang / spobs pa yang thob par 'gyur ba rnam pa de lta bu'i bsam pa kho bos bsam par bya'o/ /zhes gsungs pa'i khyod kyi spobs pa nye bar sgrub ⑤pa gang lags pa de ci rnam par rtog ⑥pas bskyed pa lags sam/ 'on te rgyu ma mchis pa las byung ba lags/ gal te rnam par rtog pas bskyed pa lags na ni 'dus byas thams cad kyang rnam par rtog pas bskyed pa lags te/ de lta bas na rnam par zhi bar mi 'gyur ro/ /ci7ste rgyu ma mchis pa las byung ba lags na ni ma byung ba la sgro 'dogs par 'gyur ro/ /byang chub sems dpa' spobs pa brtsegs kyis smras pa/ bu mo sems can gang dag kho bo'i mig lam na snang bar 'gyur ba de dag thams cad spobs pa thob par gyur cig ces bya ba'i kho bo'i smon lam 'di ni dang po sems bskyed pa nas bzung ste 43—721

btab bo/ /bu mo dri ma med kyis byin pas smras pa/ rigs kyi bu sems bskyed pa gang gis smon lam btabalgepa'i sems bskyed pa deshemachis sam/ 'on te masamachis / gal te mchis na ni rtag par lta ba lags so/ /ci7ste ma mchis na nisnyichad par lta ba lags te/ de gsung na ni khyod kyiwogasung ba log pashelags so//byang chub sems dpa'50spobs pa brtsegasashekyang cang mi smra bar gyur to/ /de nas bu mo dri ma med kyis byin pas byang chub sems dpa' gom pa 'dor ba don yod la 'di skad ces smras so/ /rigs kyi bu khyod kyis 'di skad du ci nas kyang grong khyer na sems can gang dag kho bo'i mig lam na snang bar 'gyur ba de dag thams cad bla na med pa yang dag par rdzogs pa'i byang chub las phyir mi ldog par 'gyur ba rnam pa de lta bu'i bsam pa kho bos bsam par bya'o zhes gsungs pa de ci byang chub de mchis pa zhes brjod par bgyi 'am/ 'on te ma mchis pa zhes brjod par bgyi/ gal te mchis na ni rtag pa ste yod pa'i mthar 'dzin pa lags so/ /ci57ste ma mchis na ni chad pa ste med pa'i mthar 'dzin pa lags sol/ /byang chub sems dpa' gom pa 'dor ba don yod kyis smras pa/ bu mo byang chub ces bya ba 'di ni ye shes kyi tshig bla dgas so/ /bu mo dri ma med kyis byin pas smras pa/ ci5)ye shes de skye bas rab tu phye ba lags sam/ 'on te zhi bas rab tu phye ba lagasatunye/ 'onasate7skye bas rab tu phye ba lags na ni tshul bzhin ma lags pa yid la bgyid pa las byung ba 'dus byas su 'gyur te/ shes pa de ni byis pa rnams kyi lags so/ /ci7ste zhi bas rab tu phye ba lags na ni de la 3 1dmigs pa ma mchis so/ /gang la dmigs pa ma mchis pa de la 'di ni so so'i skye bo'o zhe〈nye'am/ nyan thos so zhe 'am/ rang sangs rgyas so zhe 'am/43—722

byang chub sems dpa'o zhe'am/ sangs rgyas so zhes rnam par rtog pa mi skye'o/ /de ci'i slad du zhe na/ byang chub ni rnam par mi rtog pa lags na byis pa so so'i skye bo rnams ni byang chub la rnam par rtog ste/ mkhas pa rnams ni mi rtog pa'i slad du'o/ /byang chub sems dpa' gom pa 'dor ba don yod kyang cang mi smra bar gyur to/ /de nas tshe dang ldan pa rab 'byor gyis byang chub sems dpa' de dag la 'di skad ces smras so/ /bsod snyoms kyi phyir grong khyer du 'jug par mi bya'i ⑨slar 'dong ngo / /de ci'i phyir zhe na/ deng bu mo dri ma med kyis byin pa las chos thos ②pa gang yin pa 'di ni mkhas pa'i ⑧zas yin pas chog par 'gyur ba'i phyir te/ chos kyi zas bza' bar bya'o/ /de nas bu mo dri ma med kyis byin pas gnas brtan rab 'byor la 'di skad ces smras so/ /btsun⑧pa rab 'byor gang na gdeg pa med pa dang gzhag ⑤pa med pa de la ci zhig57khyod kyisakhubatsal bar sems/ btsun pa rab 'byor dge sbyong gir tshul ni sprosam1)pa ma mchis pa lags kyi spros pa la dga' ba'i〈skyeni ma lags so/ /btsun pa rab 'byor dge sbyong gi chos ni gnas pa ma mchis pa/ gnas par mi bgyi ba lags te / 'phags pa rnams kyi spyod yul ni mi 'khrugs pa lags so// //bam po gnyis pa ste tha gonye/ de nas nyan thos chen po brgyad po de dag dang ske/ byang chub sems dpa' brgyad po de dag dang / bram ze lnga brgya tsam po de dag dang / bu mo dri ma med kyis byin pa dang / rgyal po gsal rgyal dang /de las gzhan pa skye bo phal po che rnams bcom ldan 'das ga la ba der dong ste phyin nas bcom ldan 'das kyi zhabs la mgo bos phyag 'tshal te lan gsum bskor ba byas nas phyogs gcig tu 'khod do/ /de nas bu mo dri ma med kyis byin 43—723

pas bcom ldan 'das la lan stong bskor ba byas te gos phrag pa gcig tu bgosashenas pus mo g.yas pa'i lha nga sa la btsugs te/ bcom ldan 'das ga la ba deshelogs su thal mo sbyar ba btud nas tshigs su bcad pa'i dbyangs kyis zhu ba zhus pa / tingashe'adzin stobs ldan grags pa mtha' yas mnga'abya/ /'jig rten mgon po bdud rtsi dga' stsol ba/ /mtshungs med ye shes bde gshegs khyod la zhu / /byang chub sems dpa' ji ltar spyad pa spyod/ /ji ltar shing dbang drung mchis bdud rnams 'jomasayi/ /ji ltar rir ⑦bcas sa rnams g.yo bar bgyid / /grags pa mtha' yas ji ltar 'od zerasnyigatong / /byang chub spyod tshul legs7par bshad du gsol/ /sangs rgyas nor gyi gzungs ni ji ltar 'thob/ /ting 'dzin zhi ba dam pa ji ltar bsgomatso/ /mi yis rdzu 'phrul stobs ni ji ltar 'thob / /sems can rin chen rnams kyi spyod pa gsungs/ /gang gis dran dang rtogs〈skyedang blo grosarwa 'gyur/ /spobs pa mdzes dang ldan par gang gis 'gyur//gang dang rab tu ldan na 'khor nang du/ /snyan cing shin tu mdzes pa smra bar bgyid / /gang gis mi ni tshe rabs dran par 'gyur/ /dri ma ma mchis lha yi7mig kyang 'thob/ /lha rna 'thob cing pha rol sems tshul rig /rdzu 'phrul gyis ni zhing rnams brgyar yang mchitso/ /ji ltar sbyin pa gtong la brtson par 'gyur/ /rtag tu tshul khrims dag cing bzod la dga'/ /ji ltar brtson 'grus bsam gtan mkhas par 'gyur/ /shes rab la yang ji ltar shin tu brtson/ /mngal gyi gnas ni ji ltar rnam spangs nas/ /pad ma las ni rtag tu rdzus7te skye/ /sangs rgyas rnams kyi spyan sngar mchis par bgyid/ /bdag med stong pa nyid kyi sgra yang brjodayi/ /ji ltar de yid dga' dang mi dga' mtshungs/ /sred pa 43—724

spangs shing tha ba zhe snang spong ①/ /mtho bar mi sems dma' bar sems ma mchis/ /sems brtan g.yo ba ma mchis ri rabasnyematshungs/ /rnyed dang ma rnyed grags dang mnyegrags dang / /bstodasnyidang smad dang bde dang sdug bsngalas dang / /ji ltar 'jig rten chos rnams zil mnan gnas6)/ /'jig rten kun na zla ba lta bur spyod/ /nga yi ma mchis tshul 'chos g.yo ma mchis/ /ji ltar rdul bral nga rgyal rgyags pa spong / / zhi dngasherab tu zhi dang zhi gnas brtson/ /blo ldan ji ltar ye shes mchog tu 'gyur/ /chung ma bu nor mdza'aphrol dga' ma mchis / /ji ltar bas mtha'i mal la mngon par hukye dga'/ /rtag tu bya dang mtshungs shing zla ba 'dra/ /ji ltar chos kyi nor〈nyal dga' zhing mos/ /chu dang mtshungs shing sasngo 'dra rlung dang mtshungs/ /mkhas pa ji ltar mephyedang 'dra bar 'gyur/ /rtag tu ci7yang ma mchis mi rtog lags/ /mnyam pa nyid la dga' zhing nam mkha' mtshungs8/ /ji ltar rtag tu chos ni spong mi bgyid/ /bdag 'dor bgyid kyi chos mchog yongs7mi gtong / /'jig rten dag5nyetu ston pa'i sems bskyed nas/ /ji ltar gnas te byang chub 'jug par bgyid⑩/ /zhing gi bkod pa ji ltar gnas par 'gyur/ /dge 'dun dag par ji ltar 'gyur ba lags/ /ji ltar dus gsum du yang chos thos shing / /ji ltar tshe ring sems can bde bar 'gyur/ /rtag tu sred pa 'gog pa'i pha rol son/ /dgra bcom dul5)bar bden bzhi ji ltar mthong / /sems can brgya〈nyedag byang chub 'jog par bgyid kyi/ /spyod cing rtag tu dga' mos ji ltar 'gyur/ /gang gis shin tu mdzes par 'gyur/ /brdzusamanyete skye bar gang gis 'gyur/ /longs spyod che dngake shes rab che/ /kun mkhyen rtogs par khong du chud/ /gang gis sum 43—725

cu51)rtsa gnyis mtshan/ /dpe byad bzang po brgyad cu 'thob/ /bsod nams kun la mkhas pa lags/ /spobs pa gang gis skye bar 'gyur/ /zhing ni ji ltar dag mi'agyur lags/ /dge slong dge 'dun phun sum tshogs / /gang du de yis smon btab pa/ /der ni ji ltar skye 'gyur lags④/ /tshe rabs dran par ji ltar 'gyur/ /ji ltar sangs rgyas rnams dang mjal/ /bskal pa bye ba stong rnams su/ /ngan 'gror mchi bar mi 'gyur lags⑤/ /rnam par 'dren pa ji ltar na/ /mdog dang gzi brjid snyan grags 'thob/ /stobs dang mthu dang brtson 'grus rnams/ /ji ltar thub par mi 'gyur lags/ /ji ltar sangs rgyas chos dang yang / /dge 'dun la ni skyabs su mami⑥/ /lus dang srog ni gtong bgyid kyi/ /de dag chos ni 'dor mi rtsibagyid/ /byang chub spyan⑧pa spyod bgyid cing ske/ /the tshom ma mchis ji ltar 'gyur/ /'gyod pa thams cad spangs nas su / /srog chags rnams la chos kyang ston/ /khyod la mi mkhyen cang mi mnga'/ /thub chen khyod ni thams cad mkhyen/ /byang chub sems dpa'i spyod gang lags/ /go rims hu )bzhin du bstan du gsol/ /de skad ces gsol pa dang / bcom ldan 'das kyis bu mo dri ma med kyis byin pa la 'di skad ces bka' stsal to/ /bu mo legs so legs so/ /bu mo de bzhin gshegs pa la don 'di lta bu 'di〈nya'adri bar sems pa ni khyod yang legs so/ /bu mo de'i phyir legs par rab tu nyon la yid la zung shig 12dang bshad do/ /bu mo dri ma med kyis byin pas bcom ldan 'das la nyanyelegs so 14zhes gsol te bcom ldan 'das kyi 7ltar nyan ⑩pa dang ske/ bcom ldan 'das kyis 'di skad ces bka' stsal to/ / bu mo〈nyebyang chub sems dpa' chos bzhi dang ldan na bdud 'dul bar byed de/ bzhisnyigang 43—726

zhe na/ gzhan gyi rnyed pa la phrag dog med pa dang / phra ma'i hu)tshig yongs su spong ba dang / skye bo mang po dge ba'i rtsa ba 'dzin du 'jug pa dang / sgrib pa med pa'i byams pa sgomakhupa ste/ bu mo byang chub sems dpa' chos bzhi po de dag dang ldan na bdud 'dul bar byed do/ /de la 'di skad ces bya ste/ phrag dog mi bya phrashem smra mi bya/ /skye bo mang po dge ba rnams la sbyar/ /phyogs bcu rnams su byams pa bsgoms50byas na⑤/ /bdud 'dir btul nas byang chub reg par 'gyur/ /bu mo byang chub sems dpa' chos bzhi dang ldan na sangs rgyas kyi zhing mtha' yas pa dag g.yo bar byed de/ bzhi gang zhe na/ ji skad smras pa de bzhin byed pa dang / chos zab mo la mos pa dang / yi yodam la brtan pa dang / skye bo mang po byang chub yang dag par 'dzin du 'jug pa ste/bu mo byang chub sems dpa' chos bzhi po de dag dang ldan na sangs rgyas kyi zhing mtha' yas pa dag g.yo bar byed do/ /de la 'di skad ces bya ste/ ji skad smras pa de bzhin byed/ /mkhas pa zab mo'i chos la bzod/ /yi dam la yang shin tu brtan / /dkar7po'i chos la 'dzud par byed/ /rdzogs pa'i byang chub bla med la / /skye bo mang po dga' bar byed/ /de ltar chos bzhi de dag gis/ /zhing rnams bye ba g.yo bar byed/ /bu mo byang chub sems dpa' chos bzhi dang ldan na sangs rgyas kyi zhing mtha' yas mu med pa rnams su 'od zer nga dag gtong ste/bzhi gang zhe na/ mar me sbyin pa dang / dam pa'i chos yongs su 'dzin pa dang /sems can bag med par gyur cing mi khom par gyur pa rnams kyi gan du song ste chos ston pa dang / de bzhin gshegs pa'i mchod rten dag la rin po che'i dra bas 'gebs spupa ste/ bu mo byang chub sems dpa' chos bzhi po de dag dang 43—727

ldan na sangs rgyas kyi zhing mtha' yas mu med pa rnams su 'od zeratudag gtong ngo ske/ /de la 'di skad ces bya ste/ mar me byin pas 'od ni rnam par dag② /zad pa'i dus na dam chos yongs su 'dzin/ /bag med gyur pa rnams la chos sbyin byed/ /mchod rten dag la rin chen dra ba 'bul/ /des na bye ba bsam yas zhing 'gro zhing / /byang chub sems dpa' 'od zerashegatong bar byed/ /reg nas sems can bde dang ldan par 'gyur/ /mkhas pa byang chub bla med don du gnyer/ /bu mo byang chub sems dpa' chos bzhi dang ldan na gzungs 'thob ste/ bzhi gang zhe na/ rgyan sna tshogs gtsang zhing dag pa sbyin pa dang /bu mo rgyan thams cad kyis brgyan te 'dod pa rnams la sbyin pa dang / rgyun mi 'chad par de bzhin gshegs pa'i bsngags pa brjodakyipa dang / shes rab kyi pha rol tu phyin pa la mang du gnas pa ste/ bu mo byang chub sems dpa' chos bzhi po de dag dang ldan na gzungs 'thobalgebo/ /de la 'di skad ces bya ste/ sna tshogs byin pas gzungs ni thob par 'gyur/ /slong ba rnams la bu mo brgyan te sbyin / /rgyun mi 'chad par sangs rgyas bsngags pa brjodani/ /rgyal ba'i ye shes don du shes rab bsgomasakhye/ /chos bzhi 'di dag gis ni gzungs 'thob tunye 'gyur / /bskal pa brgyar yang thos pa chud mi za/ /phyogs bcur de bzhin gshegs pa gang 'chad pa/ /de dag thams cad dran pa'i stobs kyis 'dzin/ /bu mo byang chub sems dpa' chos bzhi dang ldan na ting nge 'dzin 'thob (nyeste/bzhi gang zhe na/ 'khor ba la yid 'byung5)ba mang ba dang / gcig pur kun tu dga' zhing mgu la mos pa dang / brtson 'grus brtsamasarwanyepa dang / las kyi mtha' shin tu yongs su mthar phyin pa yin te/ bu mo byang chub sems dpa' 43—728

chos bzhi po de dag dang ldan na ting nge 'dzin 'thob7bo/ /de la 'di skad ces bya ste/ sridasapa'i 'gro ba kun la yid kyang 'byungs/ /bse ru lta bur gcig pur spyodakyil dga'/ /rtag tu shin tu brtson 'grus brtsams pa yin/ / de yishelas rtag shin tu mthar yang phyin/ /rtag tu chos bzhi dag la zhugs nas su/ /byang chub spyod pa zhi ba myur tshol byed/ /byang chub sems dpa' tingashe'adzin la gor 'thob/ /rgyal ba rnams kyi spyod yul byang chub rtogs/ /bu mo byang chub sems dpa' chos bzhi dang ldan na rdzu 'phrul 'thob ste/ bzhi gang zhe na/ lus yang ba dang / sems yang bsnyedang / chos thams cad la mngon par zhen pa med pa dang / khams bzhi nam mkha'i khams dang mnyam pa nyid du byin gyis rlob pa ste/ bu mo byang chub sems dpa' chos bzhi po de dag dang ldan na rdzu 'phrul 'thob bo/ /de la 'di skad ces bya ste/ lus yang ba dang de bzhin sems kyang yang / /chos rnams kun la gnas pa med pa nyid/ /nam mkha'i khams dang mtshungs shing 'dra nyid du/ /khams bzhi po dganyebyin gyis rlob par byed/ /chos bzhi 'di dag nges par bsten byas na/ /blo ldan de yis rdzu 'phrul mtha' yas 'thobatso/ /skad cig gcig la zhing rnams stong du 'gro/ /sangs rgyas stong phrag mang po rnams kyang mthong / /bu mo byang chub sems dpa' chos bzhi dang ldan na mdzes par 'gyur te/ bzhi gang zhe na/ khro ba med de rtsod pa〈nyedang / tha ba dang / zhe snang dang bral ba dang / de bzhin gshegs pa'i mchod rten 'phyag parasamangon par brtson par 'gyuramo8ba dang / tshul khrims kyi sdom pas bsdams shing tshur shog /legs par 'ongs so zhes rtag tu smra ba dang / chos smra ba rnams la khro gnyer dang bral zhing zhe 'gras tsho/rtepa'i sems 43—729

med pa yin te/ bu mo byang chub sems dpa' chos bzhi po de dag dang ldan na mdzes par 'gyur ro/ /de la 'di skad ces bya ste/ gzhan la khro dang khon du 'dzin mi7byed/ /nga rgyal rgyags dang tha ba zhe snang bral/ / rtsod pa7med la dga' zhing snyan par smra/ /gus par rgyal ba'i mchod rten 'phyag par byed/ /de ni tshul khrims rnam dag rtag tu srung〈 ༄/ /de ni rtag tu legs par 'ongasalgezhes smraX/ /chos smra rnams la de ni tha ba med/ / de yi7sems ni rdo rje ri rab mtshungs / /bu mo byang chub sems dpa' chos bzhi dang ldan na rdzus7te skye bar 'gyur te/ bzhi gang zhe na/ de bzhin gshegs pa'i sku gzugs pad ma'i steng na bzhugs pa byed du 'jug cing me tog ud pa la dang / pad ma dang / pad ma dkar po dag gis lag pa bkang ste/ de bzhin gshegs pa 'am/ de bzhin gshegs pa'i mchod rten la mngon par 'thor ba dang / phan pa'i dngos po mang zhing yang dag par dga' bar byed pa'i ngang tshul can dang / gzhan dag gi skyon mi 'dzin pa dang / dge ba'i rtsa ba thams cad sems can thams cad la phan pa dang bde bar bya ba'i phyir sangs rgyas kyi byang chub tu yongs su sngoshebar byed pa ste/ bu mo byang chub sems dpa' chos bzhi po de dag dang ldan na rdzus7te skye b.ral )/'gyur ro/ /de la 'di skad ces bya ste/ sangs rgyas sku gzugs pad ma mchog bzhugs byed du 'jug /chu skyes me tog lag pa bkang ste 'bul〈mebar byed/ /pha rol dag la dga' ba skyed72pa'i tshig kyang smra/ /dga' bar byed la mngon par brtson gyi skyon mi 'dzin/ /sems can kun la phan phyir bsod nams yongs su rdzoge/ /thub mchog rnams kyi sangs rgyas byang chub sgrubalgepa shes/ /sangs rgyas gsungs pa'i yon tan 'di bzhi bsten na de/ /rgyal ba 43—730

mchog rnams drung du rdzusanyete skye bar 'gyur/ /bu mo byang chub sems dpa' chos bzhi dang ldan na longs ②spyod chen por 'gyur te / bzhi gang zhe na/brnyas pa med par sbyin pa'i tshul can dang / chags pa med par dngos po yongs su gtong ba dang / mos pa mang bsridang / lta bar gyur pa thams cad dang bral ba yin te/ bu mo byang chub sems dpa' chos bzhi posnyide dag dang ldan na longs spyod chen por 'gyur ro/ /de la 'di skad ces bya ste/ des pa brnyas pa med par sbyin pa sbyin par byed/ /de ni dngos po kun la rtag tu 'dzin pa med/ /rgyal ba'i ye shes mchog la mos pa bskyed byas na/ /de ni phyir zhing longs spyod chen po thob par 'gyur/ /dadaphudang ldan par 'gyur zhing g.yo med sgyu yang med/ /pha rol dag gi skyon ni 'dzin par yong mi byed/ /lhag pa'i bsam pas gang gi⑥lta ba drang gyur pa⑨/ /des na de 'dir longs spyod bzang po rnams dang ldan/ /bu mo byang chub sems dpa' chos bzhi dang ldan na shes rab chen por 'gyur te/ bzhi gang zhe na/ chos la ser sna mi byed pa dang /mi 'thun par mi 'jug pas 'gyod pa sel ba dang / gsol ba 'debs pa la yang dgatshwarmepa ji lta ba bzhin du gdams ngag ston pa dang / stong pa nyid bsgom pa la mang du gnas pa ste/ bu mo byang chub sems dpa' chos bzhi po de dag dang ldan na shes rab chen por 'gyur ro/ /de la5)'di skad ces bya ste/ mkhas pa nam yang ser sna yong mi byed/ /mi 'thunatshwanye'ajug pa med pas 'gyod pa sel/ /yang dag rab ldan gdams ngag ston par byed/ /rgyal ba'i spyod pa gang yin stong nyid bsgomakha / /chos bzhi 'di dag nges par bsten 8byas na/ /rgyal bas bzhed pa'i byang chub myur du 'thob/ /sangs rgyas rjes su bstan nas bslab tshe43—731

byas nas/ /rkang gnyis dam pa sangs rgyas de 'gyur ro/ /bu mo byang chub sems dpa' chos bzhi dang ldan na tshe rabs dran par 'gyur te/ bzhi gang zhe na / lung nod pa dang / kha tonatul brtson pa rnams lung mnos pa dang gdams ngag brjedasnyenas yun ring du lon te gsol ba 'debs pa la lung 'bog cing dran par byed pa dang / 'di ltar kun dga' ba'i tshig gis gzhan dag la dang ba nye bar sgrubashepa dang / 'khor ba'i sdug bsngal las nges par 'byung0ba dang ske/ mya ngan las 'das pa'i bde ba thob par bya ba'i phyir gzhan dag la chos ston pa dang / yongs su bsngo ba la mngon par brtson zhing ting nge 'dzin gyi mtshan ma la mkhas pa ste/ bu mo byang chub sems dpa' chos bzhi po de dag dang ldan na tshe rabs dran par 'gyur ro/ /de la 'di skad ces bya ste/ lung mnos kha ton brjed la0dran par byed/ /gzhan la yid du 'ong ba'i sgra yang sgrogs/ /skyo ba med par chos kyang rjod par byed/ /ting 'dzin bsgom pa'i mtshan ma legs par 'dzin/ /chos bzhi 'di dag nges par bsten byas na/ /mthu chen ldan pa tshe rabs dran par 'gyur/ /bskal pa stong phrag bsam yasalgerjes su dran / /rnam par 'dren pa'i mchog nyid myur du 'thob/ /bu mo byang chub sems dpa' chos bzhi dang ldan na sangs rgyas rnams dang phrad ⑧pa 'thob ste/bzhi gang zhe na/ srog gi phyir yang dam pa'i chos mi spong ba dang / srog gi phyir yang sdig pa'i grogs po rnams dang mi sten7pa dang / srog gi phyir yang chos smra ba la skur pa mi 'debs pa dang / sangs rgyas rjes su dran pa'i ting nge 'dzin sgom ⑩pa ste/ bu mo byang chub sems dpa' chos bzhi po de dag dang ldan na sangs rgyas rnams dang phrad par 'gyur ro/ /de la 'di skad ces bya ste/43—732

sangs rgyas byang chub gyi tshom0spong mi byed/ /chos smra ba la skur pa yong7mi 'debs/ /des nasasdig pa'i grogs rnams rnam par spong / /g.yel ba med par rtag tu sangs rgyas dran/ /chos bzhi 'di dag nges par bsten byas na/ /bde gshegs rnams dang phrad pa des 'thob po/ /bla med byang chub ma thob bar du yangs/ /'dren pa gang na bzhugs pa der de skye/ /bu mo byang chub sems dpa' chos bzhi dang ldan na skyes bu chen po'i mtshan sum cu7rtsa gnyis po de⑥dag 'thob ste/ bzhi gang zhe na/ de bzhin gshegs pa dang / de bzhin gshegs pa'i mchod rten la rin po che spar gyis 'thor ba dang / 'bru mar dri zhim po (nyedag gis de bzhin gshegs pa'i mchod rten 'khru bar byed pa dang /me tog dang / spos dang / sil snyan sna tshogs 'bul ba dang / yid du 'ong ba'i g.yog 'khor gyis mkhan po dang / slobatsodapon la bsnyen bkur bya bas rim gro byed pa7ste/ bu mo byang chub sems dpa' chos bzhi po de dag dang ldan na skyes bu chen po'i mtshan sum cu7rtsa gnyis po dag 'thob po/ /de la 'di skad ces bya ste/ mchod rten la ni spar gyis dbyig rnams 'thor/ /dri zhim 'bru mar rnams kyis mchod rten 'khru/ /spos dang me tog sil snyan sna tshogs 'bul/ /yid du 'ong bas mkhan po slobakhedapon sten⑩/ /de'i〈nyelus sum cu0)rtsa gnyis mtshan dang ldan/ /rab tu mdzes shing yon tan kun dang ldan/ /gang gis shes rab mchog ldan rgyal mdzes pa/ /chos de dag gis skyes chen mtshan du 'gyur/ /bu mo byang chub sems dpa' chos bzhi dang ldan na dpe byad bzang po brgyad cu posngo nyedag 'thob ste/ bzhi gang zhe na/ ci stan rgyu nyesna tshogs chos kyi stan du 'bul ba dang / gzhan la bstimanyestang byed pas mi skyo bsredang / chos smra ba 43—733

la 'thab ①mo mi rgol ba dang / sems can rnams byang chub yang dag par 'dzin du 'jug pa ste/ bu mo byang chub sems dpa' chos bzhi po de dag dang ldan na dpe byad bzang po brgyad cu7po dag 'thob po/ /de la 'di skad ces bya ste / stan rgyu sna tshogs chos kyi stan du 'bul/ /gzhan la bste〈stang byed pas skyo ba med/ /chos smra ba la 'thabasremo yang7mi rgol/ /sems can rnams ni byang chub 'dzin du 'jug /'di bzhis lus la dpe byad bzang po rnams/ /'di na7de yis rnyed par dka'atub med/ /yon tan 'di dag rtag tu bstenasnyebyas na/ /byang chub sems dpa' 'di na0)brgyan par 'gyur/ /bu mo byang chub sems dpa' chos bzhi dang ldan na spobs pa 'thob ste/ bzhi gang zhe na/ byang chub sems dpa'i sde snod 'dzin pa dang / nyinatshwa )mtshan du phung po gsum pa'i chos kyi rnam grangs kha ton byed pa dang / sangs rgyas bcom ldan 'das rnams kyi byang chub 'jig rten thams cad dngarwatemi 'thun〈nyepa skye ba med cing 'gag pa med par nges pa la mchog tu dga' ba skyes nas 'dzin pa dang / lus dang srog dang yo byad rnams la mi lta ba ste/ bu mo byang chub sems dpa' chos bzhi po de dag dang ldan na spobs pa 3nye'athob po/ /de la 'di skad ces bya ste/ byang chub sems dpa'i sde snod ni/ /nyin mtshan rab tu 'don par byedaci/ /'jig rten kun dang mi 'thunam8pa/ /skyo ba med par rab tu sgrogs/ /mchog tu dga' ba rnyed gyuramatshanas/ /sangs rgyas bstan pa 'dzin par byed/ /lus dang srog la mi lta bar/ /de ni byang chub lta bar byed/ /bzhi po 'di dag bsten 7byas na/ / de yitsha/nyaspobs pa 'phel bar 'gyur/ /lha dang bcas pa'i 'jig rten kun/ /sna tshogs phreng 17'dras tshim par byed/ /bu mo byang chub sems dpa' chos bzhi dang 43—734

ldan na sangs rgyas kyi zhing yongs su dag pa 'thob ste/ bzhi gang zhe na/ phrag dog med pa dang / ser sna med pa dang / sems can thams cad la sems snyoms patudang / 'khor dang 'dre ba med pa ste/ bu mo byang chub sems dpa' chos bzhi po de dag dang ldan na sangs rgyas kyi zhing yongs su dag pa 'thob po/ /de la 'di skad ces bya ste/ gzhan gyisarnyed la nam yang phrag dog med/ /mthong nas dga' bar 'gyur7te ser sna med/ /sems can kun la de yisnyisems kyang snyoms/ /'khor dang 'drosnyibar de ni yong mi byed/ /chos bzhi 'dis0ni zhing gi bkod 'thob cing / /myur du byang chub mchog kyang thob par 'gyur / /bu mo byang chub sems dpa' chos bzhi dang ldan na dge 'dun phun sum tshogs pa 'thobasreste/ bzhi gang zhe na/ gzhan gyi 'khor mi 'byed pa dang /mi 'thunashepa rnams kyi sdums byed pa dang / lung nod pa dang kha ton byed du 'jug pas phan 'dogs pā dang / phra ma'i tshig yongs su spong bsngo)ste/ bu mo byang chub sems dpa' chos bzhi po de dag dang ldan na dge 'dun phun sum tshogs pa 'thob po/ /de la 'di skad ces bya ste/ gzhan gyi 'khor ni nam yang yong mi 'byedayi/ /skye bo mi 'thunatshwanyepa dag 'dun par byed/ /lung nodamukha ton byed la yang dag 'dzud8/ /pha rol dag la dbyen gyi tshig mi smra/ /chos bzhi 'di dag nges par bsten byas na/ /dge 'dun rgya chen7rnam dag thob par 'gyur/ /de bas dge 'dun rnam par sbyang ba'i phyir(nye/ /mkhas pas chos 'di rtag tu bsten par bya/ /bu mo byang chub sems dpa' chos bzhi dang ldan na (nyesangs rgyas kyi zhing gang du sems bskyed pa der skye ste/ bzhi gang zhe na/gzhan dag gi shes kyi khe7)dang rnyed pa la phrag dog mi skyed zhuX pa dang / lhag pa'i 43—735

bsam pas pha rol tu phyin pa drug po yongs su dag pa yongs su tshol ba dang /byang chub sems dpa' thams cad la ston par 'du shes bskyed ①de tha na sems dang po ②bskyed pa'i ③byang chub sems dpa' la yang bste dustang byed pa dang /shes kyi khe'i phyir tshul 'chos pa med pasnyiste/ bu mo byang chub sems dpa' chos bzhi po de dag dang ldan na sangs rgyas kyi zhing gang ⑥nu sems bskyed pa der skye'o⑦ / /de la 'di skad ces bya ste/ gzhan la mchodasnyepa mthong na phrag dog med/ /pha rol7phyin pa dag pa yongs su 'tsho'atsho/ /byang chub sems dpa' ston par rtag tu sems/ /shes khe bde ba'i don du tshul 'chos med/ /yon tan 'di dag rtag tu bsten byas na/ /de bzhin gshegs pa rnams dang de phradaḍū'agyur / /zhing gang dag tu smon lam btab byas pa/ /'dod pa bzhin du zhing der skye bar 'gyur/ /de nas bcom ldan 'das la bu mo dri ma med kyis byin pas 'di skad ces gsol to/ /bcom ldan 'das gal te bcom ldan 'das kyis ji ltar chos brtags pa 'di dag bdag gis yang dag par blangs termuganas par mi ⑩bgyis na bdag gis sangs rgyas bcom ldan 'das gang dag phyogs bcu'i 'jig rten gyi khams na 'tsho zhing gzhesasnyil chos kyang ston pa de dag thams cad bslus par gyur cig /de nas tshe dang ldan pa mod gal gyi bu chen pos bu mo dri ma med kyis byin pa la 'di skad ces smras so/ /bu mo khyod de skad smra ba ni ngo mtshar te( te/ byang chub sems dpa' rnams kyi byang chub sems dpa'i spyod pa bsgrub dka' bar〈 nyemi shes sam/ de nas bu mo dri ma med kyis byin pas gnas brtan mod gal gyi bu chen po la 'di skad ces smras so/ /btsun pa mod gal gyi bu chen po bden pa dang dubaden pa'i tshig gang ④gis bdag ma 'ongs 43wa 736

pa'i dus na ji ltar da ltar de bzhin gshegs pa mngon sum ①du bzhugs pa ②bzhin du de bzhin gshegs pa dgra bcom pa yang dag par rdzogs pa'i sangs rgyas su 'gyur ba dang / ji ltar brtagasalgepa'i chos 'di dag kyang yang dag par blangs te gnas par 'gyur zhe na/ bden pa dang bden pa'i tshig des stong gsum gyi stong chen po'i 'jig rten gyi khams 'di rnam pa drug tu g.yos par gyur cig /sems can gang la yang gnod pa med par gyur cig /bden pa dang bden pa'i tshig gang rjogis bcom ldan 'das kyis ji ltar brtags ⑦pa'i chos 'di dag⑧yang dag par blangs te gnas par 'gyur zhe na/ bden pa dang bden pa'i tshig des lha'i me togashegi char mngon par 'babalgepar gyur cig /ma dkrol7bar sil snyan bye ba khrag khrig brgya5)stong sgra 'byin par gyur cig /bdag kyang bud med kyi lus las gyur te〈nyeskyes pa'i lus su red cing lo bcu drug lon pa 'dra bar gyur cig /smon lam de skad btab cing bden pa'i byin gyi rlabs tso'adi byas ma thag tu de nas de'i med la stong gsum gyi stong chen po'i 'jig rten gyi khams 'di yang rnam pa7drug tu g.yos/ ma dkrol bar sil snyan bye ba khrag khrig brgya stong gi sgra yang byung / lha'i me tog ginyechar yang mngon par bab bo/ /bu mo dri ma med kyis byin pa yang bud med kyi57lus mi snang bar gyur te skyes pa'i dbang po thob nas lo bcu drug lon pa tsam gyi gzhon nu 'dra bar snang ngo / /de nas bcom ldan 'das la tshe dang ldan pa mod gal gyi bu chen pos 'di skad ces gsol to/ /bcom ldan 'das byang chub sems dpa' rnams ni ngo mtshar che ba lags so/ /bcom ldan 'das dang po sems bskyed pa nas bzung ste byang chub kyi snying po la ( nyaganas pa'i bar gyi byang chub 43—737

sems dpa' la phyag 'tshal lo/ /de ci'i slad du zhe na/ 'di ltar 'di'inyebaden pa'i byin gyi rlabs kyis ②rgyu 'di dag so sor yongs su rdzogs pas bu mo dri ma med kyis byin pa 'di ni 'di ltar rdzu 'phrul che ba 'di ltar dbang che bar grags pa/ 'di ltar mthu che ba lags so/ /bcom ldan 'das kyis bka' stsal pa / mod gal gyi bu de de bzhin no/ /ji skad7smras pa de bzhin te/ dang po ④sems bskyed pa nas bzung ste byang chub kyi snying po'i bar gyi byang chub sems dpa' rnams ni lha dang bcas pa'i 'jig rten gyi mchod rten dang sbyin gnas yin te/ nyan thos dang / rang sangs rgyas thams cad kyang zil gyis gnon to / /de nas bcom ldan 'das kyis de'i tshe 'dzum pa mdzad do/ /'di ni sangs rgyas bcom ldan 'das rnams kyi chos nyid de/ gang gi7tshe 'dzum pa mdzad pa de'i tshe bcom ldan 'das kyi zhal gyi sgo nas 'od zer7kha dog du ma kha dog sna tshogs 'di lta ste/ sngon po dang / ser po dang / dmar po dang /dkar po dang / le brgan dang / shel dang / dngul gyi kha dog lta bu dag byung ste/ 'od des 'jig rten gyi7khams mtha' yas mu med pa dag snang bas khyab par mdzadatshwanyenas tshangs pa'i 'jig rten gyi bar du mngon par 'phags te slar log nas bcom ldan 'das kyi dbu'i gtsug tu nub par gyur to/ /de nas tshe dang ldan pa kun dga' bo stan las langs te bla gos phrag pa gcig tu gzar7nas pus mo g.yas pa'i lha nga sa la btsugs te/ bcom ldan 'das ga la ba de logs su thal mo sbyar ba btud nas bcom ldan 'das la tshigs su bcad de gsol pa/ lha dang tshangs pa'i sgra dang mi mjed bdag po'i sgra dang 'brug sgra dbyangs ldan pa/ /mgon po lha sgra yid 'ong ldan zhing 'dod chags zhe snang zhi 43—738

bar mdzad pa posti/ /gti mug spong ba 'jig rten dag na dga' ba bzang po gzhal yas skyed5snyemadzad pa/ /stobs bcu yon tan rgya mtsho mnga' ba gang gi don du 'od btang bstan du gsol/ /rir bcas nags tshal rtsibacas shing chab dang bcas pa'i sa rnams rnam pa drug tu g.yos/ /lha rnams nam mkhar gnas shing lha yi59me tog yid du 'ong ba'i char pa 'bebs/ /seng ges wa phamadzade)bgyis pa bzhin du khyod kyis mu stegs gzhan kun pham par mdzad/ / dpa' bo ⑥gang gi don du 'od kyi7ltas 'di bstan pa mdzad pa bka' stsal gsol/ /nyi zla bye ba stong gisakyi'od bkye ba dang glog dang nor bu rnams 'od dang / /lha dang klu dang dri zasheganod sbyin dag gi 'od rnams 'bar ba gang lags pa/ /shākya tso thub pa'i zhal nas dge zhing dag pa'i 31'od byung ba dang mjal gyur nas/ /'od rnams thams cad mog mog bgyis na〈gesangs rgyas 'od ni phyogs bcu rnams su mdzes/ /khyod kyi smin mtshams bar gyi mdzod spu gerab mdzes dkar zhing dri ma ma mchis bzang / /'bar zhing pad ma'i rtsa dang dung dang me tog kun da 'dra bas phyogs gsal bgyid/ /thams cad mog mog bgyis nas gdugs kyi misrin bu me khyer bzhin du rgyal ba bemadzes/ / mi yi 7seng ge thub 'di gang gi〈rtedon chen bzang por der 'gyur bstan du gsol/ /de skad ces gsol pa dang /bcom ldan 'das kyis tshe dang ldan pa kun dga' bo la 'di skad ces bka' stsal to / /kun dga' bo khyod kyis bu mo dri ma med kyis byin pa 'di byin gyi rlabs༄snyegang gis bud med kyi dngos po bsgyur nyurtete skyes pa'i dbang po thob params gyur padza rjemathong ngam/ gsol pa/ bcom ldan 'das mthong lags so/ /bka' stsal pa/kun dga' bo byang chub sems dpa' dri ma med kyis byin pa 8nye'adi bskal pa 43—739

grangs med pa 'bum phrag brgyad cur tu)bla na med pa yang dag par rdzogs pa'i byang chub kyi phyir spyad de/ bskal pa grangs med pa 'bum phrag drug cur7spyad nas phyis bu mo 'di 'jam dpal gzhon nur gyur pas bla na med pa yang dag par rdzogs pa'i byang chub tu sems bskyed do/ /'jam dpal gzhon nur gyur pa ci 'dra ba de 'dra ba'i byang chub sems dpa' brgyad khri dag giphusangs rgyas kyi zhing gi yon tan bkod pa gang dag yod pa de 'dra ba dag ni byang chub sems dpa' dri ma med kyis byin pa'i sangs rgyas kyi zhing gi yon tan bkod pa gcig tu 'gyur rol/ /de nas tshe dang ldan pa mod gal gyi bu chen pos byang chub sems dpa' dri ma med kyis byin pa la 'di skad ces smras so/ /rigs kyi bu khyod de ltar yun ring du bla na med pa yang dag par rdzogs pa'i byang chub kyi phyir spyod spyod na/ de ci'i baphyir khyod kyis de'i tshe bud med kyi dngos posnyim bsgyur byang chub sems dpa' dri ma med kyis byinas(6)pas smras pa/ gnas brtanashemod gal gyi bu chen po ni rdzu 'phrul dang ldan pa rnams kyi mchog tu bstan pa yin nani/ btsun pa khyod ci'i phyir skyes pa'i lus las ma bsgyurasti/ gnas brtan mod gal gyi bu chen po cang mi smra bar gyur to/ /de nas byang chub sems dpa' sems dpa' chen po dri ma med kyis byin pas mod gal gyi bu chen po la 'di skad ces smras so/ /btsun pa mod gal gyi bu chen po bud med kyi lus kyis byang chub mngon par rdzogs par 'tshang nya 7rgya ba yang ma yin(1/ skyes pa'i lus kyis byang chub mngon par rdzogs par 'tshang rgya ba yang ma yin no/ /de ci'i phyir zhe na/ byang chub ni ma skyes pa ste/nya/ de ni lus sam sems kyis mngon par rdzogs par 'tshang7rgya bar mi nus pa'i phyir ro/ /de nas bcom ldan 'das la byang chub sems dpa' 43—740

'jam dpal gyis 'di skad ces gsol to/ /bcom ldan 'das 'di ltar byang chub sems dpa' dri ma med kyis byin pa 'di zab mo la mos pa ni ngo mtshar lags so/ /bcom ldan 'das kyis bka' stsal pa/ 'jam dpal 'di ltar byang chub sems dpa' dri ma med kyis byin pa ①'dis sangs rgyas bye ba phrag ②drug cu'i⑧zad nasatshangs par spyod pa spyad do/ /stong pa nyid kyi ting ngesa'adzin bsgoms so/ /bskal pa brgyad cur7mi skye ba'i chos la bzod pa bsgoms so/ /sangs rgyas bye ba phrag sum cu ⑦dang / byang chub sems dpa' zab mo'i tshul dang ldan pa rnams la7shes rab kyi pha rol tu phyin pa yongs su dris so/ /sangs rgyas bye ba phrag brgyad cu la na bza' dang / zhal zas kyis bkur sti5)byas so / /spobs pa rnam par nges par7)bstan pa'i chos kyi rnam grangs 'di yang yongs su dris so/ /'jam dpal rigs kyi bu'amatshwa rigs kyi bu mo gang gis stong gsum gyi stong chen po'i 'jig rten gyi khams gang gā'i7klung gi bye ma snyed dag rin po che sna bdun gyis rab tu bkang ste de bzhin gshegs pa dgra bcom pa yang dag par rdzogs pa'i sangs rgyas rnams la dbul ba phul ba bas rigs kyi bu'am rigs kyi bu mo gang gis chos kyi rnam grangs 'di nyan tam/ len tam/ 'dzin tamakha 'chang ngam/ klogatsogam/ kun chub par byed dam/ gzhan dag la yang rgya cher rab tu ston na 'di ni de bas ches bsod nams mang du skyed5shedo / /de ci'i phyir zhe na/ sgrub pa 'dis hu'eni byang chub 'thob par byed pa'i phyir ro/ /de nas yang bcom ldan 'das kyis 'jam dpal gzhon nur gyur pa la bka' stsal pa/ 'jam dpal khyod kyis chos kyi5)rnam grangs 'di zung shig(nye /chongs shig /lhogs shig /kun chub par gyis shig /gzhan dag la yang rgya 43—741

cher yang dag par rab tu ston cig /de nas bcom ldan 'das la 'jam dpal gzhon nur gyur pas 'di skad ces gsol to/ /bcom ldan 'das chos kyi rnam grangs 'di'i ming ci lags/ 'di ji ltar gzungs3)bar bgyi/ bcom ldan 'das kyis bka' stsal pa/ 'jam dpal de'i phyir chos kyi rnam grangs 'di spobs (pa rnam par nges par5gubastan pa zhes bya bar zung shigs) /gzungs kyi rdo rje'i tshig ces bya bar yang zung shig ge /byang chub sems dpa'i sde snod ces bya bar yang zung shig5) /dri ma med kyis byin pas zhus pa zhes bya bar yang zung shigape /bcom ldan 'das kyis ④chos kyi rnam grangs 'di bstan pa na lha dang mi'i skye dgu las srog chags khrag khrig phrag brgyad cu bla na med pa yang dag par rdzogs pa'i byang chub tu nyu 3nges par gyur to/ /de nas bcom ldan 'das la byang chub sems dpa' spobs pa brtsegs kyis 'di skad ces gsol to/ /bcom ldan 'das byang chub sems dpa' dri ma med kyis byin pa 'di 31ji srid cig na bla na med pa yang dag par rdzogs pa'i byang chub mngon par rdzogs par 'tshang rgya hu bar 'gyur / bcom ldan 'das kyis bka' stsal pa/ rigs kyi bu byang chub sems dpa' dri ma med kyis byin pa 'di bskal pa brgya stong phrag grangs med pa bgrang ba las 'das pa na sangs rgyas kyi zhing nyan thos dang rang sangs rgyas rnams med pa tshe'i tshad dpag tu med pa/ byang chub sems dpa'i dge 'dun dpag tu med pa dang ldan pa/ lha'i longs spyod pas shin tu lhag pa dang ldan pa/ yon tan dpag tu med pa bkod pa zhes bya b.ramu de bzhin gshegs pa dgra bcom pa yang dag par rdzogs pa'i sangs rgyas bzhad cing 'dzum pa dri ma med pa'i tsotog gi rgyal po zhes bya bar 'gyur ro/ /de nas byang chub sems dpa' dri ma med kyis 43—742
